title: Bengali Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Bengali speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Bengali speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Bengali, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Bengali and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Bengali experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Bengali, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Bengali speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Fullstack Java Developer – Area Finance
description:

Per ampliamento del nostro organico interno, stiamo cercando un*:

Fullstack Java Developer – Area Finance

  • Familiarità con strumenti di sviluppo come Eclipse e IntelliJ.

  • Attitudine al confronto e al lavoro in team.
  • Precisione e capacità di organizzare il proprio lavoro.
  • Spiccate doti di problem solving.
  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese.


Cosa può offrirti BFF Bank spa:

Sede di lavoro: Viale Lodovico Scarampo 15, Milano

RAL: a partire da 48.000€

In BFF Bank spa ci assicuriamo che ogni singola persona abbia accesso alle medesime opportunità e ai medesimi equi trattamenti. title: Group Lead - Water & Environment Engineering
description:
Key Responsibilities

· Business Unit Leadership: Own the operational performance, delivery maturity, profitability, and growth roadmap for the Water & Environmental Engineering BU.

· P&L and Resource Management: Manage gross margins, capacity planning, billable utilization, project loading, and productivity across multidisciplinary offshore engineering teams.

· Global Delivery Ownership: Lead end-to-end delivery for municipal water distribution, wastewater collection, sewer gravity and force main systems, stormwater management, hydraulic modeling, flood studies, pump stations, and W/WWTP BIM/design support projects.

· Technical Quality Gatekeeping: Establish and enforce design review protocols for hydraulic calculations, pipe networks, profiles, treatment plant layouts, clash coordination, model outputs, drawings, and reports.

· Client Partnership: Serve as the senior technical and delivery interface for global engineering consultancies, managing expectations, scope, change orders, SLAs, technical RFIs, and executive-level client communication.

· Standards and Compliance: Ensure deliverables comply with applicable international and local requirements including US EPA, AWWA, WEF, Ten States Standards, UK Sewers for Adoption, Eurocodes, ISO 9001, ISO 19650, and client-specific municipal utility standards.

· Digital Delivery and BIM Transformation: Standardize workflows across Civil 3D, Bentley WaterCAD, SewerGEMS, OpenFlows, EPA SWMM, InfoWater/InfoSewer, HEC-RAS, Revit MEP, AutoCAD Plant 3D, and model-based QA/QC processes.

· Team Building and Capability Development: Recruit, mentor, upskill, and retain hydraulic engineers, civil designers, BIM modelers, draftspersons, and technical leads; create a scalable bench for international project demand.

· Process Excellence: Develop SOPs, automation opportunities, checklists, design templates, QA frameworks, and production standards to improve accuracy, turnaround time, and repeatability.

· Cross-Disciplinary Coordination: Coordinate civil, process, structural, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, and digital delivery teams to produce integrated, coordinated, and construction-ready outputs.



Requirements

Required Qualifications and Experience

· M.E. / M Tech in Civil, Environmental, Chemical, Water Resources, or related engineering discipline.

· 15+ years of experience in water, wastewater, stormwater, wet utilities, hydraulic modeling, or environmental infrastructure engineering.

· Minimum 10+ years in a senior delivery or technical leadership role managing international projects for clients in North America markets.

· Demonstrated experience building or scaling offshore engineering teams, preferably within an engineering consultancy, GCC, or specialist design delivery organization.

· Strong technical breadth across water distribution networks, gravity and pressurized sewer systems, stormwater detention/retention, pump stations, treatment plants, pipe profiles, and multidisciplinary BIM coordination.

· Proficiency or strong working knowledge of Civil 3D, Bentley WaterCAD/SewerGEMS/OpenFlows, EPA SWMM, InfoWater/InfoSewer, HEC-RAS, Revit MEP, AutoCAD Plant 3D, Navisworks, and related design/digital delivery platforms.

· Proven ability to interpret and apply international standards, municipal specifications, design manuals, and client-specific engineering requirements.

title: Rakennuttamisen projektipäällikkö (sähkötekniikka), Vantaa
description:
Projektipäällikkönä tiedät, että projektien onnistuminen ei ole sattumaa. Se vaatii taitoa, yhteistyötä ja oikeat tekijät. Caverionilla pääset johtamaan projekteja, jotka tukevat kiinteistöjen koko elinkaarta. Olet osa ammattilaisten tiimiä, jossa hommat hoituvat ja projektit valmistuvat. Jos sinullekin on tärkeää saada asiat toimimaan fiksusti ja kestävästi, saatat hyvinkin olla yksi meistä – toimivan elämän tekijä.

Me caverit teemme töitä toimivan elämän eteen intohimolla ja ylpeydellä. Etsimme nyt joukkoomme rakennuttamisen projektipäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Vantaalle.

Tässä roolissa vastaat sähköteknisten korjaus-, investointi- ja kehityshankkeiden johtamisesta kiinteistöympäristössä. Johdat useita projekteja samanaikaisesti ja vastaat niiden sujuvasta etenemisestä aina hankkeiden valmistelusta käyttöönottoon asti.

Päivittäisessä työssäsi korostuvat:

- Projektien johtaminen: Hankkeiden valmistelu, suunnittelun ohjaus sekä aikataulun, budjetin, riskien ja laadun seuranta.

- Sähkötekniset ratkaisut: Sähköjärjestelmien ja teknisten ratkaisujen arviointi sekä sähköteknisten kokonaisuuksien koordinointi projektien eri vaiheissa.

- Rakennuttaminen: Urakoiden kilpailutus, urakoitsijoiden ohjaaminen ja hankkeiden toteutuksen koordinointi.

- Sidosryhmäyhteistyö: Tiivis yhteistyö asiakkaiden, kiinteistönomistajien, suunnittelijoiden, urakoitsijoiden ja muiden projektinjohdon ja rakennuttamisen asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

- Hankkeiden kehittäminen: Riskien ennakoiva hallinta, teknisten ratkaisujen arviointi ja asiakkaan tavoitteiden tukeminen.

Työpäiväsi koostuvat esimerkiksi asiakkaiden ja projektiryhmien tapaamisista, hankkeiden edistämisestä, teknisten ratkaisujen arvioinnista sekä projektidokumentaation hallinnasta. Työaika on pääsääntöisesti liukuva toimistotyöaika (37,5 h/vko).

Tehtävässä on mahdollisuus hybridityöhön. Työ sisältää sekä toimisto- että etätyötä, mutta myös säännöllisiä käyntejä asiakaskohteissa ja työmailla.

Pääasiallinen toimipisteesi sijaitsee Vantaalla ja hankkeet ovat pääasiassa Uudenmaan alueella. Tehtävään voi sisältyä myös satunnaista matkustamista muualla Suomessa. Kohteemme ovat tyypillisesti toimitila-, liike-, logistiikka-, teollisuus-, julkisen sektorin ja energia-alan kiinteistöjä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Soveltuvaa sähkötekniikan, automaation tai talotekniikan korkeakoulututkintoa (DI, AMK-insinööri tai vastaava).

- Kokemusta sähköteknisten järjestelmien suunnittelu-, rakennuttamis-, valvonta- tai projektinjohtotehtävistä.

- Kokemusta projektien johtamisesta tai koordinoinnista.

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä asiakaslähtöisyyttä.

- Oma-aloitteista, järjestelmällistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta.

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Englannin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi.

- B-ajokorttia.

Katsomme eduksi

- Kokemuksen rakennuttamis- tai konsultointitehtävistä sekä korjausrakentamisen ja kiinteistöjen investointihankkeista.

- Rakennusautomaation tuntemuksen sekä energiatehokkuus-, aurinkosähkö-, sähkövarasto- tai latausinfrahankkeiden tuntemuksen.

- KSE- ja YSE-menettelyjen sekä julkisten hankintojen ja hankintamenettelyiden tuntemuksen.

- Kokemuksen datakeskus- tai kriittisen infrastruktuurin hankkeista.

- SFS-standardien, sähkömääräysten ja alan säädösten tuntemuksen.

- Työturvallisuuskortin.

Tehtävään valitulle henkilölle voidaan tehdä turvallisuusselvitys asiakas- tai kohdekohtaisesti tarvittaessa.

Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön ja oman tiimin tuen, laajat koulutus- ja kehitysmahdollisuudet sekä avoimen ja osallistavan työkulttuurin monipuolisten ja haastavien asiakkuuksien parissa.

title: Data Scientist II
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

The **Artificial Intelligence Group (https://ai.jpl.nasa.gov)** is seeking a **Data Scientist II** to work on fundamental research problems leading to unique software applications in spacecraft autonomy, scientific data analysis, mission operations automation, and onboard analysis for real-time decisions.

The **Data Scientist II** will have the opportunity to work on development projects that include the automation of ground and flight operations for communications stations, space missions, marine vehicles, and aerial vehicles, including fleets of vehicles. You will use Artificial Intelligence technologies to partially and fully automate critical systems for scheduling, planning, and resource allocation. Our software is currently in use for numerous missions including but not limited to: ECOSTRESS, OCO-3, EMIT, NISAR, M2020, and the DSN.

Tasks include but are not limited to:

- Develop planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and execution algorithms for autonomous systems that interpret complex state, resource, constraint, and event data to take actions to achieve mission goals.
- Develop and use search-based, constraint-based, satisfaction and optimization systems to solve large scale planning and resource allocation problems.
- Develop software to represent and reason about complex geometric and operations constraints relevant to observation planning.
- Support broader team efforts in this automation and resource allocation areas.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related discipline with a minimum of 3 years of related work experience; Master's degree in similar disciplines with a minimum of 1 years of related work experience; or PhD in similar disciplines with 0 years of related work experience.
- Broad knowledge in one or more related fields of the following areas: software development, artificial intelligence, operations research, resource allocation mechanisms.
- Experience in wide application of principles, theories, concepts, and techniques in programming languages (in order of preference) such as Rust, C++, C, Python, and Java.
- Background knowledge in Artificial Intelligence and/or Operations research techniques and concepts, as documented by software artifacts built, tested, etc.

**Preferred Skills:**

title: Lähihoitaja, Järvenpään sekä Pornaisten kotihoito
description:
Haemme lähihoitajaa Järvenpään kotihoitoon. Työskentelemme Järvenpää-Pornainen alueella.

Työ kotihoidossa on asiakkaan luona tapahtuvaa asiakaslähtöistä ja toimintakykyä ylläpitävää hoitotyötä sisältäen perushoidon lisäksi sairaanhoidollisia tehtäviä. Kotihoidon tavoitteena on asiakkaan hyvä arki, kotona asumisen turvallisuus ja kotona itsenäinen selviytyminen. Avoin tehtävä sijoittuu Järvenpään ja Pornaisten kotihoidon alueelle, mutta teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä muiden kotihoitotiimien kanssa yli kuntarajojen.

Lähihoitajan tehtävänkuva on monipuolinen sekä vastuullinen ja sisältää monipuolista tiimityötä. Työhön kuuluu asiakaslähtöinen hoidon suunnittelu, toteutus ja arviointi. Työ tehdään aamu- sekä iltavuoroissa myös viikonloppuisin.

Kotihoidon työ on itsenäistä, meillä se ei ole yksinäistä. Työkaverit auttavat sekä tukevat toinen toisiaan. Haluamme myös, että koet itsesi tervetulleeksi ja siksi panostamme hyvään perehdytykseen.

Työssäsi saat mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kehittymiseen sekä mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen työnkuvan. Mikäli kehittämistyö kiinnostaa sinua, annamme myös mahdollisuuden olla mukana kehittämässä kotihoidon toimintaa. Haluamme mahdollistaa sinulle työpaikan, jossa voit työskennellä monipuolisesti omaa osaamistasi hyödyntäen.

Tehtävään edellytettävä kelpoisuus

- Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteen ammatillinen tutkinto.

Hakijalta edellytämme ja toivomme

- Edellytämme voimassa olevia lääkelupia, jotka voi suorittaa heti palvelussuhteen alkaessa. Edellytämme lisäksi ajokorttia, oman auton käyttö ei ole välttämätöntä, mutta se on etu. Oman auton käytöstä maksamme kilometrikorvaukset.
- Tehtävän hoitamiseen tarvitaan kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon, oman työn suunnittelu- ja organisointikykyä ja hyviä tiimityötaitoja

Lisätiedot tehtävästä antaa esihenkilö Anni Talvela, p. 050 497 4322, anni.talvela@keusote.fi

title: Business Analyst – Credit & Risk Excellence ( Relocation to Qatar)

  • Develop future-state process maps, procedures, business requirements, control requirements, and implementation documentation.
  • Identify duplication, unnecessary hand offs, manual activities, control gaps, approval bottlenecks, and opportunities for standardization, simplification, and automation.

title: Field PLC Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Field PLC Engineer based in United States.

This hands-on engineering role focuses on developing, testing, programming, and supporting PLC-based control systems for large-scale data centers and other critical infrastructure environments. You will work across HVAC, mechanical, electrical, and facility systems where reliable automation is essential to operational performance. The position combines PLC programming with field commissioning, troubleshooting, system integration, and client interaction. You will collaborate with engineers, project managers, commissioning teams, contractors, vendors, and customers to deliver robust control solutions. The role offers significant ownership of assigned engineering work within a fast-paced and collaborative environment. Frequent travel to project sites provides direct exposure to complex automation systems and mission-critical facilities.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop, modify, test, and validate PLC programs supporting HVAC, central plant, mechanical, electrical, and other critical facility systems.
  • Implement customer-requested changes to PLC databases, control sequences, logic, control strategies, tags, alarms, I/O structures, and system parameters.
  • Develop reusable programming components, templates, and standardized control practices to improve consistency and scalability.
  • Test PLC logic and validate system functionality before field deployment and commissioning.
  • Meet with clients to understand mechanical, electrical, automation, and facility-control requirements and provide technical input during design and project discussions.
  • Collaborate with project managers, engineers, contractors, vendors, commissioning teams, and field personnel to deliver PLC and controls scope successfully.
  • Communicate project status, technical risks, open issues, and required actions clearly and proactively.
  • Support field installation, system start-up, commissioning, troubleshooting, and functional validation activities.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues involving PLC logic, control hardware, field devices, wiring, and industrial communication networks.
  • Support static and dynamic commissioning of building automation and specialized facility systems.
  • Integrate PLC-based controls with SCADA, BMS, EPMS, HMI, and other facility management and monitoring platforms.
  • Document programming workflows, logic changes, system configurations, testing activities, and commissioning updates for project turnover.
  • Follow established PLC programming standards, naming conventions, code review processes, and documentation requirements.
  • Maintain accurate project files and technical records while contributing to internal reviews and lessons-learned initiatives.
  • Manage assigned engineering work independently while maintaining appropriate communication with senior engineers and project stakeholders.

    • Requirements

    • 6+ years of experience in PLC programming, controls engineering, industrial automation, or a related technical discipline.
    • Hands-on experience or working knowledge of Rockwell/Allen-Bradley Studio 5000 or comparable PLC programming platforms.
    • Strong understanding of PLC logic, I/O systems, field devices, industrial networks, and control system architecture.
    • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot PLC logic, hardware, field devices, and communication-network issues.
    • Experience supporting field commissioning, start-up, testing, and validation activities is highly relevant.
    • Strong organizational, task-management, technical documentation, and problem-solving skills.
    • Ability to work independently on defined engineering assignments while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
    • Self-directed, proactive approach with the ability to manage priorities and communicate issues appropriately.
    • Strong client-facing communication skills and comfort participating in technical meetings and design discussions.
    • OSHA 10 certification obtained within the past two years is required. Candidates without a current certification will be required to complete employer-provided OSHA 10 training successfully within the first week of employment.
    • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50–60%, including frequent travel by car or plane and potential extended assignments at project sites.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Software, Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
    • Experience with HVAC controls, central plants, chillers, boilers, or other mechanical systems is advantageous.
    • Exposure to Ignition SCADA, HMIs, Kepware, EPMS, BMS, or facility integration platforms is preferred.
    • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP, BACnet/IP, or OPC-UA is a plus.
    • Experience in data centers, hyperscale infrastructure, mission-critical facilities, or systems integration environments is beneficial.
    • Ability to stand, walk, and move around active job sites for extended periods.

description:
Lead Print Production Technician- Press (We’ll Train You!)

2nd shift (3pm-11PM) | Full-Time | Competitive Pay + Overtime Opportunities

Bring Print to Life with Precision

At Sheridan Lebanon Junction we're passionate about producing high-quality books and publications that people can hold, read, and enjoy.

If you're mechanically inclined, enjoy working with equipment, and take pride in producing quality work, we'd love to meet you. Previous offset press experience is a plus, but we're willing to train someone with the right attitude and willingness to learn. We’d love to have you join our Press team as a Lead Print Production Technician (Press Operator 3).

What You'll Do

As a Lead Print Production Operator, you'll operate and maintain multi-color offset printing presses while ensuring every job meets the highest quality standards. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Operating and maintaining two-color, four-color, and multi-color offset presses.
  • Producing work involving large solids, screen tints, line work, and halftones requiring critical color accuracy and registration.
  • Reviewing job specifications to ensure proper processing, press setup, and production sequence.
  • Performing complete make-ready procedures, including hanging plates and installing cylinders.
  • Adjusting press tension, register, and other press settings to achieve quality standards.
  • Inspecting printing plates and cylinders for defects before and during production.
  • Making color corrections and press adjustments prior to and throughout production runs.
  • Cleaning, lubricating, and performing routine maintenance on press equipment, including minor repairs and replacing worn components.
  • Maintaining accurate production records and communicating production issues with supervisors.
  • Supporting special projects and performing other related duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who:

  • Can read a tape measure accurately.
  • Performs basic math, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, decimals, and percentages.
  • Can read and interpret job specifications to determine proper press setup and materials.
  • Has strong knowledge of offset press equipment, production processes, and quality standards.
  • Can perform complex mechanical adjustments, press setup, routine maintenance, and minor equipment repairs.
  • Understands press capabilities and selects appropriate settings and materials for each production run.
  • Can accurately use a micrometer to mount and align printing plates.
  • Can read and understand safety procedures, equipment instructions, and mechanical drawings.
  • Communicates effectively in writing with proper grammar, spelling, and organization.
  • Solves practical production problems involving multiple variables.
  • Can interpret written, verbal, diagrammatic, and schedule-based instructions.
  • Works well with others and contributes to a positive team environment.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Four years of vocational training or related experience in offset printing operations.
  • Extensive experience operating multi-color offset printing presses.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills involving press setup, registration, and color correction.
  • Experience performing press maintenance and mechanical adjustments.

Physical & Work Environment

This is an active manufacturing role that includes:

  • Occasionally lifting and carrying 20–50 pounds.
  • Frequently lifting and carrying 10–20 pounds.
  • Frequent standing, reaching, overhead reaching, handling, and fine finger movements.
  • Occasional walking, stooping, crouching, and other physical movement.
  • Frequent use of near vision, distance vision, depth perception, and color vision for quality control.
  • Frequent operation of equipment requiring precise hand and finger coordination.
  • Working in a very loud manufacturing environment.
  • Occasional exposure to wet or humid conditions and moving mechanical equipment.
  • Constant use of required personal protective equipment (PPE).

Why Join Sheridan?

We invest in our employees and create opportunities to build long-term careers. We offer:

  • Stable, full-time employment with a growing company.
  • A safe, values-based workplace built on integrity and respect.
  • Paid, hands-on training through Sheridan Academy.
  • Career advancement opportunities.
  • Tuition reimbursement for approved coursework.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • A 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and paid holidays.
  • Company-paid basic life, AD&D, and short-term disability insurance.
  • First Stop Health telemedicine services at little to no cost.
  • A free and confidential Employee Assistance Program for wellness and mental health support.
  • An employee referral program.
  • Opportunities to continue growing your printing and manufacturing career.

If you're an experienced press operator who takes pride in quality, enjoys working with advanced printing equipment, and is ready to grow your career with an industry leader, we'd love to meet you!

title: Lehtori, englanti ja espanja, sijaisuus, Ylästön koulu
description:
Vantaan kaupunki, Kasvatus ja oppiminen, Perusopetus
Ylästön koulu

Ollaksentie 29, 01690 Vantaa

Työsuhteen kesto: Määräaikainen 04.11.2026 - 30.06.2027

Englannin ja espanjan opettaja – tule osaksi Ylästön koulun upeaa yhteisöä!

Tule meille Ylästön kouluun englannin ja espanjan kielen lehtorin sijaisuuteen ajalle 4.11.2026–30.6.2027.

Etsimme oppilaslähtöistä, innostavaa ja yhteistyökykyistä opettajaa vahvistamaan kielten tiimiämme. Tehtävässä opetat englantia 8.–9. vuosiluokkien oppilaille sekä A2-espanjaa 4.–9. vuosiluokkien oppilaille. Saat tueksesi kokeneen ja yhteistyöhön sitoutuneen neljän opettajan kielten ainetiimin, jossa pääsee jakamaan ideoita ja kollegoilta saa apua arkeen.

Miksi Ylästö?

Ylästön koulu on noin 840 oppilaan yhtenäiskoulu Vantaalla. Vaikka olemme suuri koulu, kutsumme itseämme ylpeästi kyläkouluksi. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen oppilas ja työntekijä tulee nähdyksi ja kuulluksi.

Koulussamme työskentelee noin 85 opetuksen ja ohjauksen ammattilaista. Olemme rakentaneet uudehkon koulumme toimintakulttuuria yhdessä, luottamuksen, avoimen vuorovaikutuksen ja yhteisen kehittämisen varaan. Uuden opettajan on helppo tulla mukaan joukkoon, sillä täällä et jää yksin.

Monipuolinen koulumme tarjoaa tavallisen yhtenäiskoulutoiminnan lisäksi musiikkiluokkatoimintaa vuosiluokille 3-9 sekä yläkouluikäisten oppilaiden vammaisopetusta. Luonnonläheinen ympäristö ja viihtyisä pientaloalue luovat erinomaiset mahdollisuudet myös ulkona oppimiseen. [Tutustu Ylästön koulun tomintaan.](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/palveluhakemisto/toimipiste/ylaston-koulu)

Toivomme sinulta

- innostusta kielten opettamiseen ja oppilaiden kohtaamiseen,
- halua tehdä yhteistyötä kollegoiden kanssa,
- aktiivista ja kehittävää työotetta ja
- kykyä luoda turvallinen ja kannustava oppimisympäristö.

Koulun slogan "Yhdessä Ylästön koulussa" kannattaa tulla kokemaan paikan päälle. Meillä et jää yksin!

Miksi valita Vantaa?

Vantaa on maamme neljänneksi suurin kaupunki, jossa on rohkeutta tehdä asioita uudella tavalla ja taitoa toimia yhteistyössä erilaisissa verkostoissa. Kaupunki on turvallinen työnantaja, joka tarjoaa henkilöstölle laajat mahdollisuudet osaamisen kehittämiseen. Nykyaikaisissa oppilaitoksissamme arvostetaan laadukkaan kasvatuksen ja opetuksen lisäksi kansainvälisyyttä, monikulttuurisuutta ja yhteisöllisyyttä.

Tule opettajaksi Vantaalle! [Tutustu opettajan työhön Vantaa.fi:ssä.](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/tyo-perusopetuksessa-ja-toisella-asteella)

Vantaan kaupunki tarjoaa työntekijöilleen monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta-, hyvinvointi- ja kulttuuriedun, lounasedun ja työmatkaedun julkisen liikenteen käyttöön. Tuemme henkilöstön hyvinvointia mahdollistamalla ja tukemalla liikunnallista elämäntapaa. Kaupungin työntekijät voivat hyödyntää mm. uimahallien, kuntosalien ja ryhmäliikunnan sekä hierontayritysten etuhintaisia palveluja. Lisäksi työntekijöille on usein tarjolla alennushintaisia lippuja kaupungin kulttuuritapahtumiin.

Jos jäit vielä pohtimaan, mitä Vantaalla on sinulle tarjottavaa, [käy verkkosivuillamme lukemassa lisää syitä valita Vantaa.](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/kaupunki-ja-paatoksenteko/avoimet-tyopaikat-vantaan-kaupungilla/johtaminen-tyohyvinvointi-ja-henkilostoedut)

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksen lisäksi edellytämme: hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja.

Vantaa on vastuullinen työnantaja. Tuemme työntekijöidemme hyvinvointia ja osaamista sekä työyhteisöjen hyvää ilmapiiriä. Kehitämme jatkuvasti esihenkilötyötämme. title: Associate
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team:

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres, biotechs and MedTech companies to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges.

About the role:

This is an exciting, new role, for an individual motivated to deepen their knowledge of AI transformation in life sciences. As an Associate, you’ll be part of a close-knit team - scoping, building and delivering impactful AI projects for our pharmaceutical clients. We’ll look to you to build trusted client relationships, analyse requirements and feedback, stay on top of workflows and help to ensure our bespoke AI solutions are optimised for real-world operations.

#LI-PRIO

What you'll be doing:

  • Managing individual work streams to support the successful delivery and implementation of bespoke AI solutions.

  • Working side-by-side with life sciences stakeholders to understand critical mission challenges and user needs

  • Conducting open-source analysis to support the development of cutting-edge AI tools

  • Translating complex operational requirements into clear user stories for delivery and engineering teams.

  • Designing and testing workflows that support user-centric decision-making in high-stakes environments

  • Collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure projects run smoothly and solutions meet customer needs

  • Contributing to internal thought leadership, strategy, and capability development across the team

Who we're looking for:

  • You have some experience working on AI implementation/data intensive projects in a commercial setting

  • You've worked in a Life Sciences company, or with Life Sciences clients

  • You demonstrate analytical thinking, can clearly communicate ideas, and synthesise complex information

  • You have external client-facing experience and have built trusted relationships which have contributed to the overall success of projects

  • You understand Agile and related methodologies and the basis of iterative development and continuous delivery

  • You are thoughtful and proactive in ambiguous situations, keen to take initiative and own finding solutions to challenges

  • You’re excited and energised by the possibilities for innovation in life sciences!

Our interview process:

  1. Talent Team Screen (40 mins)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)

  4. Interview with Business Unit Director (30 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Cloud, Data & AI Security Engineer
description:
We are hiring a Cloud, Data + AI Security Engineer for a large aviation organisation in Dublin. This is a hands‑on engineering role at the point where data security and AI security meet, and it is an urgent hire with an immediate start.

Hybrid, 3 days per week on site

Our client is securing both its data estate and the AI tooling now being deployed across the business. You will be the person doing the engineering: building and tuning Microsoft Purview controls, and applying the same rigour to the AI tools, agents and integrations the organisation is adopting. This is a build role, not an oversight role. You will own the controls end to end, from design through deployment to evidence and reporting, and work alongside Data, AI, Privacy and Legal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Designing, building and tuning Microsoft Purview controls: sensitivity labels, DLP policies, classification and rights management
  • Engineering secure deployments of AI tools, agents, bots and integrations
  • Building and governing controls around AI usage across the organisation
  • Delivering control governance and remediation workflows for data and AI non‑compliances
  • Producing evidence‑based reporting on control coverage and compliance posture
  • Working directly with Data, AI, Privacy and Legal stakeholders on governance requirements
  • Owning technical delivery end to end rather than overseeing someone else's

You need both sides of this role. Candidates with one side only have not made it through.

Technical & Experience Requirements

  • Hands‑on Microsoft Purview and data security engineering, with real delivered project work across sensitivity labels, DLP, classification and rights management
  • Hands‑on AI engineering or AI security: building, governing or securing AI tools, agents, bots or MCP integrations, or engineering secure AI deployments
  • Minimum 8 years industry experience, including 4+ years specifically in data security, information protection or security engineering
  • Control governance, remediation workflows and evidence‑based reporting for data and AI non‑compliances
  • Experience collaborating with governance stakeholders across Data, AI, Privacy and Legal

On the AI side, please note this means engineering or security work on AI systems. Using Copilot or ChatGPT as a productivity tool does not meet the bar the client has set.

This one is genuinely hands‑on. It will suit an engineer who still builds, and who can talk through a real project in technical detail: what you deployed, at what scale, what went wrong and how you solved it.

It is not an architecture, programme management, delivery management or pre‑sales position, and profiles from those backgrounds have been unsuccessful even at senior level. It is also not a fit if your depth is CI/CD, infrastructure, supply chain or network and perimeter security rather than data security specifically.

Interview Process

Interview(s) with the end client The client is moving quickly on this one.

title: Senior Auditor/ Audit Supervisor Market Risk
description:
The Corporate Audit Services (CAS) department conducts and coordinates operational audits across ING, including specialist audit coverage of Market Risk Management, Treasury and related financial risk areas. As part of this team, the Audit Manager plays an important role in providing independent assurance over market risk and treasury activities across ING's global organisation.


Role and responsibilities

In this role, you will contribute to and lead complex audits covering both trading book and banking book risk management, including market risk, counterparty credit risk, valuation, Treasury, liquidity and funding risk, capital management, ICAAP and ILAAP. You will assess whether risk management practices, governance, controls and regulatory compliance are effective, sustainable and aligned with ING's risk profile.


We are looking for someone with a strong background in market risk management, ideally gained within a major bank, financial institution, consultancy firm or audit environment. You bring a proven track record in analysing complex risk topics, challenging stakeholders and translating technical observations into clear audit messages.


As an Audit Manager you are an experienced professional and subject matter expert who contributes to the delivery of high-quality audits and audit strategy. You may be involved in several complex audits simultaneously and are expected to lead on content, provide specialist input and help formulate key messages for auditees and senior management.


Your responsibilities include:

  • Performing and leading audits across Market Risk Management, Treasury and related financial risk topics.
  • Assessing end-to-end risk management processes, governance, controls, models, methodologies and management information.
  • Reviewing the design and operating effectiveness of controls over trading and banking book risk management.
  • Identifying key risks, defining audit scope, developing audit testing and formulating clear, evidence-based findings.
  • Challenging management in a constructive and professional manner.
  • Communicating audit outcomes clearly to stakeholders.
  • Sharing specialist knowledge with audit colleagues and supporting the development of team members.
  • Contributing to audit planning, continuous risk monitoring and the development of CAS expertise in market risk management.



The team

You will be based in Amsterdam within the Market Risk & Treasury audit team, working in hybrid mode between home and the office. International audits are performed jointly by local audit teams and central specialists. The team is part of the CAS Risk & Finance Division, a professional, international audit organisation with teams across the globe.


You will work in an environment where open communication, continuous learning, professional challenge and innovation are encouraged.

Your profile

title: Telugu Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Telugu speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Telugu speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Telugu, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Telugu and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Telugu experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Telugu, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Telugu speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

  • Analisi delle procedure SAS: analisi delle procedure esistenti sviluppate in SAS Enterprise Guide, per un totale di circa 250 procedure e complessivamente circa 2,5 MB di codice SAS.
  • Comprensione della logica funzionale: analisi e comprensione della logica di business e dei processi implementati nelle procedure SAS, individuando input, elaborazioni, trasformazioni e output attesi.
  • Reingegnerizzazione in Python: traduzione e riscrittura delle procedure SAS in Python, garantendo la coerenza funzionale dei risultati e adottando approcci di sviluppo strutturati, efficienti e manutenibili.
  • Ottimizzazione architetturale: identificazione e implementazione, ove applicabile, di possibili miglioramenti architetturali e di performance rispetto alle soluzioni esistenti.
  • Serverless e AWS: valutazione e trasformazione delle procedure attualmente eseguite manualmente in processi serverless, on demand o schedulati, attraverso l'utilizzo dei servizi AWS più appropriati.
  • Test e collaudo: esecuzione e supporto alle attività di test e validazione delle procedure convertite, verificando la correttezza dei risultati prodotti.
  • Confronto SAS/Python: predisposizione di evidenze relative ai test effettuati e analisi comparative tra i risultati ottenuti dalle procedure SAS originali e dalle corrispondenti implementazioni in Python.
  • Rilascio: supporto alle attività di preparazione, validazione e rilascio delle procedure convertite negli ambienti di riferimento.
  • Troubleshooting: analisi e risoluzione di eventuali anomalie riscontrate durante le fasi di sviluppo, test e confronto tra le implementazioni SAS e Python.
  • Collaborazione con il team Controllo Volumi: interazione con la funzione di Controllo Volumi per la spiegazione iniziale delle procedure da convertire, la discussione delle migliorie proposte, le attività di test e validazione e la condivisione dei risultati.
  • Trasferimento di competenze: condivisione di best practice Python, principi di organizzazione e struttura delle procedure convertite e raccomandazioni per eventuali interventi futuri, con l'obiettivo di rendere il team autonomo nella gestione e manutenzione delle soluzioni.
  • Documentazione: produzione e aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica necessaria a descrivere le procedure convertite, le scelte implementative, i test effettuati e le eventuali migliorie introdotte.
  • Ottima conoscenza del linguaggio Python.
  • Buona conoscenza di SAS Enterprise Guide.
  • Buona conoscenza di Base SAS, SAS Macro Language e PROC SQL.
  • Buona conoscenza di SQL.
  • Preferibile esperienza con database Microsoft SQL Server e PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarità con strumenti di versioning del codice, preferibilmente Git.
  • Capacità di analizzare e comprendere codice esistente e logiche di elaborazione complesse.
  • Capacità di reingegnerizzare procedure esistenti mantenendone la coerenza funzionale.
  • Buone capacità di analisi, problem solving e troubleshooting.
  • Autonomia nello svolgimento delle attività di sviluppo e conversione.
  • Capacità di interfacciarsi con interlocutori funzionali e tecnici per la raccolta dei requisiti e la validazione dei risultati.
  • Attitudine al lavoro strutturato e alla produzione di documentazione tecnica.
  • Esperienza maturata in ambito Energy o Utility.
  • Esperienza nell'ambito di processi di Portfolio Management.
  • Esperienza con servizi AWS, in particolare Lambda, Glue e S3.
  • Conoscenza di ambienti DevOps e pratiche CI/CD.
  • Esperienza in attività di data migration.
  • Conoscenza di architetture serverless e processi di schedulazione automatizzata.
  • Conoscenza di metodologie e best practice per lo sviluppo e la manutenzione di applicazioni Python.

You will plan testing activities, create comprehensive test documentation, and validate product changes across mobile, web, and backend layers. The position combines hands-on manual testing with a strong focus on improving QA efficiency through automation of repetitive checks and practical AI tooling. You will work closely with engineering and product teams to identify defects early and communicate issues clearly enough for rapid resolution. With production releases occurring several times a week, your testing will have a direct impact on product reliability and user experience. This is an opportunity for a structured, product-minded QA professional to help continuously improve both the product and its testing processes.

Accountabilities:

  • Plan testing scope, timelines, scenarios, and coverage for product releases.

  • Perform hands-on testing across mobile, web, and backend components.
  • Identify defects quickly, investigate issues, and document them clearly so engineering teams can act without unnecessary follow-up.
  • Work with client-server applications and assess how changes affect different parts of the product.
  • Support QA activities throughout the Agile development and release lifecycle rather than treating testing solely as a final quality gate.
  • Continuously improve QA processes by standardizing repetitive checks and eliminating unnecessary manual work.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools that can meaningfully improve testing efficiency and productivity.
  • Contribute a product-focused perspective by identifying opportunities to improve the overall user experience and product quality.

title: Määräaikainen valmistavan opetuksen päätoiminen tuntiopettaja
description:
Määräaikainen valmistavan opetuksen päätoiminen tuntiopettaja, valmistava opetus

Raaseporin kaupunki hakee päätoimista tuntiopettajaa määräaikaiseen virkasuhteeseen ajalle 19.10.2026 - 19.10.2027. Määräaikaisuuden perusteena on virkatehtävien tilapäinen tarve (oppilasmäärään perustuva valmistavan opetuksen ryhmä).
Tehtävän sijoituspaikka on suomenkielisen perusopetuksen yläkoulun luokilla 7-9 Karjaan yhteiskoulussa. Karjaan yhteiskoulu on tunnelmallinen yläkoulu Karjaan keskustassa Tove Janssonin taideteoksin.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on peruskoulun luokanopettajan, aineenopettajan, erityisopettajan tai erityisluokanopettajan kelpoisuus opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen (986/1998) mukaisesti. Virkaan valittavalta edellytetään erinomaista suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Määräaikaisissa tehtävissä kelpoisuusvaatimukset täyttävien ja soveltuvien hakijoiden puuttuessa myös vaadittavaa muodollista kelpoisuutta vailla olevat hakijat voidaan ottaa huomioon.

Valittavalta henkilöltä edellytämme erinomaisia yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja, monipuolista ja oppilaslähtöistä pedagogista osaamista sekä hyviä valmiuksia osallistua koulun toimintaan. Eduksi katsotaan aikaisempi kokemus perusopetukseen valmistavan opetuksen tehtävistä sekä suomi toisena kielenä (S2) -pedagogiikan tuntemus.

Palkkaus ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunta-alan opetushenkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen (OVTES) mukaan. Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.

Tutkinto- ja työtodistukset pyydetään esittämään mahdollisen työhaastattelun yhteydessä. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote sekä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan.

Haastatteluja voidaan alkaa toteuttaa jo hakuaikana, ja määräaikainen virkatehtävä voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Vietnamese speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Vietnamese speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Vietnamese, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Vietnamese and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Vietnamese experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Vietnamese, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Vietnamese speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Cloud Hardware Development Engineer I, Annapurna Labs, Early Career - 2027
description:
At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you.

What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

About the team
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon at Amazon - including Graviton (our server processors), Trainium and Inferentia (our machine learning training and inference accelerators), and the Nitro system that powers modern EC2. We own the full stack, from silicon through the software that makes it work (compilers, runtimes, drivers, and the frameworks that let customers run workloads on our hardware).

Annapurna has hardware teams across a range of systems and disciplines, and we work to place you on a technical team aligned with your interests and strengths. Example teams and focus areas include:

- Board and system design for ML servers and accelerator platforms
- Firmware and low-level software development (BMC, device firmware)
- Hardware bring-up, validation, and post-silicon testing
- High-speed interconnect and signal integrity
- System-level integration across compute, networking, and storage
Once you join, we partner with you and our hiring managers to match you to a team where your background and interests fit best, so your project is something you're genuinely excited to work on.

As a Cloud HDE I, you'll contribute to real hardware development work, which may include:

- Supporting the design, bring-up, and validation of hardware systems and subsystems
- Developing firmware or low-level software that interfaces directly with hardware
- Debugging hardware-software integration issues in the lab using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other bench equipment
- Writing and running tests to validate hardware functionality, performance, and reliability
- Collaborating with ASIC, systems, and software teams to take hardware from design through deployment
- Documenting your work and presenting findings to the team

title: Senior QA Manual (AI Product)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Manual (AI Product) based in Greece.

This role focuses on ensuring the quality and stability of an AI-powered product within a fast-moving release environment. You will plan testing activities, create comprehensive test documentation, and validate product changes across mobile, web, and backend layers. The position combines hands-on manual testing with a strong focus on improving QA efficiency through automation of repetitive checks and practical AI tooling. You will work closely with engineering and product teams to identify defects early and communicate issues clearly enough for rapid resolution. With production releases occurring several times a week, your testing will have a direct impact on product reliability and user experience. This is an opportunity for a structured, product-minded QA professional to help continuously improve both the product and its testing processes.

Accountabilities:

  • Plan testing scope, timelines, scenarios, and coverage for product releases.
  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test cases, checklists, and test documentation.
  • Test and stabilize patches within a rapid release cycle, supporting production deployments several times per week.
  • Perform hands-on testing across mobile, web, and backend components.
  • Identify defects quickly, investigate issues, and document them clearly so engineering teams can act without unnecessary follow-up.
  • Work with client-server applications and assess how changes affect different parts of the product.
  • Support QA activities throughout the Agile development and release lifecycle rather than treating testing solely as a final quality gate.
  • Continuously improve QA processes by standardizing repetitive checks and eliminating unnecessary manual work.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools that can meaningfully improve testing efficiency and productivity.
  • Contribute a product-focused perspective by identifying opportunities to improve the overall user experience and product quality.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience in manual QA testing across mobile, web, and backend environments.
    • Hands-on experience creating and executing checklists, test cases, test scenarios, and structured QA documentation.
    • Solid understanding of client-server architecture and how QA integrates into Agile development and release cycles.
    • Practical experience with Jira, Confluence, TestRail or Allure TestOps, MS SQL Server, Fiddler, and Postman.
    • Demonstrated use of AI tools as part of an everyday QA workflow.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to identify issues efficiently and communicate them clearly.
    • Structured, detail-oriented, and results-focused approach to testing.
    • Product-oriented mindset, with an interest in understanding how features work and improving the overall product rather than simply validating individual tickets.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with frequent releases and changing priorities.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with engineering and cross-functional teams.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote, full-time work opportunity.
      • Compensation level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days per year for personal, household, or recovery needs.

      • Internal gamified recognition program with rewards such as company merchandise, team-building activities, and massage certificates.
      • Opportunity to work with AI tools and modern QA practices in a high-frequency release environment.
      • International and remote-first working environment.

title: Senior Engineer - Software Development
description:
Job Description

As a Senior Engineer – Software Development you will take ownership of the React development and delivery of an existing production system operating at a critical client site, while maintaining working proficiency across the full technology stack. The role is responsible for maintaining and extending the application's state architecture in line with established development patterns, ensuring the user interface remains performant, responsive, and accessible under real client usage conditions, and diagnosing as well as resolving frontend performance issues in a live, mission-critical environment. As a secondary responsibility, the Senior Engineer will also contribute to the API layer when frontend priorities permit, supporting seamless integration across the application stack and overall system reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain full-stack solutions, with primary ownership of the React frontend, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and maintainable application features.

  • Embed accessibility as a core development principle by ensuring all user interface enhancements comply with WCAG standards and accessibility best practices from design through implementation.
  • Apply rigorous change management and quality assurance practices to all releases, recognizing the critical nature of the live production environment and minimizing operational risk.
  • Collaborate closely with backend services and APIs, consuming, transforming, and integrating data effectively to deliver seamless and intuitive frontend experiences.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with React, including a strong understanding of state management and architecture within complex, enterprise-scale applications, leveraging component state, Hooks, Context API, and modern React patterns.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, with the ability to develop and maintain scalable, type-safe, and maintainable frontend applications.
  • Proven experience identifying, analyzing, and optimizing frontend performance issues in production environments, ensuring responsive and reliable user experiences.
  • Strong knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG), with practical experience implementing accessible design and development practices rather than solely conducting compliance audits.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly understand, maintain, and enhance existing codebases, including large and unfamiliar applications with established development patterns.
  • Working knowledge of Java development, with the capability to contribute to backend services, APIs, and integrations when required to support full-stack delivery.

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working within an established, live production system rather than greenfield development
  • Comfortable following existing architectural patterns and conventions rather than introducing new ones

title: Anestesiahoitaja, Hyvinkää
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt Terveystaloon anestesiasairaanhoitajaa Hyvinkäälle.

Mitä työ anestesiasairaanhoitajana Hyvinkäällä pitää sisällään?

Terveystalon sairaanhoitajat ovat hoitotyön asiantuntijoita, joiden tehtävänä on terveyden edistäminen ja ylläpitäminen sekä sairauksien ehkäiseminen ja hoitaminen. Sairaanhoitajat ovat yksi Terveystalon suurimmista ammattiryhmistä, ja kollegojasi työskentelee niin yksityisillä lääkäriasemillamme kuin julkisen puolen kumppanuuksissamme. Sairaanhoitajamme pitävät Terveystalossa esimerkiksi itsenäistä vastaanottoa tai työskentelevät sairaaloidemme leikkaussaleissa tai digihoitajana digitaalisissa palveluissa. Sairaanhoitajana Terveystalossa voit kartuttaa erityisosaamista esimerkiksi astma-, diabetes-, muisti- ja haavahoitajana tai psykiatrisena sairaanhoitajana.

Terveystalo Hyvinkäällä anestesiasairaanhoitaja työskentelee leikkausyksikössä, jossa toteutetaan päiväkirurgisia toimenpiteitä eri erikoisaloilta. Erikoisaloina meillä Hyvinkäällä toimivat muun muassa korva-nenä-kurkkutaudit, käsikirurgia ja yleiskirurgia. Leikkauspotilaistamme suurin osa ovat lapsipotilaita. Anestesiasairaanhoitajana osallistut salityöhön sekä tarvittaessa myös heräämötyöskentelyyn. Yksikkömme toiminnassa korostuu tiivis yhteistyö koko leikkaussalitiimin kesken.

Työsuhde on tehtävässä tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavaa ja keikkatyösopimus tehdään 2 vuodeksi. Työvuorot voidaan sopia toiveidesi mukaan jo aiemmin tai ne voivat tulla lyhyelläkin varoitusajalla.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.
- Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä. - Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä. - Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun. - Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme. - Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen. Terveystalossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia riippumatta sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä tai kansallisesta taustasta, kansalaisuudesta, kielestä, uskonnosta, vakaumuksesta, mielipiteestä, vammasta, terveydentilasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai muusta ominaisuudesta.
Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Tehtävän pätevyysvaatimuksena ovat
- sairaanhoitajan tutkinto (anestesiasairaanhoitaja) - kokemus sekä lasten että aikuisten anestesioista (erityisesti lasten anestesiaosaaminen)
Katsomme eduksi, jos sinulla on
- itsenäinen työote on yhtä tärkeää kuin kyky toimia tiimissä - hyvä paineensietokyky muuttuvissa tilanteissa - mahdollisuus tarttua keikkapyyntöihin nopealla ja joustavalla aikataululla
Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jätä yhteystietosi hakulomakkeen kautta viimeistään 11.10.2026. Meille jokainen hakija on tärkeä. Siksi meillä jokaisen hakemuksen lukee aina ihminen. Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Mahdollisiin kysymyksiin vastaa mielellään sairaanhoitajien palveluvastaava Sari Lehtonen (sari.lehtonen@terveystalo.com).

title: Junior data engineer - Italia
description:
Your mission

Bring a tender from the source portal into Cato: scraping, parsing, merging, enrichment. You'll start by owning a handful of sources end to end - the scraper, the job behind it, and the data that comes out - and take on more as you go. Not tickets handed to you: sources you're responsible for.

What you'll actually do

Build and maintain scrapers for national tender portals, where reading the source in its original language is part of the job. Keep them alive: portals change their HTML, move endpoints, break pagination, throttle you. You find out before the customer does. Turn messy sources into clean records: broken HTML, inconsistent XML, APIs that lie about their own schema. Write and maintain orchestrator flows: retries, backfills, alerting, and a clear answer to "Did today's run actually land?" Work on merge and dedup - the same tender arrives three times, in three shapes, and only one version can reach the customer. Ship AI enrichment steps: batch LLM extraction of requirements, embeddings, OCR on attachments. Guard data quality with tests and checks that fail loudly before a customer finds the gap.

Ideal profile

Python that holds up: typed, tested, and readable six months later. You've scraped something real: HTTP, HTML and XML parsing, pagination, sessions, rate limits - and you know why a scraper that worked yesterday is broken this morning. SQL you're comfortable in: joins, aggregations, window functions. You'll read from the database every day; tuning and running it isn't your job. Builder by default: you see a manual process and your first instinct is to automate it. Comfortable with messy sources: broken HTML, inconsistent XML, PDFs that were scans of scans. You close your own loop: you check that what you shipped actually ran, before someone else has to ask. Experience 1-2 years writing Python in production: scrapers, ETL scripts, automation - anything that had to run unattended and be fixed when it didn't. Exposure to an orchestrator (Prefect, Airflow, Dagster) is a plus, not a requirement: you'll learn ours properly. Exposure to LLM-based extraction is welcome; curiosity about it is mandatory.

What you won't find here

No micromanagement: we trust you to own your part of the stack. No "standard" 9-to-5 mentality: we care about outcomes and we are looking for people who are willing to go the extra mile. No "we've always done it this way" excuses: we're here to disrupt, not to follow old patterns.

Our Tech Stack

Data & Infra: Python, PostgreSQL, Prefect, AWS AI: batch LLM extraction, embeddings, OCR

Compensation

RAL €35,000 - €45,000 equity, depending on profile.

You will review health records to identify opportunities to clarify diagnoses, procedures, severity, outcomes, and quality indicators. Working closely with physicians, healthcare professionals, and coding teams, you will help ensure documentation accurately reflects the care provided. title: Senior Network Designer
description:

As a Senior Network Designer, you are responsible for designing secure, resilient, and scalable network, security, and application delivery solutions across ING's hybrid infrastructure.
