You translate business and technical requirements into target-state architectures, High-Level Designs, Low-Level Designs, reusable service patterns, and secure connectivity solutions.


You work effectively with engineers, architects, service consumers, security specialists, and management. You combine clear communication with strong conceptual thinking and a structured approach to solution design. You are thorough, detail-oriented, and committed to producing accurate, maintainable, and high-quality architecture documentation.

We are looking for you if you have:

  • Extensive experience designing enterprise network, security, and application delivery solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of F5 BIG-IP LTM and GTM/DNS technologies and application delivery architectures.
  • Experience designing F5 services, including virtual servers, pools, health monitors, traffic steering, persistence, SSL/TLS, and high-availability solutions.
  • Experience with F5 AS3 and declarative application onboarding models.
  • Knowledge of certificate management, PKI integration, and SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle requirements.
  • Experience designing Palo Alto firewall rulebases, security policies, NAT configurations, security zones, and traffic flows.
  • Experience designing routing solutions, router ACL changes, network segmentation, VPN connectivity, and leased-line services.
  • Strong knowledge of DNS, Infoblox DDI/IPAM, traffic management, resilience, and disaster recovery principles.
  • Experience working in complex hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • The ability to translate business, security, and technical requirements into scalable and supportable designs.
  • A strong focus on security, availability, resilience, and operational stability.
  • The ability to work in accordance with ING standards, architecture principles, controls, and governance processes.
  • Clear communication skills and experience working in an Agile environment.

You'll get extra points for:

  • Experience contributing to F5 certificate automation and automated certificate lifecycle management.
  • Experience designing integrations between F5 platforms, enterprise PKI services, certificate management tooling, and automation platforms.
  • Experience defining reusable AS3 templates and standardized application onboarding models.
  • Experience supporting cloud migration programmes.
  • Experience contributing to Lifecycle Management (LCM) and technology refresh projects.
  • Experience designing Global Server Load Balancing, high-availability, and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Experience developing reusable service patterns, design standards, and reference architectures.

Your responsibilities:

  • Design secure, resilient, and scalable network, security, DNS, connectivity, and application delivery solutions across ING's hybrid infrastructure.
  • Act as design authority for F5 BIG-IP LTM and GTM/DNS platforms and related application delivery services.
  • Produce and maintain High-Level Designs, Low-Level Designs, reference architectures, service blueprints, and reusable design patterns.
  • Design F5 LTM services, including virtual servers, pools, pool members, health monitors, SSL/TLS profiles, traffic steering, load-balancing methods, persistence mechanisms, and Source NAT.
  • Design F5 GTM/DNS solutions, including Global Server Load Balancing, wide IPs, pools, health monitoring, geographic traffic distribution, failover, and disaster recovery architectures.
  • Define AS3-based onboarding models, reusable declarations, and standardized service templates for automated application delivery.
  • Contribute to F5 certificate automation by defining design requirements, onboarding standards, integration patterns, and certificate lifecycle processes.
  • Design scalable approaches for certificate issuance, deployment, renewal, replacement, revocation, and retirement on F5 application delivery platforms.
  • Define integration requirements between F5 platforms, AS3 services, enterprise PKI, certificate management services, and automation tooling.
  • Ensure certificate automation designs support secure key handling, certificate traceability, expiry monitoring, controlled renewal, and operational resilience.
  • Design Palo Alto firewall solutions, including security rulebases, security policies, NAT configurations, security zones, segmentation, and application traffic flows.
  • Review application connectivity requirements and translate them into appropriate Palo Alto rulebase and NAT design changes.
  • Design router ACL changes supporting network segmentation, controlled connectivity, infrastructure protection, and application onboarding.
  • Define end-to-end traffic flows incorporating firewall policies, router ACLs, routing controls, DNS services, load balancing, and security boundaries.
  • Design site-to-site VPN solutions, leased-line connectivity, partner integrations, inter-datacenter communication, and hybrid infrastructure connectivity.
  • Define routing changes, route filtering requirements, failover behaviour, network paths, and connectivity models for new business and infrastructure services.
  • Assess the impact of firewall rulebase, NAT, router ACL, routing, VPN, DNS, and application delivery changes on security, availability, and resilience.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into approved network, security, DNS, certificate management, and application delivery designs.
  • Support IPC migrations, internal cloud migrations, infrastructure transformations, and application onboarding through solution design and architecture governance.
  • Contribute to Lifecycle Management projects by assessing design impacts and defining target-state solutions for platform upgrades and technology refreshes.
  • Review proposed solutions and ensure alignment with ING security standards, resilience requirements, risk controls, and architecture principles.
  • Maintain architecture repositories, design documentation, service standards, decision records, and audit-compliant evidence.
  • Ensure traceability between design deliverables, Azure DevOps epics and user stories, architecture decisions, and ServiceNow change records.
  • Provide architectural guidance during major incident reviews, root cause analysis, and structural service improvement activities.
  • Support Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities through architecture validation, design reviews, failover scenario assessments, and periodic Standby Duty participation to ensure resilience and recoverability objectives are met.
  • Provide architectural guidance during major incidents, troubleshooting activities, and service degradation scenarios to support rapid issue identification and resolution.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis by evaluating network, security, connectivity, and application delivery designs, identifying structural improvements to enhance platform resilience, availability, and operational stability.

Your education and background:

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional and intellectual ability in Information Technology.
  • Extensive experience in network architecture, network security, connectivity, and application delivery design.
  • Strong knowledge of F5 BIG-IP LTM, F5 GTM/DNS, AS3, SSL/TLS, and application delivery technologies.

Technical Environment

F5 BIG-IP LTM, F5 BIG-IP GTM/DNS, F5 AS3, GSLB, Virtual Servers, Pools, Health Monitors, SSL/TLS Profiles, Traffic Management, Load Balancing, Persistence, iRules, PKI Integration, Digital Certificates, Certificate Lifecycle Management, F5 Certificate Automation, Palo Alto Networks, Panorama, Palo Alto Security Policies, Rulebase Design, NAT Design, Security Zoning, Router ACL Design, Routing and Switching, Network Segmentation, Site-to-Site VPN, Leased-Line Connectivity, Infoblox DDI/IPAM, DNS, Hybrid Infrastructure Connectivity, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Infrastructure as Code, High Availability, Disaster Recovery, and Enterprise Network Security Architecture.

title: Senior Director Commercial
description:
Why Mindspace?

At Mindspace, we're redefining what the workplace can be.

Founded in 2014, Mindspace has grown into one of the world's leading premium flexible workspace providers, operating nearly 50 locations across Europe, the US, and Israel. More than beautifully designed workspaces, we are a hospitality-driven company built around exceptional service, inspiring environments, and vibrant communities.

Our success has been built by ambitious people who care deeply about creating remarkable customer experiences, developing outstanding teams, and constantly raising the bar. As we continue to grow profitably and expand our global footprint, we're looking for leaders who want to shape the future of work- not simply manage it.

Based in Tel Aviv, our global headquarters and one of Mindspace's largest and most strategic markets, this role offers a unique opportunity to work alongside our executive leadership team and influence both the Israeli business and the company's global direction.

Why This Role?

This is Mindspace’s most senior global marketing leadership role, with full ownership of the company’s global Marketing function. As Senior Director Commercial, you will lead the Marketing organization globally and serve as the company’s senior-most marketing leader, reporting directly to the COO.

The role sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Digital and Member Experience, with Marketing at its core. You will own and strengthen the commercial engine that drives demand and revenue across our markets — from building a powerful global brand and generating high-quality leads, through enabling our sales teams with the right data, tools and processes, to improving conversion across the entire customer journey.

We’re looking for a true all-around marketing leader who can connect brand, PR, online and offline marketing, growth and performance into one strong commercial strategy, while leading and developing the global Marketing team.

You will also play a key role in shaping our revenue operations, digital customer journey and member experience, working closely with Sales, Operations, Product and our regional leadership teams to build a scalable commercial model across markets.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Lead Mindspace’s global Marketing function and organization, with full ownership of the company’s marketing strategy, team and performance across brand, PR, growth & performance, digital, field marketing and offline channels.
  • Drive high-quality lead generation and full-funnel performance, from acquisition and lead qualification through tour booking, conversion, deal close, renewals and retention.
  • Build and strengthen the commercial engine behind our sales organization, including data, dashboards, reporting, lead management, sales enablement materials and processes that help our teams perform better in the field.
  • Strengthen Mindspace’s key acquisition channels, including SEM, SEO, brokers, partnerships and other digital and offline lead-generation channels.
  • Use data, customer insights, CRM and funnel metrics to improve conversion, attribution, commercial performance and ROI.
  • Partner closely with Sales and regional leaders to continuously improve how we generate leads, manage opportunities, conduct tours and convert prospects into customers.
  • Own and improve the digital commercial journey, ensuring our website, app and other digital tools strengthen the Mindspace brand while driving engagement, conversion and commerce.
  • Help shape the member experience across our physical locations, connecting the brand promise with the offline customer journey, community experience, events and on-site engagement.
  • Develop additional revenue opportunities across products and services including meeting rooms, memberships, events and other on-demand offerings.
  • Partner with market GMs and regional teams to build a consistent and scalable commercial model while maintaining strong local execution.
  • Build, lead and develop Mindspace’s global Marketing organization, creating a high-performing multidisciplinary team and the right structure to support the company’s next stage of growth.
  • Support Mindspace’s continued growth through new market openings, expansion into new cities and other strategic growth initiatives.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant senior leadership experience in marketing and commercial growth.
  • A true all-around marketing leader with strong experience across brand, PR, online and offline marketing, growth/performance and go-to-market strategy.
  • A strong commercial mindset, with demonstrated impact on lead generation, customer acquisition, conversion, pipeline and revenue.
  • Experience working closely with Sales and building the tools, data, processes and insights that enable commercial teams to perform.
  • Strong analytical capabilities and experience using data, CRM, dashboards and funnel metrics to drive decisions and improve performance.
  • Experience owning or significantly influencing digital customer journeys, websites, apps or other conversion-focused digital products is a strong advantage.
  • Experience in customer/member experience and translating a brand into a strong physical and digital experience is an advantage.
  • Proven experience operating across multiple markets and working closely with country or regional leaders.
  • Experience building, leading and developing high-performing multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience across B2B and B2C environments is highly valuable.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment; hospitality, real estate, flexible workspace, lifestyle or another multi-location customer-facing business is an advantage.
  • Excellent English and strong executive communication skills.
  • A hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution.

Who You Are

You are a commercial leader with marketing at your core. You understand how to build a powerful brand, but you also know that great marketing ultimately needs to generate demand, create high-quality leads and translate into revenue.

You naturally connect the dots between brand, growth, sales, data, technology and customer experience. You think about the entire commercial journey - from the first interaction with Mindspace online, through the sales process and tour, to the experience members have once they enter our spaces.

You think globally, act quickly and use data to make decisions. You’re equally comfortable shaping strategy with senior leadership, diving into funnel performance with Sales, challenging a digital customer journey, and getting close to execution when needed.

title: Lähihoitaja, Mäntsälän kotihoito, yli 12kk
description:
Mäntsälän kotihoidossa tarjolla lähihoitajan sijaisuus

Työ kotihoidossa on asiakkaan luona tapahtuvaa hoitotyötä, jossa lähihoitajan tehtävät koostuvat omien vastuuasiakkaiden kokonaisvaltaisesta hoitotyöstä, hoidon suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta arviointiin saakka. Kotihoidossa työpäivät ovat erilaisia, työssä saat mahdollisen liikkua jalan, pyörällä tai autolla. Työtehtävissä tapaat erilaisia ihmisiä erilaisissa kodeissa ja työssäsi saat olla luova ja monipuolisesti osaamistasi!

Mäntsälän kotihoito jakautuu kolmeen alueelliseen tiimiin, joissa työskentelee sairaanhoitajia ja lähihoitajia. Olemme huumorintajuinen porukka ja huolehdimme uuden työntekijän hyvästä perehdyttämisestä. Me haluamme, että viihdyt meillä ja turvaat meidän muiden kanssa ikäihmisten arjen.

Teemme asiakaskäynnit pääsääntöisesti itsenäisesti, mutta saatavilla on aina tiimin tuki. Teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä myös muiden alueiden kotihoidon ja kotiutumisen ja arvioinnin tuen tiimien kanssa. Tarpeen mukaan autamme toinen toistamme yli aluerajojen. Työtä tehdään 2-vuorotyössä viikon jokaisena päivänä.

Tehtävään edellytettävä kelpoisuus

- Kelpoisuusehtona on sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteen ammatillinen tutkinto.

Hakijalta odotamme ja toivomme

- Edellytämme kokemusta kotihoidossa työskentelystä.
- Kotihoidossa työskentelyyn tarvitset kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon, oman työn suunnittelu- ja organisointikykyä, muutoskyvykkyyttä ja hyviä tiimityötaitoja. Arvostamme innostuneisuutta oman osaamisen ja työyhteisön kehittämiseen.
- Toivomme, että sinulla on ammatillista taitoa vastata asiakkaan kokonaisvaltaiseen hoidon tarpeeseen.
- Arvostamme kokemusta ikäihmisten parissa työskentelystä sekä RAI-toimintakykymittarin käytöstä.
- Edellytämme lisäksi voimassa olevia lääkelupia, jotka voi suorittaa myös heti palvelussuhteen alkaessa.
- Työn hoitamiseksi ajokortti ja oman auton käyttö työtehtävissä on välttämätöntä.
- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja innostuneisuutta omien vastuuasiakkaiden asioiden aktiiviseen hoitamiseen. Kokemus aiemmin vastuuhoitajana toimimisesta on etu.

Lisätiedot tehtävästä antaa kotihoidon esihenkilö Pia Mehtonen, puh. 050 497 1700, pia.mehtonen@keusote.fi.

title: Traditional Chinese Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Traditional Chinese speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Traditional Chinese speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Traditional Chinese, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Traditional Chinese and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Traditional Chinese experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Traditional Chinese, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Traditional Chinese speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

title: LVN CDP DPNF
description:
Position Description:

A licensed professional nurse under the supervision of a Registered Nurse who provides nursing care and services to residents in a long-term care setting.

General Duties and Responsibilities:

GENERAL

  1. Provides nursing care as prescribed by the physician/health care professional in accordance with the legal scope of practice, any Board of Licensing restrictions, and within established standards of care, policies, and procedures
  2. Administers professional services and provides care consistent with allowing residents to attain or maintain his or her highest practicable physical, mental, and emotional well-being. Provides clinical data and observations to contribute to the nursing plan of care

CLINICAL

  1. Admits, transfers, and discharges residents in accordance with policy and procedure.
  2. Orient new residents/families as necessary.
  3. Gives/receives nursing reports upon beginning and ending of assigned shift. Reviews daily patient report and assignments with Nursing Assistants upon the beginning of an assigned shift.
  4. Assures that the unit area is maintained in a clean and safe manner for resident comfort and convenience.
  5. Conducts daily resident rounds to observe the resident's physical and emotional status.
  6. Collects clinical data and reports significant clinical findings according to policy.
  7. Performs manual and technical skills according to the scope of practice under the direction of a Registered Nurse.
  8. Records care information accurately, in a timely manner, and concisely. Completes all required documentation, including resident observations, interventions, and patient response(s) in the medical record in accordance with policy.
  9. Assists in developing, reviewing, revising, and updating resident Plans of Care as indicated.
  10. Contributes to the evaluation of the patient's progress towards specific goals and the adjustment of the nursing plan of care as necessary.
  11. Receives and transcribes orders accurately from attending/alternate physician.
  12. Assists in making rounds with the attending physician, as necessary.
  13. Prepares/administers medications as ordered by the physician and within the legal scope of practice.
  14. Completes medical treatments as indicated and ordered by the physician.
  15. Evaluates response and reports adverse reactions to medication or treatments in accordance with the policy.
  16. Ensures that narcotic and controlled drugs are secure, inventory counts are accurate, and narcotic register documentation is timely and accurate
  17. Orders prescribed medications, supplies, and equipment as established by the facility's policies and procedures.
  18. Requests and arranges for diagnostic and therapeutic services as ordered by the physician.
  19. Notifies the attending/alternate physician, as well as the resident's legal guardian/representative, when the resident becomes critically ill, injured, etc., or has a significant change in condition as outlined within established policies.
  20. Notifies the attending/alternate physician of resident incidents/unusual occurrences. Completes Accident/Incident Report forms as indicated and documents relevant information in the resident's medical record as outlined in established policies and procedures. Initiate investigation of accidents and unusual occurrences.
  21. Informs RN Supervisor or RN in charge of the facility of significant changes in resident condition, unusual occurrences, incidents, or accidents as indicated and per facility policy and procedure.
  22. Attend various facility meetings (care conferences, stand-up meetings, staff meetings, Medicare meetings, discharge plan meetings, etc.) as required.
  23. Reports allegations of abuse or unusual occurrences per State and Federal Regulations and facility policy. Assists with gathering information relevant to the event.
  24. Initiates emergency procedures (including basic CPR) and provides emergency patient treatments.
  25. Participates in the facility's infection control program for monitoring communicable and/or infectious disease among residents and staff.
  26. Participates in procedures for reporting hazardous conditions or equipment.
  27. Assists in the orientation of newly assigned personnel as requested.
  28. Assumes Charge responsibility following the orientation period as requested.
  29. Performs other position-related duties as assigned.
  30. Supervise CNAs

SUPERVISION

  1. Make resident rounds to ensure appropriate care is being rendered, identifying and making corrections as necessary.
  2. Meet with nursing personnel to assist in identifying and correcting problem areas and/or the improvement of resident care.
  3. Assist the Charge Nurse in revision and distribution of nursing assignments as needed.
  4. Assist in the supervision and direction of nursing personnel.
  5. Participate in disciplinary action and evaluation of nursing personnel.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES

  1. Participate in the facility's quality assurance (QA) program as requested or needed. Assist in correcting findings and deficiencies from the Department of Health Services, Consultants, and the Quality Assurance Team as directed by the Director of Nursing
  2. Ensures the protection of health information as required by the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).
  3. Participates in the facility's Infection Control Program for monitoring communicable and/or infectious disease among residents and staff.
  4. Participate in procedures for reporting hazardous conditions or equipment.
  5. Orient new staff members upon request.
  6. Attend various facility meetings (care conferences, stand-up meetings, staff meetings, Medicare meetings, discharge plan meetings, etc.) as required.
  7. Attends in-services and educational classes to maintain nursing skills competency and current knowledge of the standard of care and effective practices.
  8. Assumes Charge responsibility following the orientation period as requested.
  9. Performs other position-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing or an approved LVN program
  • Current nursing licensure in good standing with the State licensing board
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to provide quality patient care under applicable standards, policies, and procedures
  • Ability to identify and report problems, use initiative, and good judgment to reach quality decisions
  • Comprehensive knowledge of applicable nursing principles and practices to ensure quality of care standards for residents are met
  • Possess the willingness to work with professional and non-professional personnel. Proficiency in the English language, including the ability to speak, read, write, and comprehend the language with minimal to no difficulty
  • Valid BLS certification

title: Senior Program Officer
description: At the World Bank Group (WBG) , you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org The WBG Infrastructure Vertical provides public and private solutions to operational teams and clients across the WBG to produce scalable impact. Its mandate is to deliver knowledge for impact to support the WBG to achieve its goals in support of our mission. The Infrastructure VPU’s objectives in driving outcomes include replicating and scaling effective solutions, enhancing thought leadership and innovation, and delivering timely knowledge to client teams. For more information: https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/infrastructure The Metals and Minerals Policy and Regulation unit is embedded within the INF VPU’s Metals and Minerals Department of the World Bank Group. This global unit of technical experts is responsible for the design and implementation of World Bank operations and knowledge activities in mining at both global and country levels. The Extractives Global Programmatic Support (EGPS) Multi Donor Trust Fund helps low-and middle-income countries fully benefit from their mineral resources and leverage mining to support new industries, create jobs, and build infrastructure. Currently in its third phase (EGPS 3), the program focuses on four priority components: Climate Smart Mining (CSM), the Resilient and Inclusive Supply chain Enhancement (RISE) Partnership, Artisanal and Small Scale Mining (ASM) and Transparency in Extractive Industries. The program is inherently donor facing and partnership driven, with strong and expanding engagement with development partners, including a growing number of European bilateral donors and the European Union. EGPS creates an ecosystem of partnerships, including through collaboration with the G7, G20, Multilateral Development Banks, industry, academia, civil society and other international organizations. The Senior Program Officer is a core member of the EGPS Program Management Team and works with a high degree of autonomy under the guidance of the EGPS Program Manager and the strategic oversight of the KIMIS Manager. The position serves as a coordinating focal point across all EGPS-3 windows and directly supports the EGPS Program Manager, ensuring continuity of leadership, decision-making, and strategic direction across the program. Duties and accountabilities A. Program-Wide Coordination and Program Manager Support • Serve as the coordinating focal point across all EGPS-3 windows working in close collaboration with the EGPS Program Manager and ensuring coherent, cross-window program direction and delivery. • Coordinate regularly with individual window managers to align priorities, track cross-cutting risks and dependencies, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure consistent reporting and messaging across windows. • Deputize for the EGPS Program Manager as needed on program-wide strategic, coordination, and management matters, ensuring business continuity in the Program Manager's absence. • Support the roll-out and implementation of EGPS-3 annual work plans across all windows, including coordinating inputs, monitoring progress against milestones, and flagging implementation risks to the Program Manager. • Support the EGPS knowledge agenda, including coordinating the pipeline of cross-window analytical and knowledge products, ensuring alignment with EGPS strategic priorities and donor expectations. • Support EGPS-wide reporting and communication, including consolidation of program-level donor reports, annual reports, and communication materials that reflect the full EGPS-3 portfolio. B. Strategic Program Development and Delivery • Provide strategic leadership in the design, positioning, and delivery of EGPS 3 program with a focus on the RISE and RISE + Partnerships, ensuring coherence across regions, and partner initiatives. • Lead preparation and quality assurance of annual work programs, block allocations, and priority pipelines, coordinating closely with regional and operational teams. • Provide senior level guidance on grant proposals and activity concepts, including programmatic fit, results frameworks, fiduciary alignment, implementation readiness, and delivery risks. • Contribute to and shape flagship analytical, advisory, and knowledge products supported by EGPS. • Serve as a senior counterpart to Task Team Leaders (TTLs) and implementing units, advising on program design, delivery approaches, risk management, and contribution to EGPS development objectives. • Provide guidance to the EGPS Monitoring Evaluation and Communications teams as part of reporting to development partners and visibility efforts. • Ensure systematic mainstreaming of jobs, climate and resilience objectives, including Paris Alignment considerations, and other corporate targets in EGPS activities. C. Donor Relations and Resource Mobilization • Provide strategic advice to management on donor engagement, positioning, and resource mobilization strategy. • Engage directly with donors and partners to understand priorities, identify collaboration opportunities, and ensure alignment with EGPS objectives. • Lead preparation of high level donor briefings, concept notes, proposals, and presentation materials, including shaping narrative, value proposition, and results story. • Lead preparation of EGPS Partnership Council meetings, including agenda setting, coordination of team inputs, and quality assurance of documentation. • Coordinate contributions to EGPS technical working groups and partnership governance bodies, acting as a senior focal point to ensure follow through and responsiveness. D. Strategic Partnerships and External Engagement • Develop and implement partnerships and engagement frameworks with MDBs, international organizations, including G7 and G20, think tanks, and policy platforms relevant to sustainable mining and critical minerals value chains. • Take leading role in MDB coordination efforts/initiatives on behalf of EGPS, ensuring EGPS is well-represented and aligned in relevant multilateral development bank coordination mechanisms and joint initiatives • Represent the World Bank in high level external forums, steering committees, technical working groups, and policy dialogues; help shape coordinated institutional messaging and positioning. • Monitor and analyze global policy, geopolitical, and market developments relevant to mineral supply chains and advise management on strategic implications for EGPS and the World Bank. • Contribute to the World Bank’s institutional positioning and thought leadership in mining and mineral value chains, working closely with communications and external relations counterparts as needed. E. Corporate Contributions and Management Support • Prepare senior level briefs, talking points, presentations, and strategic notes for EGPS, M M, and Infrastructure management, including inputs for high level engagements. • Contribute to internal coordination across Knowledge Bank, regions, and corporate units to ensure cohesive delivery and effective stakeholder management. • Provide guidance, mentoring, and quality review support to junior team members and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and results oriented team culture.

title: Urdu Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Urdu speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Urdu speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Urdu, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Urdu and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Urdu experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Urdu, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Urdu speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Software Engineer - BrandX
description:
Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘BrandX’ team, which is part of the wider ‘Order Engineering’ group.

BrandX (Brand Experience) builds the tools restaurant brands and Olo's internal teams use to run their business on Olo. We own the Dashboard that brand operators log into every day, the internal Admin application, and the billing and invoicing systems that turn platform usage into invoices. We also own how brands sign in and manage their users, including SSO and two-factor authentication, and we are building Olo AI Assist, a natural-language assistant inside the Dashboard.

The team is seven engineers spread across the US and Europe, and you'd be our first hire in Northern Ireland. Because the team sits between brands, Finance, and the rest of Order Engineering, the work is varied. One week you might be shipping a new Dashboard settings page, the next you're tracing a billing discrepancy across our finance integrations or teaching Olo AI Assist a new skill so a brand can update hours across hundreds of stores just by asking. You'll pair with senior engineers, review and ship code most days, and use Claude Code as a normal part of how you work.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Learn the BrandX domain and technology stack, and get to know the brands, Finance partners, and Order Engineering teams we work with.

  • Own small-to-medium features end to end, from understanding the requirement to shipping it, with senior engineers available when you need them.

  • Write code that meets our standards, and participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer.

  • Build reliable and maintainable software, with test coverage that matches the risk of the change.

  • Contribute to the team’s delivery pipeline, including test coverage, CI, and deployment practices.

  • Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as your default way of building, and help the team push what these tools can do.

  • Troubleshoot and debug production issues, learning how our systems fit together along the way.

  • Participate in team ceremonies such as daily stand-ups and retrospectives, sharing updates and feedback.

  • Take part in learning activities, including game days and training sessions, to build familiarity with Olo’s tools and processes.

  • Join the on-call rotation, with responsibilities that grow as you learn the team’s systems.

What will set you up for success

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 1 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects.

  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET, and comfort reading code you didn't write.

  • Some experience building web UIs. We use React and TypeScript, but any modern framework is a fine starting point.

  • Comfortable with SQL and relational data. A lot of our work is understanding how data moves between systems.

  • You understand the difference between unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and when each one earns its place.

  • AI coding agents are your default way of working. You use tools like Claude Code daily, you can explain the fundamentals underneath what they generate, and you're excited about a team that expects you to push them further.

  • You ask questions early, write things down, and are comfortable working with colleagues in other time zones.

About Olo

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. title: Senior QA Manual (AI Product)
description:

This role focuses on ensuring the quality and stability of an AI-powered product within a fast-moving release environment. You will plan testing activities, create comprehensive test documentation, and validate product changes across mobile, web, and backend layers. The position combines hands-on manual testing with a strong focus on improving QA efficiency through automation of repetitive checks and practical AI tooling. You will work closely with engineering and product teams to identify defects early and communicate issues clearly enough for rapid resolution. With production releases occurring several times a week, your testing will have a direct impact on product reliability and user experience. This is an opportunity for a structured, product-minded QA professional to help continuously improve both the product and its testing processes.

Accountabilities:

  • Plan testing scope, timelines, scenarios, and coverage for product releases.
  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test cases, checklists, and test documentation.
  • Test and stabilize patches within a rapid release cycle, supporting production deployments several times per week.
  • Perform hands-on testing across mobile, web, and backend components.
  • Identify defects quickly, investigate issues, and document them clearly so engineering teams can act without unnecessary follow-up.
  • Work with client-server applications and assess how changes affect different parts of the product.
  • Support QA activities throughout the Agile development and release lifecycle rather than treating testing solely as a final quality gate.
  • Continuously improve QA processes by standardizing repetitive checks and eliminating unnecessary manual work.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools that can meaningfully improve testing efficiency and productivity.
  • Contribute a product-focused perspective by identifying opportunities to improve the overall user experience and product quality.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience in manual QA testing across mobile, web, and backend environments.
    • Hands-on experience creating and executing checklists, test cases, test scenarios, and structured QA documentation.
    • Solid understanding of client-server architecture and how QA integrates into Agile development and release cycles.
    • Practical experience with Jira, Confluence, TestRail or Allure TestOps, MS SQL Server, Fiddler, and Postman.
    • Demonstrated use of AI tools as part of an everyday QA workflow.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to identify issues efficiently and communicate them clearly.
    • Structured, detail-oriented, and results-focused approach to testing.
    • Product-oriented mindset, with an interest in understanding how features work and improving the overall product rather than simply validating individual tickets.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with frequent releases and changing priorities.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with engineering and cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Manager
description:
This vacancy is open to permanent and fixed-term BAE Systems employees only. While agency workers have access to relevant permanent opportunities, this role has been designated as an internal opportunity and therefore only permanent and fixed-term employees of BAE Systems are eligible to apply.

You’re expected to have completed 12 months in role prior to applying for an advertised vacancy and you should also discuss the internal opportunity with your line manager to ensure sustained business continuity and to further support your career development.

We know there may be exceptional individual circumstances that impact this, in the first instance please discuss this with your line manager.

If you don’t feel you can talk to your Line Manager, you can contact your HRBP.

PLEASE NOTE\: Should you be invited for interview; you acknowledge that the Recruitment team will contact you and your line manager regarding your application for this opportunity.

Senior Quality Assurance Manager

The Quality function within the Digital Intelligence business is keen to welcome an established Quality Assurance professional to take on this GG13 leadership role.

The role will see you lead the internal Quality Audit programme across Digital Intelligence to assure conformance with applicable Quality, IT Security and Business Continuity Management Standards, and manage and support external certification events, acting as primary point of contact with external Certification Body.

You will be required to manage process and product non-conformances, including the timely completion of containment, correction, root cause analysis and corrective action, and integrating and driving efficiency improvements into assurance activities across Digital Intelligence.

You will line manage a small team of 4 heads and support functional plans to address resource and operational challenges, and where applicable, incorporate into Integrated Business Plan (IBP). You will need to provide guidance, support, coaching and mentoring to individuals conducting Quality related roles (within own capability and skill base areas) which impact on Quality Assurance.

This role will provide you with the opportunity to develop your career within BAE Systems due to exposure gained across multiple business areas.

Your main responsibilities as Senior Quality Assurance Manager will involve\:

· Support activities relating to Certification, contractual and Regulatory requirements against ISO 9001, EN9100, ISO 27001 and ISO 22301

· Carry out activities associated with “Quality planning”, “Risk assessment” and “Risk / analysis activities

· Maintenance of Assurance Matrix to ensure appropriate assurance coverage across Digital Intelligence

· Responsible for leading the verification of all non-conformances

· Lead effective analysis of data, identifying themes and driving and leading corrective action management to deliver cross functional improvements

· Contribute to periodic Quality Management Reviews

· Deliver effective succession planning activities to enhance functional development and futureproof team to support Strategic Workforce Planning (SWP) activities

· Support the programme embedded Learning from Experience (LfE) teams and lead at LfE reviews

Your skills and qualifications\:

· Have extensive knowledge, application and training of Quality certification and regulatory standards (ISO 9001 essential, EN9100, ISO 27001, ISO 22301 desirable)

· Have extensive understanding of own discipline and end to end Quality Assurance process and a broad understanding of other Quality related disciplines

· Understanding of Lifecycle Management (LCM) process, Business Management Systems, Operational Framework and Operational Assurance process or equivalent governance best practice from industry

· Knowledge of and experience of product safety

· The ability to lead and influence teams when undertaking Continuous Improvement activities

· Export requirements knowledge (for example International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)) and support others within the team

Location\: Southern DI sites. Occasional travel to all DI sites will be required to support external audits (predominantly in the south). The role is not able to accommodate travel expenses for northern-based candidates at this time.

Grade\: GG13

Digital Intelligence

BAE Systems Digital Intelligence is home to 4,500 digital, cyber and intelligence experts. We work collaboratively across 10 countries to collect, connect and understand complex data, so that governments, nation states, armed forces and commercial businesses can unlock digital advantage in the most demanding environments.

Our Land business supports both maritime and land forces, manufacturing a broad range of conventional and naval munitions from 4.5-inch and 5-inch naval rounds to large-calibre artillery and insensitive munitions. With the launch of our ‘Next Generation Munitions Solution’ (NGMS), we are securing the UK’s future in the munitions industry. Backed by decades of expertise at sites including Glascoed, Washington, Radway Green, and Bishopton, we deliver the firepower armed forces need safely, reliably, and to the highest standards.

We are committed to supporting work life balance for all our employees and embrace a range of modern working practices, which aim to enhance flexibility for individuals whilst also enabling business performance. Flexibility provisions vary by role, but include; hybrid working arrangements, flexible working patterns and shift working.

There are endless opportunities to grow at BAE Systems, and we will build upon the diversity of your experience through supporting your movement across our organisation. Our mission is to support our colleagues reach their full potential and so you’ll always find something new that will continue to inspire and provide an exciting and varied career that continues to play a crucial role in creating a secure tomorrow for generations to come.

We believe when you bring together different people and different perspectives it inspires creativity and drives innovation. It helps us fulfil our purpose and it's integral to our culture. We want everyone to be heard and respected, allowing us all to develop in an inclusive workplace and thrive together. We also want to make sure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible. If you have a disability or health condition (for example dyslexia, autism, an anxiety disorder etc.) that may affect your performance in certain assessment types, please speak to your recruiter about potential reasonable adjustments.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified people, who are BAE Systems employees and have been in their current role for 12 months or longer.

Please be aware that many roles working for BAE Systems will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including your nationality, any previous nationalities you have held, and your place of birth may limit those roles you can perform for the organisation.

title: Exercise Experiment Planner
description:
Candidates must have an active Secret clearance and verify, before applying, that you meet the minimum requirements of the position.

Target salary range: $85k - $90k. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Position: Joint/Multinational Experiment Planner

Location: U.S. Army Joint Modernization Command, Fort Bliss, TX

Position Description: Serves as an experiment planner in the US Army Joint Modernization Command (JMC) G3 Plans Division. Responsible to the Chief of Plans and experiment-specific Lead Planner (Government) to assist in coordinating, scheduling and synchronizing all experiment related planning activities, experiment training support requirements, assessments, and operations. More specifically, the individual performs the following tasks as directed by the G3, Chief of Plans:

Assist the JMC Lead Planner in developing a comprehensive plan and strategy for the internal and external integration planning and coordination actions/activities required to support experiment planning. Provides sound, mature advice and recommendations to the Lead Planner for effective orchestration of events and activities to support experiment planning. Assists the Lead Planner with managing ongoing actions, status, prioritizing planning actions and provides comprehensive status briefs to division chief or G3 in the absence of the Lad Planner. Assists the Lead Planner with staffing, receipt, review, tracking and approval of all experiment related taskings, products and documents. Provide design and maintenance of various data collections and instrumentation networks.

Assists the Lead Planner with developing and managing and experiment support requirements, timelines to support experiment planning (as an example identify key events and dates, planning conferences and IPRs). In conjunction with the Lead Planner represents JMC at planning and resource meetings ensuring ranges, training and maneuver areas, simulation facilities are reserved and can adequately support experiment requirements.

In support of the Lead Planner, monitors progress of work and reports status works actions through to completion. Ensures event resourcing is coordinated and suspense’s are meet during the planning process; as an example, orders, annexes, range and ammunition forecasting, airspace, spectrum and other training support requirements with external agencies to resource training and test events. Provides analysis of all proposed systems for capability and its proper integration into the network architecture.

Specific knowledge, skills, and experience include:

  • Competence in executing the Army’s Military Decision Making Process (MDMP)
  • Experience in planning and executing large-scale combat operations, exercises, or experiments at brigade-level and above
  • Experience with planning large-scale, Live-Virtual-Constructive training experiments
  • Experience in planning and executing Joint/Multinational experiments or combat operations
  • Experience facilitating, briefing, and presenting analytical results (written or orally) to senior leadership (Army, other Service, and Joint)
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

Clearance: Current SECRET clearance

General requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Army Brigade or Division-level staff experience
  • Service as a maneuver Battalion or Brigade Operations Officer (S3) or Executive Officer (XO)

Desired: Master’s degree

  • Army Command and Staff College Graduate
  • Experience serving in Joint/Multinational operations
  • Service as a Battalion or Brigade Operations Officer (S3) or Executive Officer (XO)
  • Observer/Controller at U.S. Army Combat Training Center

Travel: Approximately 20% a year both CONUS and OCONUS

title: Senior QA Manual (AI Product)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Manual (AI Product) based in Austria.

This role focuses on ensuring the quality and stability of an AI-powered product within a fast-moving release environment. You will plan testing activities, create comprehensive test documentation, and validate product changes across mobile, web, and backend layers. The position combines hands-on manual testing with a strong focus on improving QA efficiency through automation of repetitive checks and practical AI tooling. You will work closely with engineering and product teams to identify defects early and communicate issues clearly enough for rapid resolution. With production releases occurring several times a week, your testing will have a direct impact on product reliability and user experience. This is an opportunity for a structured, product-minded QA professional to help continuously improve both the product and its testing processes.

Accountabilities:

  • Plan testing scope, timelines, scenarios, and coverage for product releases.
  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test cases, checklists, and test documentation.
  • Test and stabilize patches within a rapid release cycle, supporting production deployments several times per week.
  • Perform hands-on testing across mobile, web, and backend components.
  • Identify defects quickly, investigate issues, and document them clearly so engineering teams can act without unnecessary follow-up.
  • Work with client-server applications and assess how changes affect different parts of the product.
  • Support QA activities throughout the Agile development and release lifecycle rather than treating testing solely as a final quality gate.
  • Continuously improve QA processes by standardizing repetitive checks and eliminating unnecessary manual work.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools that can meaningfully improve testing efficiency and productivity.
  • Contribute a product-focused perspective by identifying opportunities to improve the overall user experience and product quality.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience in manual QA testing across mobile, web, and backend environments.
    • Hands-on experience creating and executing checklists, test cases, test scenarios, and structured QA documentation.
    • Solid understanding of client-server architecture and how QA integrates into Agile development and release cycles.
    • Practical experience with Jira, Confluence, TestRail or Allure TestOps, MS SQL Server, Fiddler, and Postman.
    • Demonstrated use of AI tools as part of an everyday QA workflow.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to identify issues efficiently and communicate them clearly.
    • Structured, detail-oriented, and results-focused approach to testing.
    • Product-oriented mindset, with an interest in understanding how features work and improving the overall product rather than simply validating individual tickets.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with frequent releases and changing priorities.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with engineering and cross-functional teams.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote, full-time work opportunity.
      • Compensation level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days per year for personal, household, or recovery needs.
      • Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations.
      • 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.
      • Corporate discounts for English-language lessons.
      • Health support, including up to $1,000 gross per year toward health insurance or eligible medical expenses when corporate medical insurance is not available.
      • Workplace equipment and support, including reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross once every three years for home office or coworking expenses where applicable.
      • Internal gamified recognition program with rewards such as company merchandise, team-building activities, and massage certificates.
      • Opportunity to work with AI tools and modern QA practices in a high-frequency release environment.
      • International and remote-first working environment.

title: Senior software engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer who is ready to take ownership of a growing engineering team. This is a hands‑on leadership role, combining software development with day‑to‑day technical leadership, mentoring and delivery management.

Initially you will remain an active contributor, designing and building software alongside the team while providing technical direction, coaching engineers and ensuring work is delivered to a high standard. As the engineering function grows, the role will naturally evolve towards greater people leadership and delivery ownership.

You will work closely with the CTO and product stakeholders to translate business priorities into high quality software, helping establish engineering processes, technical standards and a culture of continuous improvement.

Responsibilities Technical Leadership Lead the design and implementation of new platform capabilities. Maintain high standards of software quality, security and maintainability. Review architecture and technical designs. Drive improvements to engineering practices and development workflows. Champion automation, testing and modern software engineering practices. Support production issues and lead technical investigations where required. Team Leadership Provide day‑to‑day leadership for the engineering team. Mentor and coach software engineers through regular one‑to‑ones and code reviews. Support recruitment, onboarding and development of new engineers. Help build a collaborative, accountable and high‑performing engineering culture. Identify capability gaps and recommend hiring plans as the team grows. Delivery Break business objectives into achievable technical work. Plan and coordinate sprint activities. Monitor delivery progress and remove blockers. Work closely with Product and the Fractional CTO to ensure priorities are understood and delivered. Ensure engineering estimates and commitments remain realistic. Quality & Operations Ensure software is well tested before release. Promote observability, monitoring and operational excellence. Encourage continuous improvement through retrospectives and metrics. Help maintain secure development practices and compliance with company standards. Required Experience 7+ years of commercial software engineering experience. Previous experience leading or mentoring engineers. Strong experience building and maintaining production Saa S applications. Excellent understanding of software architecture and design patterns. Experience with cloud‑native application development. Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems and integrations. Comfortable balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery. Technical Skills

We recognise great engineers can learn new technologies quickly, however experience in several of the following would be advantageous:

. NET / C# Java Script or Type Script React SQL and relational databases REST APIs Cloud platforms (Azure preferred) CI/CD pipelines Git Docker and containerisation Automated testing Leadership Qualities You will: Lead by example. Be comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. Communicate clearly with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders. Coach rather than command. Care about delivering business outcomes, not simply writing code. Hold yourself and others accountable while maintaining a supportive environment. Take ownership of problems through to resolution. Success Measures

Within the first 12 months you will have:

Become the day‑to‑day technical leader for the engineering team. Improved engineering quality and consistency. Established effective development standards and ways of working. Reduced delivery bottlenecks. Helped grow a strong engineering culture. Built trust with product, leadership and engineering stakeholders.

Reports to: CTO

Direct reports: Software Engineers (as the team grows) #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Psykologi, opiskeluhuolto Hyvinkää
description:
Tervetuloa opiskeluhuollon psykologiksi Hyvinkäälle

Keusotessa työskentelee 47 opiskeluhuollon psykologia. Yksikköömme kuuluu myös 56 opiskeluhuollon kuraattoria. Esi- ja perusasteen tiimi on jaettu alueellisesti kahden esihenkilön vastuulle, toisen asteen tiimiä johdetaan omana kokonaisuutenaan. Avoinna oleva paikka sijoittuu perusopetuksen tiimiin Nurmijärvelle ja siihen kuuluvat Urheilupuiston, Harjulan ja Kivenpuiston koulut. Työskentelyalueita tarkastellaan vuosittain. title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Role Purpose :


As a Lead Data Engineer at Prevalent AI, you will lead the design and delivery of advanced data engineering projects for our clients. You will write code, review the team's code, and stay accountable for how the solution performs in production.

The work involves large data volumes, complex joins and transformations, and tight processing windows. Clients usually come to us when their pipelines are slow, expensive or difficult to change. Working out why, and then fixing it, is a large part of the role.

This role suits engineers who know Spark internals well enough to read the logs and explain what is going wrong, who ask the right questions about the data before they write code, and who can run a small team to a delivery date.


Key Accountabilities :

  • Lead the design and delivery of client data engineering projects, from understanding the requirement through to production.
  • Design pipelines that meet their SLA and continue to do so as data volumes grow.
  • Diagnose failures and performance problems in large distributed jobs using logs and metrics.
  • Set the data layout and storage strategy so jobs read only the data they need.
  • Build reusable, configuration-driven components that cut development effort across the team.
  • Review the team's code and agree the standards the team works to.
  • Work with client teams to pin down the requirement and understand the data before development starts.
  • Contribute to the platform work around delivery, including object storage, containerisation and CI/CD.
  • Mentor developers, and document design decisions, tuning approaches and operational runbooks.

Skills & Experience :


Must Have :


  • 10+ years in data engineering, with at least 5 years hands-on PySpark on large-volume workloads, and still writing code daily.
  • Deep understanding of Spark internals: execution model, stages and tasks, shuffle, partitioning, broadcast versus sort-merge joins, adaptive query execution, and memory and spill behaviour.
  • Experience tuning long-running jobs down to an SLA and handling data skew, with specific examples of how a job was diagnosed and what changed.
  • Hands-on experience with time-series data at scale: event-time semantics, sliding and tumbling windows, and as-of or point-in-time joins across billions of rows.
  • Strong Delta Lake or Iceberg experience, covering partitioning, compaction, sort keys, data pruning and versioning.
  • Able to read Spark logs, the Spark UI and the history server and work out why a job is slow or failing.
  • Experience running Spark on self-managed clusters, not only on managed platforms.
  • Strong Python, with experience building reusable, configuration-driven frameworks rather than one-off scripts.
  • Able to lead a small team through code reviews, mentoring and unblocking, and hold a delivery date.

Good to Have

  • Trade surveillance, capital markets or FX experience, and familiarity with trade, order and market data.
  • KDB/q exposure, or experience migrating off a vendor surveillance platform.
  • Experience moving Spark workloads to object storage such as MinIO or S3, and running Spark on Kubernetes.
  • CI/CD, automated testing and observability for data pipelines.
  • Exposure to regulatory or compliance-driven delivery in a banking environment.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Executive Director, Project Management – RWE & Phase IV Studies based in United States.

This executive leadership role oversees a global project management organization responsible for Real-World Evidence (RWE) and Phase IV study delivery. You will be accountable for operational performance, financial results, quality outcomes, and client satisfaction across a complex portfolio. The position combines P&L ownership, strategic resourcing, portfolio management, business growth, and organizational leadership. You will work closely with senior leaders across clinical operations, commercial, finance, quality, and other functions to drive enterprise objectives. A major focus will be building scalable delivery models, strengthening project management capabilities, and developing future leaders. The role offers the opportunity to shape a high-performing global organization supporting important clinical research programs.

  • Lead the operational, financial, and quality performance of a global RWE and Phase IV project management portfolio, ensuring alignment with long-term business objectives.

  • Develop and optimize resourcing models and budgets for RWE and Phase IV programs, partnering with Proposals, Commercial, and Finance leadership on pricing, bids, delivery strategies, and margin optimization.
  • Support business development activities, including bid defenses, portfolio planning, strategic accounts, competitive positioning, and initiatives designed to increase growth and win rates.
  • Build and develop a high-performing project management leadership team through talent development, succession planning, organizational effectiveness, and leadership readiness.
  • Foster strong financial and commercial accountability across project management teams, encouraging effective budget management, forecasting, and delivery excellence.
  • Embed risk management practices and implement effective project tools, templates, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement processes.
  • Promote a strong client-focused culture centered on satisfaction, repeat business, portfolio expansion, and consistent delivery quality.
  • Identify and lead departmental and enterprise-wide initiatives while partnering with senior cross-functional leaders to improve end-to-end business performance.
  • Drive strategic planning and ensure project management capabilities, resources, and organizational structures evolve with business needs.

    • Requirements

    • University or college degree in Life Sciences or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.

    • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to partner effectively with business development and operational leaders.
    • Fluent English, both written and verbal.
    • PMP certification or clinical research certification is preferred.
    • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 20–30% domestically and internationally to support clients, meetings, site visits, business needs, and training.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time position with remote work options in the United States.
      • Executive-level responsibility for a global RWE and Phase IV project management portfolio.
      • Opportunity to lead and develop a global project management organization.
      • Significant exposure to P&L management, portfolio strategy, commercial planning, pricing, resourcing, and business growth.
      • Collaboration with senior leaders across clinical operations, commercial, finance, quality, and other functions.

      • Varied working hours may occasionally be required to meet client and business needs.
      • Opportunity to contribute to RWE and Phase IV programs within the broader clinical research and development environment.
