title: Senior QA Manual (AI Product)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Manual (AI Product) based in Netherlands.

This role focuses on ensuring the quality and stability of an AI-powered product within a fast-moving release environment. You will plan testing activities, create comprehensive test documentation, and validate product changes across mobile, web, and backend layers. The position combines hands-on manual testing with a strong focus on improving QA efficiency through automation of repetitive checks and practical AI tooling. You will work closely with engineering and product teams to identify defects early and communicate issues clearly enough for rapid resolution. With production releases occurring several times a week, your testing will have a direct impact on product reliability and user experience. This is an opportunity for a structured, product-minded QA professional to help continuously improve both the product and its testing processes.

Accountabilities:

  • Plan testing scope, timelines, scenarios, and coverage for product releases.
  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test cases, checklists, and test documentation.
  • Test and stabilize patches within a rapid release cycle, supporting production deployments several times per week.
  • Perform hands-on testing across mobile, web, and backend components.
  • Identify defects quickly, investigate issues, and document them clearly so engineering teams can act without unnecessary follow-up.
  • Work with client-server applications and assess how changes affect different parts of the product.
  • Support QA activities throughout the Agile development and release lifecycle rather than treating testing solely as a final quality gate.
  • Continuously improve QA processes by standardizing repetitive checks and eliminating unnecessary manual work.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools that can meaningfully improve testing efficiency and productivity.
  • Contribute a product-focused perspective by identifying opportunities to improve the overall user experience and product quality.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience in manual QA testing across mobile, web, and backend environments.
    • Hands-on experience creating and executing checklists, test cases, test scenarios, and structured QA documentation.
    • Solid understanding of client-server architecture and how QA integrates into Agile development and release cycles.
    • Practical experience with Jira, Confluence, TestRail or Allure TestOps, MS SQL Server, Fiddler, and Postman.
    • Demonstrated use of AI tools as part of an everyday QA workflow.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to identify issues efficiently and communicate them clearly.
    • Structured, detail-oriented, and results-focused approach to testing.
    • Product-oriented mindset, with an interest in understanding how features work and improving the overall product rather than simply validating individual tickets.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with frequent releases and changing priorities.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with engineering and cross-functional teams.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote, full-time work opportunity.
      • Compensation level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days per year for personal, household, or recovery needs.
      • Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations.
      • 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.
      • Corporate discounts for English-language lessons.
      • Health support, including up to $1,000 gross per year toward health insurance or eligible medical expenses when corporate medical insurance is not available.
      • Workplace equipment and support, including reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross once every three years for home office or coworking expenses where applicable.
      • Internal gamified recognition program with rewards such as company merchandise, team-building activities, and massage certificates.
      • Opportunity to work with AI tools and modern QA practices in a high-frequency release environment.
      • International and remote-first working environment.
How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

title: Sairaanhoitaja, digitiimi, 3kk
description:
Haemme sairaanhoitajaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Keusoten digitiimin.

Tule monipuoliseen työtehtävään, jossa työtä on mahdollista tehdä osin myös etänä alkuperehdytyksen jälkeen.

Vastaanottopalveluiden digitiimi on osa Keusoten hyvinvointialueen terveysasemien palveluita, ja se vastaa muun muassa alueen reaaliaikaisesta sairaus- tai terveyshuoli- chatista sekä puhelimitse saapuvasta kysynnästä yhdessä omatiimien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu perusterveydenhuollon asiakkaiden palvelu digitaalisissa ja etäpalvelukanavissa. Toivomme, että oma-aloitteisuus, paineensietokyky, ongelmanratkaisutaidot sekä kyky omaksua uusia toimintatapoja ja -malleja ketterästi ovat vahvuuksiasi. Teemme työtä moniammatillisessa tiimissä, jossa vallitsee mukava ja kannustava ilmapiiri.

Työ on päivätyötä arkisin osin etätyötä, mutta sisältää myös säännöllisiä viikoittaisia toimistopäiviä. Tiimin toimisto sijaitsee Järvenpään terveysasema JUST:ssa, joka toimii ensisijaisena työpisteenä työsuhteen alussa. Hyvinvointialueen sisällä työpistettä voidaan kuitenkin tarpeen vaatiessa ja toiminnan tarpeiden mukaisesti vaihtaa, jotta voimme tukea palvelujen sujuvuutta ja henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämistä.

Tehtävään edellytettävä kelpoisuus

- Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on terveydenhuollon korkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi opistoasteen tutkinto. Lisäksi edellytetään laki terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä (559/1994) mukaista sairaanhoitajan laillistusta.

Hakijalta odotamme ja toivomme

- Vahvuudeksi laskemme aiemman kokemuksen hoidon tarpeen arviointia sisältävästä työstä, terveysasematyöstä sekä työstä terveydenhuollon chat- ja muissa digi- ja etäpalveluissa.
- Työssä edellytetään vahvaa tietoteknistä osaamista. Katsomme eduksesi Omni-Pegasoksen ja SuomiSote-digiasiointialustan käyttökokemuksen ja osaamisen.

Lisätiedot tehtävstä antaa esihenkilö Lotta Siiriäinen, p. 050 497 1111, lotta.siiriainen@keusote.fi

title: JOULU 2026: Ohjaaja, Tuusulan asumisyksikkö Neitoperho
description:
Keusoten joulun ajan sijaisuuksiin hakuaika alkanut

Haemme joulun ajan sijaisuuksiin ohjaajia Tuusulan Neitoperhon asumisyksikköön. Tarjoamme mukavan ja lämminhenkisen työpaikan, jossa opit paljon uutta ja tapaat mielenkiintoisia ihmisiä.

Kehitysvammaisten henkilöiden asumisyksikkö Neitoperhossa on 15 kotia. Asukkaat asuvat ryhmämuotoisessa asumisyksikössä, omissa kodeissaan ja ohjaajat ovat asukkaiden saatavilla ympärivuorokautisesti. Neitoperhossa elämme asukkaiden kanssa aktiivista arkea.

Asukkaat tarvitsevat apua arkielämän toiminnan ohjauksessa ja osallistamisessa yhteiskunnan toimintoihin. Työtä tehdään asukkaiden kotona ja lähtökohtana on asukkaiden arvojen, sekä kodin kunnioittaminen. Asukkaiden toiveena ohjaajille on, että heillä on kiinnostusta pitää yhteisöllisyyttä yllä erilaisten tekemisten keinoin, mm. leipominen, ruoanlaitto. Lisäksi he toivovat ohjaajilta ystävällisyyttä ja huumorintajua. Haettavan ohjaajan työaika painottuu pääsääntöisesti klo 7-21 välille, yötyö voi myös olla mahdollista.

Tehtävään edellytettävä kelpoisuus

- Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteen ammatillinen tutkinto.
- Kelpoisten hakijoiden puuttuessa huomioimme myös alan opiskelijat, joilla vaadittavat opinnot suoritettuina.

Hakijalta odotamme ja toivomme

- Edellytämme voimassa olevia lääkelupia, jotka voi suorittaa heti palvelussuhteen alkaessa sekä hyvää suomen suullista kielen ja tyydyttävää kirjallista osaamista..
- Edellytämme asukkaiden osallisuuden ja itsemääräämisoikeuden huomioimista ja kunnioittamista. Lisäksi tehtävä edellyttää hyviä ihmissuhde- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja.
- Arvostamme aitoa halua ja sitoutuneisuutta työskennellä kehitysvammaisten henkilöiden parissa sekä toimintakykyä edistävää, ylläpitävää ja kannustavaa työotetta.

Lisätietoja tehtävistä antaa asumispalveluiden esihenkilö Nina Hintikka, p. 050 497 2821, nina.hintikka@keusote.fi.

title: Project Coordinator Telecommunications
description:
About AARNet

Australia’s Academic and Research Network (AARNet), founded in 1989, has played a pivotal role in shaping Australia’s digital landscape as the pioneers of the country’s Internet. Our mission extends beyond mere connectivity; we are the architects, builders, and operators of a world-class network infrastructure that fuels critical research and learning. At AARNet, innovation thrives within a vibrant community.

The Role: Project Coordinator Telecommunications

AARNet is seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Project Coordinator to join our Networks Construction team and build a rewarding career in telecommunications infrastructure.

In this role, you will support the delivery of new fibre network builds, customer connections, and network relocation projects. Working closely with construction and project teams, you will help ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on time, and to a high standard.

A sound understanding of telecommunications fibre networks will be highly regarded, along with knowledge of fibre splicing and testing, civil construction practices, and telecommunications infrastructure delivery methodologies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and monitor project delivery to ensure key milestones, timelines, and outcomes are achieved.
  • Coordinate and manage small splicing tasks from initiation through to successful completion.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining forward works programs to support effective planning, coordination, and timely delivery.
  • Facilitate delivery meetings, track actions, and coordinate follow-up to ensure agreed deliverables are completed within required timeframes.
  • Track and monitor customer and community issues, ensuring timely follow-up, resolution, and appropriate reporting.
  • Assist with project scheduling, planning, and contractor engagement.
  • Support the development and coordination of project scopes, work packs, and final delivery documentation.
  • Work closely with Telstra and NBN customer access network teams to ensure compliance with access requirements and applicable design and construction standards within their networks.

Skills, experience & qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, exercise initiative, and effectively prioritise and manage competing tasks, deadlines, and deliverables.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, stakeholder engagement, and coordination skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of Telstra and nbn systems, processes, and customer access networks.
  • Experience in project coordination or administration within telecommunications construction, civil, or asset maintenance environments is highly desirable.
  • Strong commitment to Work Health and Safety (WHS), with a high level of awareness and focus on maintaining a safe working environment.
  • Australian Citizenship is required for this role.
  • Must be eligible to obtain a Working with Children Check (WWCC).

Why Work at AARNet?

At AARNet, we’re passionate about advancing global education and critical research. Our Australia-wide network, with global reach, supports some of the most demanding network-based applications. If you’re looking for a purpose-driven workplace where you can make a difference, consider joining our team.

Make an impact: By working with us, you’ll directly contribute to critical research in fields like astronomy, physics, earth observation, environment, health, and medicine. Our mission matters, and we’re committed to providing equal opportunities for all.

Competitive Benefits and Conditions:

  • Superannuation: Enjoy a 17% superannuation contribution.
  • Parental/Adoption Leave: We offer 24 weeks of paid parental leave and superannuation top-up.
  • Secondary Carer Leave: 16 weeks of paid parental leave for secondary caregivers.
  • Wellness Leave: 2 days per month paid Women’s wellness leave.
  • Family & Domestic Violence Leave: 20 days of paid leave.
  • Other Supportive Leaves: Paid leave for various life events such as weddings, deaths, trauma, and disasters.
  • Purchased Leave: Options to purchase additional Annual Leave.
  • Flexible Work Options: We support work-life balance.
  • Equal Opportunity Focus: We value diversity and inclusion.
  • Social Responsibility and Ethics: We lead by example.
  • Cutting-Edge Technologies: Access to work with the latest industry technology.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer — Mobile Healthcare Platform
description:
What you'll do

We are a startup building a platform that is in daily use during patient care, and our direction changes as we learn. The engineer we are looking for is comfortable with that: someone who moves between backend, mobile, integration and platform work as the product demands, and who picks up new technologies quickly because their strength is in engineering fundamentals rather than any one stack.
Right now that means, among other things, bringing our clinical mobile app to Android, evolving how our product integrates with hospital systems, and keeping our services dependable across cloud and on-premise deployments. Six months from now the list will look different, and you will help decide what is on it.
We build AI-native: agents write a large share of our code, and the engineer's job is to design the system, specify the work precisely, and keep the codebase in a state where both humans and AI tools can understand and extend it safely. Your engineering judgement is the product here.

  • Move across the stack as priorities shift: mobile UI, backend services, APIs, hospital integrations, platform and deployment work
  • Own the architecture of the parts you touch: module boundaries, API contracts, data models, and the decisions behind them
  • Direct AI coding agents to implement against your specifications, and review their output with the same rigour you would apply to a colleague's pull request
  • Keep the codebase legible for readers without context: consistent conventions, small well-named units, documented rationale, tests that express intent
  • Own service quality end to end: automated testing, CI/CD, observability, diagnosability in production
  • Work with clinical data and healthcare interoperability standards
  • Produce the technical documentation and evidence required in a regulated development process


What we're looking for

  • Several years of professional experience building and operating software in production, spanning both frontend or mobile and backend work, and a track record of changing roles or stacks when the product needed it
  • Strong grasp of software architecture: you decompose problems into modules with clear contracts, think about dependency direction and ownership of state, and can explain why a boundary sits where it does
  • Fluency with agentic AI development tools (for example Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agents). You can describe a concrete workflow you use, where it breaks down, and which guardrails you put in place. You know which code you would never hand to a model unreviewed
  • A specification and review mindset: you define "done" before starting, treat generated code as a hypothesis to verify, and notice missing edge cases and error paths
  • Grounding in fundamentals that transfer across stacks: concurrency, data consistency, networking, API design, relational data. You have switched languages before and can judge whether unfamiliar code is idiomatic. Our backend is built with Python, Go, .NET and Rust; our mobile app is native iOS today, with Android coming next, likely in Flutter
  • Mobile development experience, ideally Android or Flutter, including app lifecycle, background execution and offline behaviour
  • Hands-on experience with containers, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines
  • A structured, quality-focused way of working, comfortable in a regulated environment
  • Professional English communication skills; German is a strong advantage
Nice-to-have
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR, HL7, or interface engines like Mirth or Rhapsody
  • Knowledge of DICOM and medical imaging workflows
  • Experience developing regulated medical software or working in other safety-critical industries
  • Experience deploying software in customer-managed or on-premise infrastructures
  • AWS experience


Why Snke

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model within Germany

title: Data Center IT Technician, Data Centre Operations
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for skilled Server/Network Technicians with a passion for technology to help us expand our data centers to the next level. At Amazon, career progression is part of our environment. We want you to progress, so come and work for the world’s most Customer-centric Company.

You will work on installing and troubleshooting the IT infrastructure that supports the AWS cloud. You will work closely with our engineering and logistics teams to maintain daily operations. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges.

Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of cloud technology in the region.

Key job responsibilities
- Install and configure racks of hosts in line with internal SLAs
- Diagnose and repair issues for server, storage and network devices, including the physical replacement of parts.
- Remediation or recovery of physical power issues on racks and participate in Data Center power & cooling events.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Marathi Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Marathi speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Marathi speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Marathi, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Marathi and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Marathi experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Marathi, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Marathi speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Consultant Analyst for Program Monitoring, Review and Quality Assurance (Indonesia’s National Only)
description:
Terms of Reference (TOR)

View and download full terms of reference here.


“Consultant Analyst for Program Monitoring, Review and Quality Assurance”

RECONNECT (Religious Counselors Prison Rehabilitation and Community Reintegration) Programme

(Indonesia’s National Only)


I. ABOUT NONVIOLENT PEACEFORCE

Nonviolence Peaceforce (NP) is a nonpartisan international organization globally recognized for its Unarmed Civilian Protection (UCP) strategies in preventing violence, increasing safety and security of civilians, and strengthening local peace infrastructures across its program locations. Presently, NP has country program operations in South Sudan, Myanmar, Iraq, Indonesia and the Philippines.


Nurani Perdamaian Indonesia (NPID) is a humanitarian organization established on March 01, 2023. With legality certification by the Indonesian Ministry of Law and Human Rights through AHU Number -0003058.AH.01.07. TAHUN 2023. Our organization is affiliated with the Nonviolent Peaceforce organization and operates as a branch representative of the Nonviolent Peaceforce for Indonesia. Nonviolent Peaceforce (NP) is a nonpartisan international organization globally recognized for its Unarmed Civilian Protection (UCP) strategies in preventing violence, increasing the safety and security of civilians, and strengthening local peace infrastructures across its program locations.


II. BACKGROUND INFORMATION OF THE PROJECT

Indonesia continues to strengthen a comprehensive approach to preventing and countering violent extremism conducive to terrorism. Beyond security measures and law enforcement, these efforts require sustainable rehabilitation and social reintegration for individuals who have previously been exposed to violent extremist ideologies.


In practice, however, the reintegration process continues to face several challenges, including limited inter-agency coordination, the absence of well established community based support mechanisms, and the need to strengthen the capacity of local actors involved in facilitating successful reintegration. These challenges require coordinated and context-sensitive approaches that involve government institutions, community actors, religious leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.


The Government of Indonesia reaffirmed its commitment through Presidential Regulation No. 8 of 2026 on the National Action Plan for Preventing and Countering Violent Extremism Conducive to Terrorism (RAN PE) 2026–2029, which emphasizes a whole of government and multi stakeholder approach to prevention efforts. Within this framework, the Ministry of Religious Affairs plays a strategic role through the promotion of religious moderation, religious counselling services, and strengthened social cohesion, in line with Presidential Regulation No. 58 of 2023 on Strengthening Religious Moderation.


Through the RECONNECT (Religious Counselors Prison Rehabilitation and Community Reintegration) Programme, Nurani Perdamaian Indonesia (NPID), in collaboration with the Ministry of Religious Affairs and cross-sector strategic partners, seeks to strengthen the role of Religious Counsellors and community actors in supporting safe, inclusive, and sustainable rehabilitation and social reintegration.


The RECONNECT Programme includes capacity building for Religious Counsellors, the development of practical guidance for community-based assistance, the strengthening of community reintegration mechanisms, and the monitoring of reintegration related risks and signals through relevant systems within the Ministry of Religious Affairs. Through these interventions, the program seeks to contribute to stronger institutional capacity, improved coordination, and more sustainable community-based approaches to rehabilitation and reintegration.

III. OBJECTIVE

To provide analytical, monitoring, and quality assurance support to the RECONNECT Programme by assisting the Programme Officer in reviewing program activities, outputs, and reports, monitoring progress against agreed objectives and indicators, identifying implementation gaps and areas for improvement, and documenting key findings, lessons learned, and recommendations to strengthen the quality and effectiveness of program implementation.

IV. CONSULTANCY FRAMEWORK

The consultancy will focus on five interconnected components: MEL System and Tools, Programme Data Analysis and Projection, Activity Monitoring and Documentation, Programme Reporting and Knowledge Management, and Learning and Adaptive Programming. These components are designed to provide technical and analytical support to the Programme Officer throughout the implementation of the RECONNECT Programme.


The MEL system and tools provide the foundation for systematically tracking program implementation and results. Programme data analysis and projection build on this foundation by generating evidence and insights on program progress, emerging trends, gaps, and potential areas requiring attention. Activity monitoring and documentation ensure that program implementation and results are systematically captured, while reporting and knowledge management consolidate these findings into clear and useful program documentation. Finally, learning and adaptive programming use the evidence generated through these processes to identify lessons learned, inform program adjustments, and strengthen future implementation.


The framework below outlines the key program needs, the analytical and technical support to be provided by the Consultant Analyst, the expected outputs, and the key users and stakeholders involved.

[see table in full terms of reference]


V. SCOPE OF WORK

The Consultant Analyst will be responsible for providing technical and analytical support to the Programme Officer in monitoring and analysing the implementation and results of the RECONNECT Programme.


The Consultant Analyst will:

  • Support the Programme Officer in monitoring the implementation of RECONNECT program activities to ensure that activities are carried out in accordance with approved plans, program objectives, timelines, indicators, and agreed deliverables.
  • Analyse the implementation and results of program activities to assess progress, identify gaps, challenges, emerging issues, and areas requiring follow-up or further action.
  • Review activity documentation and reports to assess whether reported activities, outputs, achievements, and results are consistent with the activities implemented and supported by appropriate evidence.
  • Support the Programme Officer in verifying the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of program data, activity reports, and related documentation.
  • Provide analytical feedback and evidence based recommendations to improve the quality and effectiveness of program implementation, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Support the Programme Officer in documenting key findings, lessons learned, good practices, challenges, and follow-up actions arising from program activities.
  • Perform other related analytical and monitoring tasks as reasonably required to support the effective implementation and management of the RECONNECT Programme.

VI. TIMELINE

  • The assignment will be conducted for three (3) working months.


[see table in full terms of reference]


VII. GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS OF THE CONSULTANT:

  • A minimum of a Master's degree with at least five (5) years of relevant professional experience, or a Bachelor's degree with at least seven (7) years of relevant experience in Preventing and Countering Violent Extremism (PCVE).
  • Strong understanding of the institutional context of the Ministry of Religious Affairs, the role of Religious Counsellors, and issues related to religious moderation and social cohesion will be considered an advantage.
  • Experienced in collaborating with ministries and government institutions.
  • Experienced in monitoring and evaluating programs.
  • Excellent communication and report writing skills in Bahasa Indonesia.
  • Demonstrated ability to complete assignments within agreed timelines.
  • Individual consultants or consultant teams may apply independently.

VIII. PREFERABLE CATEGORY:

Candidates with strong skills in programme monitoring, evaluation, quantitative analysis, and data visualisation are preferred, particularly those experienced in analysing programme performance and outcomes, developing analytical matrices and tools, and translating findings into clear and accessible visual outputs. Experience with KoboToolbox or similar data collection and management tools, quantitative analysis, infographic development, graphic design, and layouting is highly desirable, especially the ability to transform programme data into concise, engaging, and user friendly knowledge products.


IX. HOW TO APPLY:

  • We strongly encourage applicants to carefully review the job description before submitting their application and ensure they meet the essential requirements.
  • Candidates meeting the above requirements are requested to submit the following, through our website, detailing their experience and how they qualify for the role. Incomplete applications will not be considered:
    • Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) highlighting relevant experience in program monitoring, research and analysis, PCVE, rehabilitation and reintegration, program management, monitoring, evaluation, or other related fields.
    • Cover Letter outlining the applicant’s relevant qualifications and professional experience, as well as their motivation and interest in supporting the implementation and monitoring of the RECONNECT Programme.
    • Samples of Previous Analytical, Monitoring, Evaluation, or Programme Review Work, such as monitoring reports, analytical reports, assessment reports, evaluation reports, research outputs, program review reports, data analysis, or other relevant analytical work. Applicants may also include examples of data visualisation, diagrams, analytical frameworks, infographics, dashboards, or other visual products developed to communicate program findings, results, trends, or evidence.
    • Brief Technical Approach (maximum 2 pages) outlining the applicant’s proposed approach to monitoring program implementation, reviewing activity results and supporting documentation, analysing program data and evidence, and assessing the consistency and alignment between activities implemented, outputs achieved, and reported results.
    • Address application to: TIM NURANI PERDAMAIAN INDONESIA
  • The closing date for applications is Thursday, 1 October 2026
  • This is on a rolling basis. Candidates may be selected before the closing date apply early.
  • As part of the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a technical assignment before participating in an interview.

Selection Process

  • Administrative screening based on the completeness and relevance of the submitted application documents.
  • Interviews (if required) to assess the consultant's methodological approach and readiness to undertake the assignment.
  • Shortlisted candidates may be invited to present their technical proposals.
  • The final selection will be based on the overall technical quality, relevant experience, and demonstrated suitability for this Terms of Reference.


Honorarium and Payment Terms

  • The Consultant will receive a total professional fee of IDR 55,000,000, payable in monthly installments. (Fifty Five Million Indonesian Rupiah), inclusive of all applicable costs, including taxes, transportation, communication, logistics, and other related expenses.
  • Payments will be made based on the completion of agreed milestone deliverables.

SPECIAL NOTICE

Nonviolent Peaceforce is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability.

Nonviolent Peaceforce acknowledges the duty of care to safeguard and promote the welfare of employees, contractors, volunteers, interns, communities we work with, and other stakeholders and is committed to ensuring safeguarding practice reflects statutory responsibilities and government guidance and complies with best practices in the Humanitarian and Development sector.NP expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We prioritise ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our values are recruited to work for us.

The post holder will undertake the appropriate level of training and is responsible for ensuring that they understand and work within the safeguarding policies of the organisation.

All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records and terrorism finance checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP Process Control and Risk Management Specialist based in the United States.

This role focuses on strengthening enterprise risk governance, compliance, and control effectiveness through SAP GRC solutions. You’ll lead the deployment, configuration, and optimization of SAP GRC Process Control and Risk Management modules. Working closely with Audit teams and business stakeholders, you’ll help improve risk processes and strengthen the organization’s compliance posture. The position combines hands-on technical expertise with a strong understanding of business processes, controls, and risk management. You’ll also troubleshoot and maintain GRC solutions while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to contribute to high-impact enterprise technology initiatives in a collaborative and mission-focused environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead the deployment, configuration, enhancement, and optimization of SAP GRC Process Control and Risk Management modules.
  • Partner with Audit teams, business process owners, and other stakeholders to strengthen controls, compliance processes, and risk governance.
  • Support ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and enhancements of SAP GRC solutions to ensure stability and effective performance.
  • Assess and improve risk management and control processes through technology-enabled solutions.
  • Document and communicate process changes, risk assessments, control activities, and related improvements for cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Contribute to initiatives that improve operational integrity, control effectiveness, and enterprise compliance.
  • Apply techno-functional expertise to translate business requirements and risk objectives into effective SAP GRC solutions.

    • Requirements

    • Active DoD Secret clearance.
    • 8+ years of hands-on experience with SAP GRC Process Control and Risk Management.
    • Strong techno-functional expertise covering SAP GRC implementation, configuration, troubleshooting, and process optimization.
    • Demonstrated experience working with Audit teams and business process owners on compliance, controls, and risk initiatives.
    • Strong understanding of risk assessment methodologies, control frameworks, and compliance management.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
    • SAP GRC or related governance, risk, and compliance certifications are preferred.
    • Experience supporting or partnering with internal Audit organizations is an advantage.
    • Willingness to travel locally up to 10% as required.

      • Benefits

      • Salary range of $90,300–$189,600, with final compensation influenced by location, relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, and contract requirements.
      • Full-time, regular employment.
      • Remote work opportunity within the United States, with the role also listed for Scott AFB, Illinois.
      • Comprehensive healthcare and wellness benefits.
      • Financial and retirement support.
      • Family support benefits.
      • Flexible time-off options designed to support work-life balance.
      • Continuing education and learning and development opportunities.
      • Opportunity to work on enterprise SAP GRC, risk governance, compliance, and process optimization initiatives.
      • Collaborative environment focused on integrity, innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth.

title: Senior Analyst, Revenue Recovery
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Analyst, Revenue Recovery based in United States.

This role serves as a subject matter expert in healthcare revenue recovery, focused on maximizing insurance reimbursement and identifying payment discrepancies. You will analyze contractual reimbursement terms, remittance data, underpayments, denials, and other revenue cycle opportunities. The position combines financial analysis, payer communication, problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration across healthcare revenue operations. You will investigate root causes, support timely recovery, and identify trends that can improve revenue cycle performance. The role also involves supporting escalations, leadership initiatives, and client-focused projects in a KPI-driven environment. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced revenue cycle professional who can work independently while serving as a mentor and resource for others.

Accountabilities:

  • Analyze contractual reimbursement arrangements and identify variances between expected reimbursement and payments received from managed care, government, and other payors.
  • Communicate directly with payors regarding outstanding underpayments, file appeals, resolve account variances, and support timely and accurate recovery.
  • Review large volumes of remittance and account data to identify underpayments, billing opportunities, trends, and opportunities for revenue optimization.
  • Investigate the root causes of underpayments, denials, and delayed payments and collaborate with client teams to document and address recurring issues.
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of applicable state and federal insurance regulations and payor-specific requirements when determining appropriate recovery actions.
  • Accurately document investigative and recovery activities in client host systems, revenue cycle platforms, and other designated tracking tools.
  • Analyze trends and compile reports to communicate findings, risks, issues, and recommendations to leadership.
  • Collaborate with Managed Care, Billing, Coding, Revenue Integrity, Payor Strategy, and other departments to resolve complex revenue cycle issues.
  • Assist leadership with client and payor escalations, strategic initiatives, reports, and assigned projects.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills when determining effective approaches to complex underpayments.
  • Apply knowledge of underpayment prediction rules and related revenue recovery tools to identify accounts requiring further investigation.
  • Manage multiple projects, reports, and priorities efficiently in a fast-paced, KPI-driven environment while meeting established productivity and quality standards.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to other team members and serve as a subject matter expert on revenue recovery processes.

    • Requirements

    • At least 5 years of experience in the hospital or physician insurance industry, healthcare revenue cycle, or a closely related field.
    • Demonstrated understanding of healthcare revenue cycle processes and experience identifying and recovering underpaid accounts.
    • High school diploma or GED required; a Bachelor's degree is preferred but not required.
    • CRCR (Certified Revenue Cycle Representative) certification required within 9 months of hire.
    • Strong knowledge of insurance reimbursement, contractual variances, underpayments, denials, and payer processes.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
    • Ability to adapt to multiple client host systems and work effectively across different operational environments.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to work with large amounts of data and reports.
    • Strong customer service orientation and professional presence.
    • High level of integrity, honesty, accountability, and attention to detail.
    • Self-motivated and able to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
    • Experience mentoring colleagues or serving as a subject matter expert is valuable.

      • Benefits

      • Annual compensation of $66,300–$99,450, depending on experience and other job-related factors.
      • Bonus and incentive opportunities.
      • Paid professional certifications, including support toward the required CRCR certification.
      • Tuition reimbursement.
      • Comprehensive healthcare and benefits package.
      • Retirement benefits.
      • Paid time off and well-being programs.
      • Fully remote, work-from-home opportunity within the United States.
      • Professional development and career advancement opportunities.
      • Opportunities to work on complex healthcare revenue cycle, reimbursement, analytics, and recovery initiatives.
      • Cross-functional collaboration with Managed Care, Billing, Coding, Revenue Integrity, and Payor Strategy teams.
      • Opportunity to serve as a subject matter expert and mentor other revenue cycle professionals.
      • Culture focused on collaboration, innovation, professional growth, and work-life flexibility.
      • Quarterly and annual incentive programs based on performance and contributions.
      • Position is limited to individuals residing in and authorized to work within the United States.

title: Senior full stack developer - e-commerce platform
description:
About the Role

Our client is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join their growing e-commerce team in Durban. You will play a crucial role in the design, development, and maintenance of their customer-facing platform and backend systems. This position requires a blend of front-end and back-end expertise, with a focus on building scalable, high-performance web applications. You will collaborate closely with product managers, UI/UX designers, and other engineers to deliver exceptional user experiences and robust functionalities, contributing to a key area of the company’s business operations in a vibrant coastal city.

Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain responsive, user-friendly interfaces using modern front-end technologies (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js). Design, build, and manage robust backend services and APIs using frameworks like Node.js, Django, or Ruby on Rails. Optimize application performance, database efficiency, and overall system scalability for a high-traffic e-commerce environment. Implement and maintain automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and deliver solutions on time. Troubleshoot and debug issues across the full stack, ensuring the stability and reliability of the platform. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of professional experience in full stack development, with a strong portfolio showcasing web application development. Proficiency in front-end technologies (HTML5, CSS3, Java Script/Type Script) and modern frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js). Strong experience with server-side languages and frameworks (e.g., Node.js, Python/Django, Java/Spring, Ruby/Rails). Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgre SQL, My SQL) and/or No SQL databases. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker). Benefits Competitive salary and performance incentives. Comprehensive health and wellness benefits. Generous paid time off and holiday allowances. Opportunities for career advancement and professional development. A dynamic and collaborative work environment in the heart of Durban.

title: Software Development Engineer I, Annapurna Labs, Early Career - 2027
description:
At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you.

What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

About the team
Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon at Amazon - including Graviton (our server processors), Trainium and Inferentia (our machine learning training and inference accelerators), and the Nitro system that powers modern EC2. We own the full stack, from silicon through the software that makes it work (compilers, runtimes, drivers, and the frameworks that let customers run workloads on our hardware). As a Software Development Engineer I, you'll write the software that turns custom silicon into products used by millions.

Where you might land:
Annapurna has software teams spanning the full stack, and we work to place you on a technical team aligned with your interests and strengths. Example teams and focus areas include:

- Compiler development for ML accelerators (Neuron SDK, MLIR, LLVM)
- ML runtimes and frameworks (integration with PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow)
- Low-level systems software, firmware, and device drivers
- Performance optimization and kernel development for custom silicon
- Distributed training and inference infrastructure
Once you join, we partner with you and our hiring managers to match you to a team where your background and interests fit best, so your project is something you're genuinely excited to work on.

As an SDE I, you'll contribute to real production software, which may include:

- Designing, implementing, and testing software across the stack - from low-level systems code to compilers, runtimes, and tooling
- Writing efficient, maintainable code in languages such as C, C++, or Python
- Optimizing software performance on custom hardware (Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia)
- Debugging complex issues across the hardware-software boundary
- Collaborating with hardware, compiler, and systems teams to deliver features end-to-end
- Documenting your work and presenting results to the team

description:

  • Performing data entry of client information for billing

  • Resolving patients’ complaints and concerns
  • Demonstrating strong attention to details and the ability to multi-task within a fast-paced work environment
  • Ensuring the completeness of all insurance forms and sub-forms
  • Providing high quality submissions at all times
  • Preparing and submitting claims for payment in a timely manner
  • Responding to inquiries regarding accounts
  • Posting cash receipts as received, if any
  • Completing accounts receivable and accounts payable reports
  • Monitoring accounts receivable and outstanding insurance claims
  • Maintaining a minimum balance in outstanding accounts
  • Preparing claims and reports as requested by management and as scheduled
  • Creating, maintaining, and updating billing manuals with new or changing rules and regulations
  • Attending provider billing training as needed for updates
  • Maintaining current expertise in billing and collections
  • Maintaining confidentiality of client and personnel information
  • Performing job functions in compliance with regulations and agency policies and standards
  • Tracking and cross-checking all forms, claimed amounts, level of care, duration of care, etc.
  • Performing other duties as assigned

Other Duties:

  • Audits records to ensure proper submission of services prior to billing on pre-determined selected charges
  • Receives hospital information to properly bill provider services for home care patients
  • Supplies correct ICD-10-CM 2015 diagnosis codes on all diagnoses provided
  • Supplies correct HCPCS code on all procedures and services performed
  • Supplies correct CPT code 2011 on all procedures and services performed
  • Contacts providers to train and update them with correct coding information
  • Attends seminars and in-services as required to remain current on coding issues
  • Audits medical records to ensure proper coding completed and to ensure compliance with regulatory bodies
  • Accurately follows coding guidelines and legal requirements to ensure compliance with regulatory bodies
  • Maintains all mandatory in-services
  • Maintains compliance standards in accordance with the Compliance policies and the Code of Conduct.
  • Reports compliance problems appropriately.
  • Determines the final diagnoses and procedures stated by the physician or other health care providers are valid and complete.
  • Quantitative analysis - Performs a comprehensive review for the record to assure the presence of all component parts such as: patient and record identification, signatures and dates where required, and all other necessary data in the presence of all reports which appear to be indicated by the nature of the treatment rendered.
  • Qualitative analysis - Evaluates the record for documentation consistency and adequacy. Ensures that the final diagnosis accurately reflects the care and treatment rendered. Reviews the records for compliance with established reimbursement and special screening criteria.
  • Analyzes provider documentation to assure the appropriate Evaluation & Management (E&M) levels are assigned using the correct CPT code.

Qualifications:

title: QA Engineer
description:
About AppNation

We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide.

Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 90M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries.

We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions.

About the Role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join Genie Studio and ensure the quality and reliability of Genie, our AI-powered assistant used by millions worldwide.

You’ll own testing end-to-end across iOS, Android, and Web, covering AI-powered experiences, revenue-critical flows, releases, and A/B tests. Working closely with Product and Engineering, you’ll combine hands-on testing, automation, and strong user perspective to catch issues early and help us ship reliable experiences at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Testing Across Platforms: Plan and execute functional, exploratory and regression testing for Genie on iOS, Android and Web.

  • Test AI-Powered Experiences: Validate chat flows, streamed responses and model updates, and catch quality issues in non-deterministic outputs that traditional test cases miss.

  • Guard Every Release: Run smoke and regression cycles, validate release candidates, and give a clear go/no-go signal for every build.

  • Test Revenue-Critical Flows: Ensure subscriptions, paywalls, trials, renewals and web checkout work correctly across platforms and pricing configurations.

  • Validate A/B Tests: Verify that experiments are set up correctly, users land in the right variants, and each variant behaves and tracks as expected.

  • Detect, Report and Track Bugs: Write clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira, prioritize them with Product and Engineering, and follow them through to verification.

  • Be Part of the Sprint: Join planning and grooming, review requirements early, surface edge cases and risks, and help define acceptance criteria.

  • Automate & Improve: Build and maintain automated tests for web and mobile, keep test plans and regression suites up to date, and drive practical improvements to our QA process and tooling.

What We Look For

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on QA in consumer mobile and/or web products, ideally in a fast-paced environment.

  • Mobile & Web Testing: Strong experience testing iOS and Android apps and web applications across devices, OS versions and browsers.

  • Release Ownership: Proven experience running regression cycles and validating releases, including App Store and Google Play release processes (TestFlight, internal testing tracks).

  • Subscription & Payment Testing: Hands-on experience with StoreKit and Google Play Billing sandbox environments and/or web payment flows.

  • Technical Skills: Comfortable with API testing (e.g., Postman), reading device logs, network debugging tools (e.g., Charles, Proxyman), Jira and test management tools.

  • Test Automation: Hands-on experience with Playwright, and with Appium or Selenium.

  • Ownership & Communication: Able to work as the sole QA in a team, set your own priorities, make sound quality judgments without close supervision, and communicate risks clearly to Product and Engineering.

  • User Perspective: You think like an end user and care about delivering reliable experiences to millions of people.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing AI/LLM-based products

  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools and analytics event validation

Why AppNation?

  • Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally.

  • Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment.

  • Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build.

  • Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions.

  • Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options.

Our Hiring Process

Application Review → Interview → Technical Assessment → Final Interviews

At AppNation, we set ambitious goals and challenge ourselves to build products that reach millions of people. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous growth. If this role excites you and you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now—we're excited to meet you.

1. Meillä saat työnhakijana ja -tekijänä aidosti henkilökohtaista palvelua. Tapaat meidät kasvotusten jo työnhakuvaiheessa.

Haluamme tehdä töihin menon sinulle helpoksi: kauttamme voit työllistyä parhaimmillaan jo seuraavana päivänä. Tarjoamme jatkuvasti töitä erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin, ja kauttamme tehty vuokratyö on ollut monelle työntekijällemme reitti vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

title: ICC Project Coordinator
description:
The University

At Durham University we are proud of our people. A globally outstanding centre of educational excellence, a collegiate community of extraordinary people, a unique and historic setting – Durham is a university like no other.

Across the University we have a huge variety of roles and career opportunities, which together make us a large and successful community, which is a key hub of activity within our region and nationally. Whether you are at the very start, middle or end of your career, there is a role for you. We believe everyone has their own unique skills to offer.

We would be thrilled if you would consider joining our thriving University. Further information about the University can be found here.

Find out more about the benefits of working at the University and what it is like to live and work in the Durham area on our Why Join Us? - Information Page.

The Role and the Department

We are seeking a full-time ICC Project Coordinator who, working closely with the Director and other members of staff, will contribute to the future success of Durham University’s Institute for Computational Cosmology (ICC). A world-renowned research centre, the ICC is about to celebrate its 25th anniversary during which time it has made decisive progress on fundamental questions ranging from the origin of galaxies to the nature of matter. We are looking for an administrator who will take ownership of varied and wide-ranging areas such as\: coordinating our portfolio of grants; working as needed with internal university departments such as HR and Finance; welcoming and arranging support for research students and high-profile visitors; and managing recruitment of research students and other staff.

The successful applicant will work closely with the administrative team in astronomy and the broader Physics department, as well as with academic staff from the ICC and other relevant research groups. The base location for this role is the award-winning Ogden Centre West building, in which the ICC is homed alongside the Centre for Extragalactic Astronomy and Centre for Advanced Instrumentation. This is chiefly an in-person role, although a small amount of hybrid working (such as one day per week) can be considered.

Working at Durham

A competitive salary is only one part of the many fantastic benefits you will receive if you join the University\:

• You’ll receive 27 days annual leave per year in addition to 8 public holidays and 4 customary days per year - a total of 39 days. The University closes between Christmas and New Year.
• No matter how you travel to work, we have you covered. We have parking across campus, a cycle to work scheme which helps you to buy a bike and discount with local bus and train companies.
• You can access exclusive discounts via our benefits portal including money off at supermarkets, high street retailers, IT products such as Apple, eating out and days out at various attractions.
• Our on-site nursery is rated Outstanding by Ofsted, and you can access holiday camps for children aged 5-16.
• We provide wide-ranging health and wellbeing support including discounted membership for our state-of-the-art sport and gym facilities and access to a 24-7 Employee Assistance Programme.
• We offer all staff the opportunity to take part in volunteering activities to make a difference to the local community.
• Our family friendly policies, including maternity and adoption leave, are among the most generous in the higher education sector (and likely above and beyond many employers).
• If you are keen on advancing in your role or career, we have a genuine passion for developing our colleagues from qualifications to IT skills, courses and apprenticeships.
• We offer generous pension schemes with varying contribution amounts to help you plan for your future.

Discover more about our total rewards and benefits package here.

Durham University is committed to equality, diversity and inclusion

Our collective aim is to create an open and inclusive environment where everyone can reach their full potential and we believe our staff should reflect the diversity of the global community in which we work. As a University equality, diversity, and inclusion (EDI) are a key part of the University’s Strategy and a central part of everything we do. We also live by our values and our Staff Code of Conduct. At Durham we actively work towards providing an environment where our staff and students can study, work and live in a community which is supportive and inclusive.

We welcome and encourage applications from members of groups who are under-represented in our work force including people with disabilities, women and black, Asian and minority ethnic communities. If you have taken time out of your career, and you feel it relevant, let us know about it in your application. If you are a candidate with a disability, we are committed to ensuring fair treatment throughout the recruitment process. We will make adjustments to support the interview process wherever it is reasonable to do so and, where successful, reasonable adjustments will be made to support people within their role.

title: Senior Project Manager - ResiPro
description:
Position Purpose

ResiPro is seeking a high-energy, field-centric Senior Project Manager to lead our specialized residential renovation operations across North Carolina. This role is built for a dynamic leader who excels at managing people, processes, and high-volume field execution. You will directly oversee a team of Project Managers, serving as the operational anchor for the Raleigh, Charlotte, and Greensboro/Winston-Salem markets. In addition to team leadership, you will stay directly engaged in field execution—performing occupied property inspections, conducting quality control, writing scope estimates, and running projects alongside your team to uphold quality, timeline, and profitability standards.

Note: This role requires up to 50% travel across our Raleigh, Charlotte, and Greensboro/Winston-Salem market footprint.

Key Responsibilities

1. Market Leadership & Team Development

• Direct the day-to-day field activities of a team of Project Managers across the Raleigh, Charlotte, and Greensboro/Winston-Salem markets.

• Determine market staffing needs, supervise the hiring process, and assign new projects to PMs based on workload, location, and volume.

• Set monthly performance goals, conduct field job walks alongside your team, and lead regular meetings to review metrics, address issues, and set market direction.

• Mentor and professionally develop your team, scheduling ongoing training to ensure PMs are fluent in ResiPro’s technology, systems, and procedures.

2. Field Operations & Direct Execution

• Perform occupied property inspections, write comprehensive scope estimates, and directly manage assigned renovation projects alongside your team.

• Monitor project progress during pre-construction and active renovation to assure expectations are met concerning safety, quality, timelines, and profitability.

• Maintain strict oversight of project budgets and aggressively manage Change Orders (COs) to prevent margin erosion.

• Ensure PMs are visiting properties as required, providing accurate updates in the system, and driving their projects to completion.

• Step in to troubleshoot and actively resolve complex problems encountered during the scoping and construction phases.

3. Quality Control & Vendor Management

• Directly conduct quality control inspections on homes to ensure strict enforcement of life-safety, building code, and workmanship standards.

• Work closely with the recruiting team to assure they are fulfilling market labor demands and effectively assigning new subcontractors to PMs based on regional needs.

• Identify, track, and address subcontractor defects, performance issues, or bottlenecks in the field.

• Identify internal system inefficiencies and make strategic recommendations to executive management via weekly and monthly reporting.

The Ideal Candidate

• Field-First Leader: You lead from the front. You thrive on job sites and understand that the best way to manage a construction team is to be visible and active in the field.

• Targeted Regional Travel: You are highly organized, manage your own schedule efficiently, and are comfortable with up to 50% travel focused strictly within our core NC markets (Raleigh, Charlotte, and Greensboro/Winston-Salem).

• Hands-On Quality & Execution: You lead by example—personally performing occupied inspections, conducting thorough quality control walks, drafting estimates, and running projects beside your team.

• Strategic & Detail-Oriented: You have an eagle eye for field defects and non-compliance, paired with the financial acumen to manage regional budgets, review Excel reports, and track profitability metrics.

Job Requirements

• 5+ years of strong experience in residential construction management, quality control, occupied home inspections, or high-volume scattered-site rehabs.

• 2+ years of direct management experience leading teams of project managers or superintendents.

• Travel: Ability to travel up to 50% of the time between assigned NC markets (Raleigh, Charlotte, and Greensboro/Winston-Salem).

• Licensure: Active Residential Contractor License or General Contractor License (North Carolina or reciprocal state) is a strong plus.

• Solid financial and administrative skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel and cloud-based project management software.

• Extensive "Multi-Trade" knowledge with a solid understanding of local building codes, life-safety requirements, and permitting processes.

• College degree in Construction Management, Business, or a related field (preferred).

• Valid Driver's License and reliable transportation.

Why ResiPro?

We believe that high-volume renovation doesn't have to mean compromising on quality. ResiPro provides the technology, the framework, and the team to help our leaders succeed, allowing you to focus on what matters: clear communication, solid craftsmanship, and operational excellence. If you're looking for a professional, stable, and tech-forward environment to apply your construction leadership expertise, we'd love to meet you.

title: Malay Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Malay speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Malay speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Malay, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Malay and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Malay experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Malay, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Malay speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

Rengasasentaja Teräs-Rengas Oy:lle

Hei, juuri sinä!

Me etsimme rengasasentajia asiakkaallemme Teräs-Rengas Oy:lle Oulun Alppilaan.

Mistä on kyse?

Rengassesonki lähestyy taas kovaa vauhtia ja etsimmekin nyt ripeitä rengasasentajia sesonkiajaksi. Syksyn sesonki alkaa arviolta loka-marraskuussa. Etsimme nyt kokoaikaisia ja osa-aikaisia tekijöitä. Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa. Palkkaus alkaen 13,28€/h.

Rengasasentajan työtehtäviin kuuluvat pääasiassa henkilöautojen renkaiden asennukset, mutta työ voi sisältää myös muita avustavia työtehtäviä kuten varastointia, pakkausta ja autojen siirtelyä. Edellytämme hakijoiltamme täysi-ikäisyyttä ja b-ajokorttia.

Katsomme eduksi aikaisemman kokemuksen rengasasennuksesta, mutta työhön annetaan kattava perehdytys. Tärkeimmät piirteesi ovat siis oppimishalu, asiakaspalveluhenkisyys ja motivoitunut asenne työntekoon.

Jos olet hakemamme ripeä asentaja oikealla asenteella varustettuna, niin hae meille heti, sillä paikat täytetään pian!

Kuinka haen Carrotille?

Voit jättää hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta. Jos olet jo aiemmin jättänyt hakemuksen Carrotille, voit hakemuslomakkeen kautta myös kirjautua sisään käyttäjätunnuksillasi ja päivittää aiempaa hakemuspohjaasi hakeaksesi tähän työpaikkaan. Carrotille työhakemuksen jättäminen on helppoa ja nopeaa, ja olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin työhakemuksen jättäneisiin. Kartoitamme osaamisesi ja toiveesi työpaikan suhteen, ja tarjoamme sinulle yhdellä hakemuksella yhteydet satoihin työpaikkoihin, sekä koko elämän mittaisia urapolkuja!

Tarvittaessa lisätietoja tästä työpaikasta saat soittamalla Janne Tauriaiselle numeroon 0400 406 633, ark. klo 8-16.

Jos sinulla on kysyttävää työpaikkoihimme, työnhakuun tai palveluihimme liittyen, löydät yhteystietomme osoitteesta

Nähdään Carrotilla!

Carrot on nopea, välittävä ja vastuullinen työelämän kumppani, jonka tärkeimpänä tavoitteena on olla luomassa hyvää työelämää kaikille.   • Problem-solving skills, ability to think out of the box, challenge the status quo and come with concrete and pragmatic proposals.
  • Self-motivated, flexible and adaptable, able to work in a rapidly evolving environment, effectively handling multiple tasks.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Familiarity with principles of cybersecurity

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with embedded systems
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, IT, Compurer Science or a related field
  • Understanding of distributed or real-time software architectures
  • Experience building, deploying, and scaling applications in containers, with exposure to Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity principles, application security, data protection principles and threat modelling. Experience with vulnerability scan and penetration tests.
  • Interest in or experience applying AI/ML technologies to software development
  • Understanding of Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Deployment/Delivery (CD).

What we offer:

  • a dynamic work environment where you can make a difference and grow your career;
  • smart working (depends on the role);
  • company restaurant for the lunch break;
  • agreements for bank account, credit card and personal purchases;
  • opportunity of professional and salary growth through various initiatives:
  1. annual performance appraisal in order to evaluate the achievement of individual objectives;
  2. inner job posting to apply for career opportunities in Inpeco, even between different locations;
  3. annual salary review linked to performance and professional development;
  4. continuous training on the job, through meetings or conferences, seminars and events
