Working closely with Data Engineers, Software Engineers, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Digital Transformation teams, the AI Engineer will transform large-scale structured and unstructured data into impactful AI solutions that drive operational excellence, automation, and innovation across the organization.

This position plays a critical role in enabling VinFast's vision of becoming a data-driven and AI-powered global EV manufacturer.

Key Responsibilities

AI Model Development & Training

  • Design, develop, train, and optimize Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for production use cases.
  • Fine-tune foundation models and Large Language Models (LLMs) for enterprise applications.
  • Build AI solutions leveraging Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Generative AI, Predictive Analytics, and Recommendation Systems.
  • Develop and execute model training pipelines, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, model validation, and performance evaluation.
  • Conduct experiments to improve model accuracy, robustness, scalability, and inference efficiency.
  • Apply transfer learning, reinforcement learning, and advanced deep learning techniques where appropriate.

Generative AI & LLM Applications

  • Develop and deploy Generative AI solutions using state-of-the-art foundation models.
  • Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and AI Agents to support enterprise use cases.
  • Optimize prompts, fine-tuning strategies, and inference workflows to improve model performance.
  • Evaluate and benchmark various LLMs against business requirements and performance targets.

Production Deployment & MLOps

  • Deploy and maintain AI models in production environments.
  • Implement model monitoring, performance tracking, retraining, and lifecycle management processes.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to establish scalable data pipelines and feature stores.
  • Utilize MLOps best practices for model versioning, deployment automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure AI solutions meet reliability, security, and governance requirements.

Research & Innovation

  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies, research, and industry best practices.
  • Evaluate new algorithms, architectures, and tools that can create business value.
  • Contribute to the long-term AI strategy and roadmap for VinFast.
  • Support the adoption of AI across manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, customer experience, and corporate functions.


Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in AI, Machine Learning, or Deep Learning development.
  • Proven experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying Machine Learning and Deep Learning models in production environments.
  • Strong expertise in Python and modern AI/ML frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • PyTorch
    • TensorFlow
    • Hugging Face Transformers
    • Scikit-learn
    • LangChain or equivalent frameworks
  • Experience working with GPU-based training environments and model optimization techniques.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Machine Learning Algorithms
    • Deep Learning Architectures
    • Transformer Models
    • Computer Vision
    • NLP
    • Generative AI
    • LLM Fine-tuning
  • Experience with SQL and large-scale data processing.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Good command of English, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building and deploying enterprise Generative AI solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
    • AI Agents
    • Multi-Agent Systems
    • LLM Fine-tuning
    • Prompt Engineering
  • Experience with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Weights & Biases, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Experience developing Computer Vision models for defect detection, quality inspection, or industrial automation.
  • Experience within Automotive, Manufacturing, Industrial AI, Robotics, or Smart Factory environments is highly preferred.
  • Contributions to AI research, open-source projects, patents, publications, or Kaggle competitions are a plus.


Benefits

Why Join VinFast

  • Be part of a globally ambitious EV company transforming the future of mobility.
  • Work on large-scale, real-world AI applications with tangible business impact.
  • Access cutting-edge technologies, high-performance computing resources, and large enterprise datasets.
  • Collaborate with world-class engineers, researchers, and technology leaders.
  • Accelerate your career in an innovation-driven and fast-growing global organization.

Key Requirement: Strong hands-on experience in training, fine-tuning, and optimizing Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential. This role is intended for engineers who can build and deploy production-ready AI models rather than perform only data analysis or reporting activities.

title: Caseworker I
description:
POSITION: CASEWORKER 1 – Intake

Full-Time, 80 hours per pay

DEPARTMENT: Children and Youth Services, Clarion, PA


PAY GRADE: $19.00/hour starting rate

$5,000 Sign-on Bonus after successful completion of Probationary Period


Transfer to Caseworker II after successful Onboarding and Foundations training. $2.00 pay raise and added to On Call Rotation


BENEFITS: Up to family coverage for health, dental, and vision insurance effective first of the month after date of hire (employee pays 15% of premium, county pays 85%). $1,500 stipend if you do not need the county insurance. Life insurance coverage at no cost to employees. 5 Vacation days first year, 10 vacation days starting second year, 3 personal days per year, 10 sick days per year, 13 paid holidays off. Enrollment in Clarion County’s Pension plan (vested after 5 years, eligible to retire at 55 with 20 years of service).


POSTING DATE: Wednesday, September 23, 2026

DEADLINE TO APPLY: Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 4:00 PM

QUALIFICATIONS: A bachelor's degree which includes or is supplemented by successful completion of 12 college credits in sociology, social welfare, psychology, gerontology, criminal justice, or other related social sciences.

HOW TO APPLY

A County application and copy of your transcripts are required to be considered for the advertised vacancy.

Applications are available at:



OVERALL OBJECTIVE OF JOB

This position does job shadowing for training purposes. Furthermore, to perform intake assessments for all individuals entering the county human service programs, provide daytime and after-hours coverage for protective services of Children and Youth Services. The primary function of the after-hours work is to assure immediate safety of children through the provision of assessment and referral to community-based services.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF JOB

  1. Conducts intake or assessment interviews to determine immediate needs of children and families.
  2. Provides crisis and/or supportive counseling to stabilize children and families.
  3. Provides walk-in, telephone, and mobile crisis intervention services to children and families.
  4. Investigates allegations of sexual abuse, assesses risk, assures safety of child(ren) and if appropriate, makes referrals for ongoing treatment.
  5. Investigates allegations of physical abuse, sexual abuse, assesses risk, assures safety and if appropriate, makes referrals for ongoing treatment.
  6. Assesses individuals for need of emergency mental health services.
  7. Provides information, referral and other required services to individuals and/or families of developmental disabilities or substance abuse services.
  8. Assists the individual in the development or enhancement of their natural support systems.
  9. Develops and implements service plans for individuals based on preventing further abuse from occurring.
  10. Provides for necessary arrangements according to individual’s needs; makes referrals/contacts to other community services/agencies to help fulfill the service plan.
  11. Maintains accurate documentation and records on individuals.
  12. Attends court hearings and writes reports as needed.
  13. Testifies in court, if necessary, regarding children’s needs; prepares summaries for court as requested.
  14. Prepares required reports as mandated by federal, state, or County policies and procedures.
  15. Completes necessary filing and maintenance of records.
  16. Utilizes computer and other office equipment as needed.
  17. Maintains statistics on pertinent data base and completes required paperwork/reports.
  18. Assists individual in making appointments, including helping the individual arrange transportation. Transports individual as a last resort.
  19. Travels periodically and makes home visits to individuals as necessary to complete the investigatory process.

20. Upon certification by the State as a Direct Service Worker, participate in the On-Call rotation for afterhours emergency services.

OTHER DUTIES OF THE JOB

  1. Attends staffings, training, and other meetings as required.
  2. Attends meetings, training, and seminars as necessary.
  3. Attends certification trainings as required under Act 151 of the Child Protective Services Law, Title 23 PA. C.S.
  4. Required to work flexible schedule in order to meet the needs of consumers.
  5. Performs other job-related work as required.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED

Incumbent must demonstrate the ability to work with minimal supervision. Must be able to formulate an immediate plan of action while in the field, with little or no direct supervisory links. Formal supervision provided by Casework Supervisor.

SUPERVISION GIVEN

None

WORKING CONDITIONS

  1. Works indoors in adequate workspace, lighting, temperatures, and ventilation.
  2. Works with average indoor exposure to noise, but subject to frequent disruptions and stress.
  3. Normal indoor exposure to dust/dirt.
  4. Works in conditions of potential outbursts or disruptive behavior of individuals.
  5. Travels frequently during all seasons and is exposed to outdoor elements, including snow and icy roadways.
  6. Works frequently outside the office and is exposed to above average dust/dirt/odors and smoke.
  7. Works non-traditional hours and maintains flexible work schedule.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL CONDITIONS

  1. Must possess above average ability to record, convey, and present information, explain procedures, and follow instructions.
  2. Usually performs job functions in a high-stress environment.
  3. Must be able to sit and/or drive for long periods throughout the workday with intermittent periods of standing, walking, bending, twisting, and reaching as necessary to carry out essential duties of job.
  4. Dexterity requirements range from simple to coordinated movements of fingers/hands; feet/legs; torso as necessary to carry out duties of job.
  5. Sedentary work, with occasional lifting/carrying of objects with a maximum weight of fifty (50) pounds.
  6. Must be able to cope with the physical and mental stress of the position.
  7. Must be able to physically and mentally react quickly in the event of a disturbance or physical outbreak.
  8. Must be able to pay close attention to details and concentrate on work.
  9. Must have above average ability to think clearly and act decisively.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

A bachelor's degree which includes or is supplemented by successful completion of 12 college credits in sociology, social welfare, psychology, gerontology, criminal justice, or other related social sciences; or successful completion of 6-month probationary period as Caseworker Intern; or an equivalent combination of education or related experience unless regulatory requirements state otherwise. Necessary Special Requirement: Must possess a Pennsylvania driver’s license.


Clearances:

· Must work in conjunction with employer to apply for Act 34 PA State Police Criminal History, Act 151 PA Child Abuse and FBI clearances prior to employment. All clearances must reflect acceptable results.

· Must not appear on Preclusion Lists as defined by “Pennsylvania’s Medical Assistance Bulletin 99-11-05 Provider Screening of Employees and Contractors for Exclusion from Participating in Federal Healthcare Programs.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED

  1. Must be able to speak and understand the English language in an understandable manner in order to carry out essential job duties.
  2. Must possess effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  3. Must possess initiative and problem-solving skills.
  4. Must possess ability to function independently, have flexibility, and the ability to work effectively with individuals, co-workers, and others.
  5. Must possess ability to maintain confidentiality in regard to individuals’ information and records.
  6. Must possess ability to operate personal computer and related software, to type and utilize other office equipment, and to prepare required reports.
  7. Must possess ability to make accurate observations and documentation of it in regard to individuals’ needs and make determinations of risk assessment.
  8. Must possess the academic knowledge and some skill in promoting therapies and social service work and skills with children and youth and families.
  9. Must possess knowledge of child development and the ability to conduct assessments and investigations.
  10. Must possess ability to provide structured and unstructured life skills instructions and guidance to individuals as needed.
  11. Must possess the ability to express empathy and understanding to all individuals.
  12. Must be able to interact effectively with children and youth, department staff, counselors, attorneys, and the courts.
  13. Must be able to work effectively with persons involved in the criminal and/or juvenile justice system.
  14. Must be able to rapidly establish rapport with individuals having behavioral health, substance abuse, or intellectual challenges.
  15. Must have some knowledge of the judicial and court system as it relates to child services.
  16. Must have transportation available and a willingness to travel for work-related job duties.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Big Data and AI Platforms)
description:
We impact the lives of over 40 million consumers daily by working with clients in the Baltics, the USA, Central and South America, and the Caribbean. We operate one of the largest big data environments in the Baltics, with one of the most diverse data sets, and we tackle some of the most challenging analytical and AI problems in the industry.

Exacaster's team is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to build and operate the platforms that power our big data and Generative AI solutions for clients in telecommunications, finance, and investment management.

About the role

We are looking for a DevOps engineer who is excited to work at the intersection of big data infrastructure and the new wave of AI engineering. You will design, deploy, and operate the platforms that run our distributed data systems and our production grade LLM powered applications - RAG systems, AI agents, MCP servers, and ML pipelines.

This role is ideal for an engineer with strong DevOps and cloud fundamentals who is curious about Generative AI and wants to build the foundations that AI engineers, data scientists, and product teams rely on every day. Hands-on experience with AI/LLM workloads is a plus but not required - strong infrastructure, automation, and operational skills are more important. You will also actively use AI tools (Claude, AI coding agents, MCP-based assistants) to accelerate your own work.

In this role, you will take care of

  • Infrastructure for AI & data platforms: Design, deploy, and maintain the cloud and on-prem infrastructure that runs our big data platforms (Cloudera, Spark, Hadoop) and Generative AI workloads (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, vector databases, AI agents, MCP servers).

  • Cloud architecture: Build secure, scalable AWS or Azure environments - multi-account/landing-zone setups, networking, IAM and identity integration for both data and AI products.

  • AI platform operations: Deploy, scale, and operate LLM powered services in production: agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, vector stores, and orchestration layers. Ensure they are reliable, observable, and cost-efficient (latency, token usage, model spend).

  • Automation & IaC: Use Terraform and Ansible for repeatable, scalable deployments across data, AI, and supporting services. Manage secrets, keys, and AI provider credentials securely (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, KMS).

  • CI/CD pipeline management: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, ArgoCD) for infrastructure, data applications, and AI services - including AI-assisted code review, automated testing, static analysis, and release management.

  • Kubernetes management: Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters (EKS/AKS) for big data and AI workloads, ensuring efficient resource utilization for GPU/CPU inference and batch jobs.

  • Monitoring and alerting: Implement and optimize observability with Prometheus, Zabbix, Grafana, and cloud native tools extended to LLM specific signals: model latency, error rates, prompt/response quality, and cost.

  • Networking & security: Collaborate with network and security teams to ensure secure connectivity for data and AI services (VPNs, Transit Gateway, private endpoints), and apply best practices for compliance in regulated industries.

  • Performance optimization: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across big data clusters and AI inference workloads - tuning resources, caching, and scaling strategies.

  • AI-augmented DevOps: Use AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, MCP-based assistants) in your daily workflow - for code review, IaC generation, runbook automation, incident response and help the team adopt these practices.

We are looking for a person who has

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps or SRE roles, ideally on big data, distributed systems, or modern AI/ML platforms.

  • Strong knowledge of Linux (RHEL) systems - scripting, system administration, and troubleshooting.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud environments, particularly AWS or Azure, including deployment of cloud-native services and infrastructure.

  • Expertise in deploying, managing, and scaling applications using Kubernetes.

  • Proficiency with Terraform and Ansible for infrastructure automation and configuration management.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab CI, ArgoCD, or similar.

  • Proficiency with monitoring systems such as Prometheus or Zabbix for metrics and alerting.

  • Strong understanding of networking - security, VPNs, and performance tuning in hybrid environments.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of resolving complex platform and performance issues.

  • Curiosity about Generative AI and a willingness to apply AI tools (coding agents, MCP) to your own work and to the platforms you operate.

Nice to have

  • Experience deploying or integrating MCP servers or AI agent frameworks.

  • MLOps practices - model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Experience managing Cloudera or similar on-prem big data platforms.

  • Experience with Hadoop, Spark, or similar data processing frameworks.

  • Snowflake administration and automation (Terraform provider, key-pair auth, SCIM/SSO).

  • Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) or Kubernetes.

  • Security best practices and tools for cloud and on-prem environments - including AI-specific concerns (data leakage, prompt injection, model access control).

We promise

  • Monthly salary for this position from 5000 EUR gross to 7300 EUR gross for a full-time role.

  • Direct involvement in building the infrastructure behind real, production Generative AI products - not pilots or PoCs.

  • Daily access to and active use of modern AI tooling as part of your engineering toolkit.

  • Participation in the company's stock options program.

  • Flexible Benefits & Personal learning budget.

  • Ownership and dynamics in your role.

  • Hybrid work environment.

  • And the most important thing - you will be part of a great international team!

title: SOK Kiinteistötoiminnot: Kylmämanageri
description:
Työsopimuksen tyyppi: vakituinen, kokoaikainen

Sijainti: Helsinki, hybridi

Hakuaika päättyy: 8.10.2026

SOK Kiinteistötoiminnot etsii nyt kylmämanageria Helsinkiin johtamaan merkittävän asiakkaan kylmäjärjestelmien kokonaisuutta!

SOK Kiinteistötoiminnot vastaa asiakkaidensa eli S-ryhmän alueosuuskauppojen ja yritysten toimipaikkojen ylläpidon johtamisesta, rakennuttamisesta ja rakennushankkeiden johtamisesta, energiatehokkuudesta sekä kiinteistötaloudesta ja -hallinnosta. Saat kollegoiksesi laajan joukon kiinteistöalan ammattilaisia kylmäalan asiantuntijoista, kiinteistötalouden ja -hallinnon, kiinteistöjen ylläpidon, rakentamisen ja energianhallinnan asiantuntijoihin.

Mitä tulet tekemään?

Kylmämanagerina työskentelet S-ryhmän suurimman osuuskaupan, HOK-Elannon, asiakkuudessa ja johdat kaupan kylmäjärjestelmien ylläpitoa tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaan, huoltoliikkeiden ja asiantuntijakollegoidesi kanssa. Työsi yhdistää pitkän aikavälin suunnittelun, ennakoinnin, teknisen asiantuntijuuden ja käytännön ongelmanratkaisun. Tavoitteena on tukea liiketoiminnan häiriöttömyyttä, pienentää huolto- ja korjauskuluja, tunnistaa investointitarpeita ja pidentää järjestelmien elinkaarta.

Tyypilliset työpäiväsi koostuvat muun muassa seuraavista tehtävistä:

  • Yhteistyöstä myymälöiden, HOK-Elannon liiketoiminnan, omavalvonnan, energiamanagerien, kiinteistöpalvelupäälliköiden, projektipäälliköiden ja viranomaistahojen kanssa

  • Teknisenä asiantuntijana toimimisesta kylmäkaluste- ja laitosuudistuksissa, esimerkiksi takuuasioissa ja tarkastuksissa

  • Kaupan kylmäjärjestelmien pitkän tähtäimen suunnittelun johtamisesta, huolto- ja korjaustarpeiden ennakoinnista sekä teknisten investointitarpeiden priorisoinnista yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa

  • Kausihuoltojen sisällön määrittelystä, aikataulutuksesta ja toteutuksen seurannasta sekä huoltoraporttien ja pöytäkirjojen läpikäynnistä

  • Palvelupyyntöjen seurannasta, vuosikorjausten johtamisesta sekä kylmäjärjestelmiä koskevien tietojen ajantasaisuuden varmistamisesta

  • Kylmähuoltoliikkeiden toiminnan ohjaamisesta, laskujen ja toimenpiteiden oikeellisuuden tarkastamisesta, sopimushintojen seurannasta sekä tarvittaessa reklamaatioiden hoitamisesta

  • Ylläpito- ja korjauskustannusten budjetoinnista, ennustamisesta ja seurannasta sekä talouden, toimenpiteiden ja energiatehokkuuden raportoinnista asiakkaalle

  • Toimenpidesuositusten ja kustannusarvioiden laatimisesta sekä kohdekäynteihin ja laadunvarmistukseen osallistumisesta

Millaista osaajaa etsimme? Menestyt tehtävässä, kun tunnet kaupan kylmäjärjestelmät ja pystyt ottamaan itsenäisen omistajuuden laajasta palvelukokonaisuudesta. Osaat yhdistää teknisen tiedon, asiakastarpeen ja käytännön huoltotyön realiteetit toimiviksi ratkaisuiksi.

Pystyt keskustelemaan sujuvasti sekä asiakkaan että palveluntuottajien kanssa, tekemään johdonmukaisia päätöksiä myös paineen alla ja sanoittamaan monimutkaisetkin asiat ymmärrettävästi eri sidosryhmille. Hyödynnät dataa päätöksenteossa, mutta ymmärrät, että tehtävässä tarvitaan myös arjen tilanteiden lukutaitoa ja kykyä erottaa olennainen epäolennaisesta.

Sinulta odotamme:

  • Tehtävään soveltuvaa ylempää tai alempaa korkeakoulututkintoa

  • Useamman vuoden kokemusta kaupan kylmäjärjestelmistä esimerkiksi suunnittelun, urakoinnin, huollon tai ylläpidon tehtävissä

  • Ymmärrystä kylmäjärjestelmien elinkaaresta, huollosta, korjauksista, energiatehokkuudesta ja viranomaisvaatimuksista

  • Analyyttistä ja taloudellista ajattelutapaa sekä valmiutta budjetointiin, ennustamiseen ja kustannusseurantaan

  • Itsenäistä, proaktiivista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta sekä kykyä ennakoida tulevia huolto- ja investointitarpeita

  • Erinomaisia yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja eri sidosryhmien kanssa sekä asiakaslähtöistä asennetta

Miksi valita SOK?

Työntekijöiden tyytyväisyys on SOK:lle tärkeää ja työyhteisötutkimuksen mukaan jopa 86 % SOK:n henkilöstöstä suosittelisi yritystä työnantajana. SOK on myös yksi vetovoimaisimmista työnantajista kaupallisen alan ammattilaisten mielestä (Universum, 2025). Työtä ohjaavat S-ryhmän yhteiset johtamislupaukset: uskallan, arvostan ja toteutan.

S-ryhmässä ollaan sitouduttu työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.

Lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Vakaan työympäristön, jonka toiminta pohjautuu vastuulliseen osuustoiminnallisuuteen

  • Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä työnantajana S-ryhmä tarjoaa sinulle jatkuvasti oppimis- ja kehittymismahdollisuuksia

  • Hyvästä ja tuloksellisesta tekemisestä palkitaan, ja SOK:lla jokainen työntekijä on tulospalkkauksen piirissä

  • Suomen laajimmat henkilöstöedut, kuten esimerkiksi alennuksia ruoasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, elektroniikasta, kosmetiikasta, kurahousuista, kodinkoneista tai vaikkapa autopesusta. SOK:lla työskennellessä elämä työn ulkopuolella on vähän helpompaa ja paljon hauskempaa. Eduista voit lukea lisää täältä

Käytännön asiat:

Tässä vakituisessa ja kokoaikaisessa tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan SOK Kiinteistötoimintojen palvelukseen. Tehtävässä aloitus on viimeistään joulukuussa 2026. Pääasiallinen toimipisteesi on Helsingin Ässäkeskuksessa, jossa myös lähimmät kollegasi työskentelevät. Tehtävään kuuluu säännöllisiä kohdekäyntejä HOK-Elannon toimipaikoissa viikoittain, joten toivomme sinulta matkustusvalmiutta sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta. SOK:n hybridityökäytäntö mahdollistaa kuitenkin joustavan etätyön osan viikosta.

Rekrytointiprosessin kulku:

  • Ensimmäiset haastattelut puhelimitse tai videolla aTalentin toimesta

  • Haastattelu SOK Kiinteistötoimintojen kanssa

  • Haastattelu SOK Kiinteistötoimintojen sekä HOK-Elannon edustajan kanssa

  • SOK:n soveltuvuusarvioinnit

  • Rekrytointipäätös

title: 26-05R – CONSTRUCTION SAFETY SPECIALIST
description:
26-05R – CONSTRUCTION SAFETY SPECIALISTS

Request for Resumes – (3) Construction Safety Specialists

October 2026

Three (3) Year Term

2 Positions @ 241 Erie Street, Jersey City, NJ 07310 and 1 Position @ 4 World Trade Center, 150 Greenwich Street, New York, NY 10007

OVERVIEW

Under the direct Supervision of the Construction Management Division, to support the Port Authority Office of Safety Management, the selected candidate shall perform technical and administrative duties essential to ensure that contractors conduct activities in compliance with all Federal, State and Local fire and safety regulations and standards to eliminate hazardous practices and conditions, and also ensuring fire safety programs and standards are properly adhered to at the Port Authority and Leaseholder construction sites.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review contracts, drawings, and project-related documentation to ensure adherence.
  • Ensure contractors are in compliance with OSHA, FDNY, NYCDOB, Local laws and all applicable regulations.
  • Review contractor Health and Safety Plan submittals.
  • Audit work operations and construction processes to ensure they conform to Health & Safety Programs, Job Hazard Analysis, Contract drawings, approved plans and all accepted safety procedures.
  • Monitor work conditions, operations, practices, construction equipment and processes to evaluate effectiveness, adherence with accepted programs, required regulations, and alignment with all applicable safety policies.
  • Provide Port Authority with daily reports to include photos and detailed account of safety observations, findings, safety deficiencies, and corrective measures.
  • Conduct Accident, Incident and near miss investigations, root cause analysis and make recommendations to prevent recurrences.
  • Provide Port Authority with Preliminary Information Reports on accident and incident investigation information.
  • Interact & collaborate with Port Authority Resident Engineers, Agency Safety Representatives, Integrity Monitors, Stakeholders, insurance brokers, and affiliated representatives.




Requirements

REQUIREMENTS

  • The successful candidate will also be subject to a comprehensive background check, must pass a fingerprint based criminal history records check in order to obtain an airport Security Identification Display Area (SIDA) credential. The candidate must be able to maintain SIDA credentials throughout your employment in this position.
  • The candidate will be expected to conduct comprehensive site audits throughout all construction projects throughout the agency.
  • The position is a field position that requires working in all types of weather.
  • The position requires the candidate to be capable of walking, navigating and accessing all points of a vast, active and dynamic construction site for extended periods of time through most of the day. The position will require climbing various types of stairs, ladders and scaffolds as well as bending, lifting/moving objects, and driving to construction sites.
  • The ideal candidate must be flexible and available to work evenings, extended hours and overtime if/when needed. Must also be able to work rotating shifts which include weekends and holidays.


QUALIFICATIONS

Candidates must present the following qualifications to be considered eligible for this position:

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in construction safety including conducting investigations and accident prevention at construction sites or related fields.
  • Possess a valid NYC DOB Site Safety Supervisor Card (SST).
  • Possess OSHA 30-hour construction safety certificate.
  • Possess a valid driver’s license.
  • Strong communications and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational, time management skills.
  • Demonstrated experience on Major Capital Construction projects including heavy civil infrastructure construction.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Construction Safety and regulations including OSHA 1926 Standards, NYC DOB Code, FDNY, Local laws including DOT, DEP and any other applicable regulatory agency.
  • Familiarity with National Fire Codes, NFPA standards, NYC and NJ Fire Codes, Rules of the City of NY and FDNY operations and procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate effectively contractor construction safety and fire safety programs and to make technical recommendations based upon findings.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of hazard recognition and assessment, incident and accident Investigation and reporting and conduct root cause analysis and Job Hazard Analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and professionally with OSHA and FDNY inspectors, construction inspectors, contractors, management, safety professionals, workers and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated knowledge using computer safety software utilized for managing and tracking of project hazards, incidents, and program documentation.
  • Demonstrated computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.


DESIRED

• CHST certification or other recognized construction safety credential.

• Bachelor’s degree in Safety Management or Construction Management, or College Degree in a safety-related field from an accredited institution.

• Experience with OCIP and CCIP projects.

• Worked on other Port Authority projects.



Benefits

ITE offers an excellent benefits package including FREE medical, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, 401(k) with company match, short and long-term disability, life insurance, college savings plan, commuter benefits, and educational assistance.

title: Senior Managing Consultant – Data Engineer - (Databricks)| Sydney

title: Korean Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Korean speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Korean speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Korean, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Korean and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Korean experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Korean , written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Korean speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Logistician IV – PMS Specialist
description:
Logistician I – IV – NSCWPD Code 316

Salary Range: $50,000 - $110,000

Logistician I: $50,000 to 60,000

Logistician II: $60,000 to $70,000

Logistician III: $70,000 to $80,000

Logistician IV: $100,000 to $110,000


Company Overview:

KMS Solutions, LLC is a technical management / solutions company that specializes in engineering, analysis, and cyber security. Founded in 2005, KMS is a certified small business with nearly two decades of experience supporting the Department of Defense as well as many other departments and programs critical to our Nation’s security and well-being.

KMS is a two-time winner of the USA Today Top Workplaces recognizing quality workplace cultures across the United States who put their employees first. Additionally, we received the Providence Journal Rhode Island Top Workplaces award and Culture Excellence Awards for Compensation & Benefits, Innovation, Leadership, Purpose & Values and Work-Life Flexibility


Position Summary / Objective:

The Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division (NSWCPD) is a Department of Defense entity responsible for research and development, test and evaluation, engineering, and Fleet support services for the Navy’s ships, submarines, military watercraft, and unmanned vehicles.

This position supports NSWCPD Code 316, which is responsible for the Planned Maintenance System (PMS)/Class Maintenance Plan (CMP), Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) and PMS Service Request (PSRs), review of New Construction PMS Contract Deliverables, and PMS update and development for in-service, modernization, new construction, and land-based engineering test site maintenance documents.


Essential functions:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Collect, review, and process Fleet logistics and maintenance feedback (e.g., TFBRs, LARs, MAFs) for shipboard mechanical and electrical systems.
  • Analyze Planned Maintenance System (PMS) data and recommend updates to MIPs/MRCs based on field experience and reliability trends.
  • Support the development, review, and update of ILS documentation including:
  • Maintenance Index Pages (MIP) / Maintenance Requirement Cards (MRC)
  • Maintenance Plans
  • Technical Manuals
  • Provisioning Technical Documentation (PTD)
  • Allowance Parts Lists (APLs)
  • Logistics Support Analyses (LSA)
  • Use Navy data systems (e.g., PMSMIS, REMEDY, DECKPLATE, CDMD-OA, MBPS, OMMS-NG, SKED, SCLSIS) to assess configuration, logistics status, and maintenance effectiveness.
  • Track the incorporation of feedback into logistics products and PMS systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, technicians, and Fleet representatives to resolve supportability issues and maintain logistics accuracy across ship classes.
  • Prepare logistics assessments, reports, and briefing materials in support of PMS and ILS process improvements.
  • Participate in ILS Reviews (ILSRs), Technical Evaluation Reviews (TERs), and Engineering Change proposals related to logistics.


Required education and experience:

  • Bachelor of Science (or higher) in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Familiarity with Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) elements and lifecycle sustainment planning
  • Navy shipboard experience in an engineering Rate (i.e. MM, EM, GS, HT, EN, etc.) is required.
  • Working knowledge of Navy maintenance and logistics systems (e.g., PMSMIS, REMEDY, DECKPLATE, MBPS, e-Waivers, OMMS-NG, CDMD-OA)..
  • Required years of professional experience in logistics or life cycle support, preferably supporting Navy or DoD programs:
    • Logistician I – Entry Level
    • Logistician II - 3 years
    • Logistician III - 7 years
    • Logistician IV - 10 years


Preferred education and experience:

  • NAVSEA Reliability Centered Maintenance Level 1 & 2 certification (active or held within previous three years)
  • Prior Navy or DoD experience in logistics, maintenance planning, or configuration management.
  • Experience with Logistics Support Analysis Records (LSAR) or Product Data Reporting and Evaluation Program (PDREP).
  • Understanding of NAVSEA technical documentation standards and processes.
  • Experience with supporting PMS updates and Fleet feedback response workflows.
  • Technical writing experience, particularly with maintenance or logistics documentation.
  • Adept at learning new systems and terminology.


Competencies:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, specifically, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook software.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, as well as presentation skills.
  • High comfort level working with and around all military/organizational levels, clients, customers, suppliers, and visitors.
  • Must be highly reliable and demonstrate personal initiative to operate in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.


Additional eligibility requirements


Work authorization/security clearance requirements:

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and/or maintain a DoD Security Clearance and required access to all worksite locations. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and throughout employment.


Other Duties:

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.


Supervisory Responsibility:

None


Work Environment:

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and photocopiers.


Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. Excellent listening skills are essential. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle or feel, and reach with hands and arms. Must be able to lift up to 20 lbs.


Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:

The typical workday is eight hours in length. Some flexibility in hours is allowed, with concurrence from the supervisor. Attendance at prescheduled mandatory meetings is required. Must be available during the core work hours as determined by your contract/location and must account for the required number of hours in a pay period to maintain Full-time status.


Telework:

  • Telework may be allowed for this position subject to customer requirements/expectations.


Travel:

  • Ability to travel CONUS; potential to travel OCONUS
  • Travel up to 10% may be required


Benefits and Additional Compensation:

KMS offers a competitive benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurances, flexible spending account, PTO, paid holidays, military leave, bereavement leave, 401k / retirement savings plan, professional development and tuition reimbursement, basic and voluntary life insurance / AD&D, short-term and long-term disability, voluntary AFLAC supplemental insurance products and employee assistance plan (EAP) program. Additionally, KMS offers employee referral bonuses and a discretionary annual bonus.

This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: RE-Tech Engineering: Suunnittelupäällikkö
description:
Työsopimuksen tyyppi: Vakituinen ja kokoaikainen

Sijainti: Tampere / Helsinki

Hakuaika päättyy: 9.10.2026

Kiinnostaisiko vastuullinen rooli uuden sähköasemaliiketoiminnan rakentamisessa? RE-Tech Engineering etsii Suunnittelupäällikköä vastaamaan sähköasemaprojektien suunnittelusta!

RE-Tech Engineering on uusi yhtiö, joka laajentaa RE-Techin nykyistä muuntaja- ja laitetoimituksiin keskittyvää liiketoimintaa kohti sähköasemien kokonaisratkaisuja. Uusi liiketoiminta keskittyy erityisesti datakeskus-, uusiutuvan energian ja energiavarastohankkeisiin Suomessa ja Pohjoismaissa. Mitä tulet tekemään?

Suunnittelupäällikkönä olet yksi RE-Tech Engineeringin ensimmäisistä avainhenkilöistä ja vastaat sähköasemaprojektien suunnittelukokonaisuuksista. Pääset rakentamaan yhdessä liiketoimintajohtajan kanssa uuden yrityksen toimintamallia ja teknistä perustaa sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miten projekteja tulevaisuudessa toteutetaan.

Rooli on etenkin alkuvaiheessa vahvasti operatiivinen rooli. Osallistut itse sähköasemien ylätason suunnitteluun ja tekniseen määrittelyyn, laadit projektien teknisiä spesifikaatioita sekä varmistat asiakasvaatimusten, standardien ja verkkoyhtiöiden vaatimusten huomioimisen. Yksityiskohtaisempaa toteutussuunnittelua hankitaan ulkoisilta kumppaneilta, joiden teknistä työtä ohjaat ja koordinoit.

Pidät teknisestä näkökulmasta kokonaisuuden hallussa läpi sähköasemaprojektien ja työskentelet tiiviisti asiakkaiden, konsulttien, laitetoimittajien ja aliurakoitsijoiden kanssa. Tuet myös myyntiä tarjousten teknisessä valmistelussa ja osallistut laitetoimittajien tehdaskäynneille. Ensimmäisten kuukausien aikana keskeinen tavoitteesi on saada yhdessä liiketoimintajohtajan kanssa suunnittelun toimintamallit, työkalut sekä toimiva kumppani- ja alihankintaverkosto kuntoon. Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Etsimme sähkötekniikan osaajaa, jolla on useamman vuoden kokemus sähköasemien, suurjännitejärjestelmien tai sähkönjakelun suunnittelusta. Pystyt ottamaan itsenäisesti vastuuta teknisistä kokonaisuuksista ja tekemään ratkaisuja myös tilanteissa, joissa kaikkea ei ole vielä määritelty valmiiksi.

Uuden toiminnan rakentaminen edellyttää oma-aloitteista ja yrittäjämäistä työskentelytapaa. Viihdyt asiakkaiden ja kumppaneiden parissa, kommunikoit teknisistä asioista luontevasti eri sidosryhmille ja haluat oman suunnittelutyön lisäksi rakentaa toimintatapoja ympärillesi.

Hakijalta odotetaan:

  • Useamman vuoden soveltuvaa kokemusta sähköasemien, suurjännitejärjestelmien tai sähkönjakelun suunnittelusta

  • Soveltuvaa sähkötekniikan insinööri- tai diplomi-insinöörikoulutusta

  • Kykyä johtaa suunnittelukokonaisuuksia ja tehdä itsenäisiä teknisiä päätöksiä

  • Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

  • Valmiutta matkustaa Suomessa ja ulkomailla

  • Voimassa olevaa ajokorttia

Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:

  • Kokemus sähköasemaprojektien teknisestä määrittelystä ja koordinoinnista

  • Tausta datakeskus-, raskaan teollisuuden tai muiden vaativien sähköteknisten hankkeiden parista

  • Kokemus ulkoisten suunnittelukumppaneiden tai aliurakoitsijoiden ohjaamisesta

  • Kokemus ympäristöstä, jossa olet päässyt rakentamaan uusia toimintatapoja tai teknisiä kokonaisuuksia

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Pääset rakentamaan uutta sähköasemaliiketoimintaa alusta asti ja vaikuttamaan konkreettisesti sen teknisiin toimintatapoihin

  • Saat laajan roolin, jossa yhdistyvät oma suunnittelutyö, tekninen kokonaisvastuu ja tiivis asiakasyhteistyö

  • Työskentelet ajankohtaisten datakeskus-, uusiutuvan energian ja energiavarastohankkeiden parissa Suomessa ja Pohjoismaissa

  • Pääset vaikuttamaan käytettäviin suunnittelutyökaluihin sekä rakentamaan toimivaa kumppani- ja alihankintaverkostoa projektien tueksi

  • Saat kattavat terveyspalvelut hammashoitoineen ja kaksinkertaisen lomarahan

Käytännön asiat:

Tässä vakituisessa ja kokoaikaisessa tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan RE-Tech Engineering Oy palvelukseen. Toivottu aloitusajankohta on mahdollisimman pian. Ensisijainen työskentelyalue on Tampere, mutta myös Helsinki on mahdollinen. Olennaista on, että pystyt työskentelemään säännöllisesti kasvotusten liiketoimintajohtajan kanssa, sillä rakennatte uuden toiminnan käytäntöjä tiiviissä yhteistyössä.

Tehtävään kuuluu matkustamista Suomessa ja Pohjoismaissa sekä muutamia pidempiä kansainvälisiä matkoja vuodessa esimerkiksi laitetoimittajien tehtaille. Työajat sijoittuvat pääasiassa tavallisiin toimistotyöaikoihin, mutta tehtävä edellyttää joustavuutta projektien ja matkustamisen mukaan.

RE-Tech Engineering Oy on uusi sähköasemien kokonaisratkaisuihin keskittyvä yritys, joka toimii erityisesti datakeskus-, uusiutuvan energian ja energiavarastohankkeiden parissa Suomessa ja Pohjoismaissa. title: Senior QA Manual (AI Product)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Manual (AI Product) based in Mexico.

This role focuses on ensuring the quality and stability of an AI-powered product within a fast-moving release environment. You will plan testing activities, create comprehensive test documentation, and validate product changes across mobile, web, and backend layers. The position combines hands-on manual testing with a strong focus on improving QA efficiency through automation of repetitive checks and practical AI tooling. You will work closely with engineering and product teams to identify defects early and communicate issues clearly enough for rapid resolution. With production releases occurring several times a week, your testing will have a direct impact on product reliability and user experience. This is an opportunity for a structured, product-minded QA professional to help continuously improve both the product and its testing processes.

Accountabilities:

  • Plan testing scope, timelines, scenarios, and coverage for product releases.
  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test cases, checklists, and test documentation.
  • Test and stabilize patches within a rapid release cycle, supporting production deployments several times per week.
  • Perform hands-on testing across mobile, web, and backend components.
  • Identify defects quickly, investigate issues, and document them clearly so engineering teams can act without unnecessary follow-up.
  • Work with client-server applications and assess how changes affect different parts of the product.
  • Support QA activities throughout the Agile development and release lifecycle rather than treating testing solely as a final quality gate.
  • Continuously improve QA processes by standardizing repetitive checks and eliminating unnecessary manual work.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools that can meaningfully improve testing efficiency and productivity.
  • Contribute a product-focused perspective by identifying opportunities to improve the overall user experience and product quality.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience in manual QA testing across mobile, web, and backend environments.
    • Hands-on experience creating and executing checklists, test cases, test scenarios, and structured QA documentation.
    • Solid understanding of client-server architecture and how QA integrates into Agile development and release cycles.
    • Practical experience with Jira, Confluence, TestRail or Allure TestOps, MS SQL Server, Fiddler, and Postman.
    • Demonstrated use of AI tools as part of an everyday QA workflow.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to identify issues efficiently and communicate them clearly.
    • Structured, detail-oriented, and results-focused approach to testing.
    • Product-oriented mindset, with an interest in understanding how features work and improving the overall product rather than simply validating individual tickets.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with frequent releases and changing priorities.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with engineering and cross-functional teams.

emagine söker en Senior Platform Engineer till en spännande kund i Stockholm. Du kommer att ha en central roll i utvecklingen av kundens nästa generations utvecklarplattform, med stort fokus på developer experience, molninfrastruktur, automatisering och skalbarhet.

Steg 2: 60 min intervju på plats

Uppdraget

Kundens infrastruktur är idag decentraliserad, med en central plattformsfunktion som tillhandahåller byggblock som utvecklingsteamen själva sätter samman för att definiera och hantera infrastrukturen för sina applikationer enligt DevOps-principer. Det har även lett till variation i lösningar och arbetssätt, där lärdomar, förbättringar och best practices inte alltid sprids effektivt mellan teamen. Kunden vill nu bygga nästa generations utvecklarplattform.

Målet är att utvecklingsteamen ska kunna definiera vilka kapabiliteter deras applikationer behöver på en högre abstraktionsnivå, medan plattformen ansvarar för att översätta dessa behov till lämpliga underliggande molnteknologier.

Genom ett flexibelt abstraktionslager byggt på AWS, Kubernetes och GitOps kommer plattformen att centralisera en stor del av det ansvar för drift och underhåll som idag är distribuerat över organisationen.

Syftet är att minska infrastrukturkomplexiteten för produktteamen, skapa en mer enhetlig developer experience och frigöra mer tid för utvecklingsteamen att fokusera på att skapa värde för slutanvändarna.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Flera års erfarenhet inom Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, Cloud Engineering eller motsvarande.

  • Mycket god och praktisk erfarenhet av AWS och cloud native-arkitektur.

  • Djup erfarenhet av Kubernetes, inklusive design och drift av produktionskritiska miljöer.

  • Erfarenhet av GitOps och tillhörande verktyg och arbetssätt.

  • Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

  • God förståelse för CI/CD, automatisering, observability, reliability, säkerhet och cloud operations.

  • Stark förståelse för mjukvaruutveckling och förmåga att behandla en intern plattform som en produkt, snarare än enbart som infrastruktur.

  • Intresse för och gärna praktisk erfarenhet av AI och AI-assisterade utvecklingsverktyg.

  • Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med såväl utvecklare som produktteam och andra tekniska intressenter.

Viktiga egenskaper

Produktsinne – Du ser plattformen som en produkt och utvecklingsteamen som dess användare. Du förstår vikten av developer experience, enkelhet och användbarhet.

Tekniskt djup – Du har en stark teknisk grund och kan både diskutera arkitektur på hög nivå och arbeta hands-on med tekniken.

Kommunikation – Du kan förklara komplexa tekniska frågeställningar på ett tydligt sätt och samarbeta effektivt över teamgränser.

Agens och driv – Du tar initiativ, identifierar förbättringsmöjligheter och driver arbetet framåt utan att behöva detaljerad styrning.

AI Engineering – Du är nyfiken på moderna AI-baserade arbetssätt och ser möjligheter att använda AI för att effektivisera utveckling, plattformsarbete och engineering workflows.

Social mognad – Du är pragmatisk, lyhörd och samarbetsorienterad samt bekväm med att navigera mellan olika perspektiv i en komplex teknisk organisation.

description:

K-Citymarket Porvoo Jokiranta avautuu vuonna 2027 – ja nyt etsimme ensimmäisiä uusia tekijöitä rakentamaan kanssamme jotain aivan uutta.

Haemme joukkoomme:

KEITTIÖVASTAAVAAKokoaikainen

PALVELUTISKIVASTAAVAAKokoaikainen

ILTAVASTAAVAA / PÄIVYSTÄJÄÄKokoaikainen / Osa-aikainen

PALVELUTISKIMYYJÄÄOsa-aikainen

MYYJÄÄ HEVI- JA LEIPÄOSASTOILLEOsa-aikainen

UUDEN AJAN KAUPPAHALLI TARVITSEE TEKIJÄNSÄ

Jokirantaan ei ole syntymässä vain uutta ruokakauppaa. Rakennamme Porvooseen uuden ajan kauppahallia, jossa hyvä ruoka, tuoreus, laaja valikoima ja lämminhenkinen palvelu kohtaavat saman katon alla.

Etsimme nyt erilaisiin tehtäviin ihmisiä, jotka haluavat olla mukana rakentamassa uutta kauppaa ja sen toimintatapoja alusta lähtien.

KEITTIÖVASTAAVA

Pääset rakentamaan Jokirannan oman keittiön toimintaa ja valikoimaa. Vastaat yhdessä tiimisi kanssa keittiön päivittäisestä tekemisestä, tuotteiden laadusta, tuotannon suunnittelusta, hävikin hallinnasta ja toiminnan tuloksellisuudesta.

Etsimme ruoan ammattilaista, joka osaa yhdistää herkullisen ruoan, tehokkaan tekemisen ja kaupallisen ajattelun.

PALVELUTISKIVASTAAVA

Pääset rakentamaan palvelutiskiämme, josta haluamme tehdä yhden Jokirannan tärkeimmistä vetovoimatekijöistä.

Vastaat palvelutiskin päivittäisestä toiminnasta, myynnistä, valikoimasta, laadusta, esillepanoista ja yhdessä tiimisi kanssa erinomaisesta asiakaspalvelusta.

Etsimme tekijää, jolla on kaupallinen ote ja halu kehittää toimintaa myös numeroiden kautta.

ILTAVASTAAVA / PÄIVYSTÄJÄ

Iltavastaavana olet yksi kaupan arjen avainhenkilöistä. Huolehdit vuorosi aikana koko kaupan sujuvasta toiminnasta, asiakaspalvelusta ja siitä, että yhteiset toimintatapamme toteutuvat myös kiireen keskellä.

Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka tarttuu asioihin oma-aloitteisesti, osaa tehdä päätöksiä ja nauttii vastuusta sekä ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä.

OSA-AIKAINEN PALVELUTISKIMYYJÄ

Haemme palvelutiskiimme asiakaspalvelusta ja hyvästä ruoasta innostuvaa tekijää.

Aikaisempi kokemus palvelutiskistä, kalasta, lihasta tai ruoan parissa työskentelystä on etu, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme hyvällä asenteella varustettua ihmistä, joka haluaa oppia ja kehittyä.

OSA-AIKAINEN MYYJÄ – HEVI & LEIPÄ

Haemme tekijöitä erityisesti hedelmä- ja vihannes- sekä leipäosastoillemme.

Näillä osastoilla tuoreus, runsaus, siisteys ja houkutteleva esillepano näkyvät asiakkaalle heti. Etsimme ihmisiä, jotka nauttivat vauhdikkaasta tekemisestä ja joilla on silmää sille, miltä hyvä kauppa näyttää ja tuntuu.

KENET HALUAMME JOUKKOOMME?

Arvostamme ennen kaikkea hyvää asennetta, vastuullisuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua tehdä tulosta yhdessä muiden kanssa.

Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen K-ryhmästä ja K-ryhmän järjestelmistä sekä näytöt tuloksellisesta toiminnasta.Vastaavien tehtävien hakijoilta odotamme kykyä johtaa omaa tekemistä ja vastuualueen toimintaa tavoitteellisesti.

Emme kuitenkaan etsi vain ihmisiä täyttämään valmiita tehtävänkuvia. Haluamme joukkoomme tekijöitä, joilla on ajatuksia, uskallusta kehittää ja halua rakentaa kanssamme jotain uutta.

MUKAAN JO ENNEN JOKIRANNAN AVAUSTA

Työt voivat tehtävästä riippuen alkaa jo joulukuussa K-Citymarket Porvoossa, ennen uuden Jokirannan kaupan avaamista.

Tämä antaa mahdollisuuden päästä tutustumaan toimintaan, asiakkaisiin ja tuleviin työkavereihin jo hyvissä ajoin – ja ennen kaikkea olla mukana rakentamassa Jokirannan toimintatapoja ennen kuin uuden kaupan ovet avautuvat.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan ainutlaatuiseen vaiheeseen: rakentamaan kokonaan uutta K-Citymarketia ja työyhteisöä alusta lähtien.

Tule tekemään kanssamme Porvoon omaa uuden ajan kauppahallia.

Kerro hakemuksessasi, mitä tehtävää haet ja miksi juuri sinä olisit hyvä lisä Jokirannan porukkaan. Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 8.10.2026 oheisesta linkistä.

Voit näyttää meille, että olet valmis oppimaan ja tarttumaan uusiin mahdollisuuksiin. Suorita maksuton LET'S K! Duunitaidot -koulutus ja liitä suoritusmerkintä hakemukseesi. Koulutuksesta saat käytännön vinkkejä työnhakuun, oman suunnan löytämiseen ja työelämään. Koulutuksen löydät osoitteesta kesko.fi/duunitaidot.

Rekrytointiin liittyvän tietosuojaselosteen saat rekrytoivasta kaupasta.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

title: Web & Mobile (AI-Enabled Development)- React with React Native
description:
Job Description

Position: Senior Software Engineer – Full-Stack & Mobile (AI-Enabled Development)


About the Role

We're looking for a T-shaped engineer who can move fluidly across web and mobile platforms while operating within a modern, AI-augmented software development lifecycle. You'll build and ship production-grade applications using React and React Native, while leveraging AI tooling to accelerate design, development, testing, and deployment. Experience in telco environments is a strong plus, given the scale and regulatory nuances of that industry.


Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain web and mobile applications using React and React Native

• Apply AI-enabled SDLC practices across the full development lifecycle — from requirements and design (AI-assisted specs, user stories) to coding (AI pair-programming/copilots), testing (AI-generated test cases, automated QA), code review, and deployment (AI-assisted CI/CD, monitoring, and incident triage)

• Collaborate with product, design, and QA teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions

• Own features end-to-end: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-release monitoring

• Champion best practices for code quality, performance, accessibility, and security across platforms

• Evaluate and integrate AI tools/agents (e.g., code generation, automated testing, documentation generation) to improve engineering velocity and quality

• Mentor junior engineers on both technical delivery and AI-assisted workflows

• Participate in architectural decisions balancing web/mobile code reuse, performance, and maintainability

• Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, including AI-driven build/test optimization


Required Skills & Experience

• T-shaped skill profile: deep expertise in at least one area (web or mobile) with solid working proficiency across the full stack

• Strong hands-on experience with React (web) and React Native (mobile/cross-platform)

• Solid understanding of mobile app development fundamentals (iOS/Android build processes, app store deployment, native module integration)

• Practical understanding of all phases of an AI-enabled SDLC: requirements/planning, design, development, testing, deployment, and monitoring — and where AI tools add value at each stage

• Experience using AI coding assistants/copilots in a professional development workflow (not just casually)

• Strong grasp of state management, API integration (REST/GraphQL), and performance optimization on both web and mobile

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and automated testing frameworks

• Good understanding of software architecture patterns and scalable system design


Preferred Qualifications

• Telco industry experience

• Strong cross-functional collaboration across product, design, QA, and DevOps

• Ability to evaluate emerging AI tools critically and pragmatically (not just adopt for adoption's sake)

• Clear communicator, comfortable explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders

• Self-driven with a continuous-learning mindset, especially around fast-evolving AI tooling


Experience Level

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (adjust based on actual seniority target)

• Demonstrated portfolio of shipped web and mobile applications

title: Principle Engineer, Cybersecurity
description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Job Description

Your Role at Baxter

This is where your work saves lives.

As a Principal Product Cybersecurity Engineer, you will own and direct the cybersecurity design, architecture, and analysis of medical devices, digital platforms, and connected healthcare solutions. You will serve as a cybersecurity subject matter expert, leading security initiatives from concept through deployment while providing technical leadership and mentorship across cross-functional teams. You will drive cybersecurity strategy, influence technical decision making, and ensure products are designed and maintained in alignment with industry best practices, regulatory expectations, and organizational objectives.

You will contribute to the organization's cybersecurity vision and strategic roadmap, utilizing deep knowledge of medical device security, connectivity, cloud technologies, software development, and risk management to deliver innovative and secure solutions.

What You'll Be Doing

· Lead the implementation of cybersecurity principles as part of the overall architecture for medical devices, connected systems, digital platforms, and hosted solutions.

· Create, own, and maintain security-related documentation including:

· Threat Models and Interface Architecture

· Security Requirements and Architectures

· Security Risk Assessments and Security Risk Analyses

· Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)

· Product Security Whitepapers

· Manufacturer Disclosure Statements for Medical Devices (MDS2)

· Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs)

· Static Code Analysis Reports and Security Evidence Packages

· Partner with product development teams to establish and maintain cybersecurity requirements, plans, policies, and best practices throughout the product lifecycle.

· Lead threat modeling activities and security architecture reviews for medical devices, software applications, cloud-hosted services, and interconnected systems.

· Perform and guide vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, fuzz testing, secure code analysis, and vulnerability scanning activities.

· Establish governance processes around product vulnerability management and cybersecurity risk management.

· Monitor threat intelligence, analyze emerging threats, CWEs, CVEs, and zero-day vulnerabilities, and assess potential impacts on products and platforms.

· Assess third-party software, open-source components, and off-the-shelf technologies for secure use within Baxter products and solutions.

· Drive cybersecurity improvements across cross-functional teams including Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Risk Management, Marketing, Clinical, Human Factors, Service, and Compliance.

· Ensure compliance with product development processes, quality systems, design controls, and applicable cybersecurity standards and regulations.

· Support annual security audits and assessments, including SOC 2, HITRUST, and other cybersecurity compliance initiatives.

· Participate in security incident investigations, response activities, and post-incident recovery efforts.

· Interface with regulatory agencies and external stakeholders as needed to represent cybersecurity aspects of Baxter products.

· Contribute to external cybersecurity communications including security bulletins, whitepapers, FAQs, and customer-facing documentation.

· Lead project planning, estimation, and execution of cybersecurity deliverables while mentoring and guiding junior engineers and technical teams.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, Mathematics, Information Management, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.

· 5+ years of experience in software development, cybersecurity engineering, product security, or secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) activities.

· Strong understanding of application security and secure development practices throughout the software lifecycle.

· Experience addressing OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and implementing secure coding practices.

· Experience performing threat modeling, security risk assessments, secure design reviews, and vulnerability analysis.

· Experience with threat modeling methodologies such as STRIDE, DREAD, LINDDUN, PASTA, or similar frameworks.

· Experience with vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, fuzz testing, and secure code analysis tools.

· Experience with security and software analysis tools such as Coverity, Black Duck, Fortify, Nessus, or equivalent technologies.

· Experience analyzing threat intelligence, CVEs, and CWEs and translating findings into actionable product improvements.

· Strong technical writing and communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Ability to influence technical direction, lead cross-functional initiatives, and drive decisions aligned with business objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with cybersecurity requirements for medical devices, connected healthcare systems, cloud platforms, and hosted software applications.

· Familiarity with security, privacy, and risk management frameworks including NIST 800-53, ISO 27001/27002, IEC TR 80001, UL 2900, FIPS 140, ICS-CERT guidance, and privacy-by-design principles.

· Expertise in designing secure networks, systems, cloud architectures, and application ecosystems.

· Security certifications such as CSSLP, CAP, CISSP, or equivalent.

Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a demonstrated ability to solve complex cybersecurity challenges.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Urdu (Romanized) Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Urdu (Romanized), and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Urdu (Romanized) and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Urdu (Romanized) experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Urdu (Romanized), written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Urdu (Romanized) speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

description:
Job Description

Job Title: Clinical Assistant Float

Department: Clinical Services/Practice Operations

Reports To: Clinic Manager/Physician

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Approval Date: June 12, 2026


Summary

The Clinical Assistant Float assists in the examination and treatment of patients under the direction of Peachtree Orthopedics physicians. The Clinical Assistant Float provides clinical and administrative support to ensure efficient patient flow, accurate documentation, and a safe, high-quality patient experience.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Travel between Peachtree Orthopedics locations and provide clinical support where operational needs are required. Maintain flexibility in provider, clinic, and team assignments.
  • Escort patients to exam areas and prepare patients and rooms for examination.
  • Interview patients to determine medical problems/conditions and document in the EMR (Athena), including Meaningful Use criteria as applicable.
  • Obtain and record patient vital signs and height. weight, and BMI.
  • Support physician orders, lab requests, imaging orders (including X-rays), and follow-up needs with patients.
  • Collect specimens (e.g., urine, blood) for testing and perform routine laboratory tests when applicable; prepare specimens/forms for lab processing.
  • Obtain patient history and assist with ordering X-rays as directed.
  • Schedule diagnostic studies and/or surgery; schedule pre- and post-operative appointments.
  • Prepare and assist with injections/aspirations; perform dressing changes and remove sutures/staples per protocol.
  • Apply/remove casts, splints, braces; fit/dispense DME
  • Complete e-charge when applicable.
  • Place Physical Therapy referrals for provider signature.
  • Provide patient education materials and instructions related to diagnosis, self-care/mobility, surgery, diagnostic studies, and equipment/casts.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA standards regarding bloodborne pathogens; monitor biohazardous waste and prepare for disposal.
  • Prepare prescriptions orders for signature and e-prescribe for physician approval.
  • Coordinate work-in appointments; communicate schedule changes and clinic cancellations to team members; assist with rescheduling clinics cancelled with less than 7 days’ notice.
  • Obtain X-ray and imaging results and store/import images in Joints; import outside discs into Joints; scan reports into Athena and match to close out orders.
  • Serve as liaison between patient and physician; coordinate consultations with other physicians.
  • Provide staff coverage for other clinical personnel; X-ray backup available for single-member teams when assigned.
  • Support administrative clinical documentation and forms (e.g., handicap parking permits, FMLA, disability forms, work excuses) as assigned.
  • Schedule OR cases and maintain surgery schedules; notify manufacturer reps of surgical cases and coordinate special equipment/bone graft needs.
  • Maintain supplies within modules; monitor biohazard waste; ensure compliance with OSHA bloodborne pathogen standards.
  • Wipe tables, change pillowcases, and straighten rooms as needed.
  • Attend meetings and perform other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

  • One year of related clinical experience and/or training preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Credentialed/licensed in one of the following (or equivalent): LPN, CMA/RMA, ROT/OTC, ATC, or CNA.
  • Strong communication, customer service, organizational, and EMR skills.


Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.


Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)-required.


Physical Demands & Work Environment

Employee must regularly stand, walk, lift and/or move up to 100 pounds, and assist patients with mobility as needed.


Peachtree Orthopedics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Supervisor-CO0330
description:
Warehouse Supervisor

Detroit, MI

Capstone is a leading North American supply chain solutions partner with more than 600 operating locations, 22,000 associates, and 60,000 carriers.
