This position offers a competitive salary, bonus potential and a benefit package after 30 days.

SCHEDULE: Monday – Friday; split shift so start time is either 4:30am or 7:30am depending on the day.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

This is the final step before taking over your own site. You will learn to represent Capstone with our Partners, manage day to day activates with associates, all the while ensuring that safety and productivity are always the focus. At this stage, you may be asked to run portions of the business or perhaps an entire shift. The Site Supervisor will train new hires and provide an environment that is team centric. This is the training opportunity to hone the skills necessary to run your own site. With the growth that Capstone has experienced over the past years, it could be sooner than you think!


DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Negotiation of rates with common carrier representatives
  • Running site with safety and efficiency as priorities
  • Writing and balancing daily bank deposits

  • Audit of daily labor and billing reports

  • Assist in managing Site and Departmental budget.

  • Interview, hire, and train new associates.

  • Complete daily closeout, including cash balancing, data upload, and payroll record administration according to Capstone policies and standard operating procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2 years of supervisory / leadership experience in an industrial setting.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal)

  • Ability to simultaneously perform multiple tasks.
  • Ability to solve problems and make effective decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to manage budgets; read and interpret P&L statements; and prepare related management reports.
  • Intermediate PC skills with knowledge of Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to stand for long period of times.
  • Ability to safely operate material handling equipment as needed.
  • Ability to work in warehouse environment on concrete flooring and in varying temperatures
  • Ability to lift up to 75 lbs.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

  • Warehousing, Logistics, Supply Chain or Third-Party experience preferred
  • BS/BA Degree or Associates Degree with Equivalent Experience is a plus but no required
  • Excellent interpersonal communication, leadership, and customer service skills.
  • The ability to make decisions, problem solve, prioritize assignments and direct the workforce in an ever-changing, warehouse environment.
  • Proven track record in supervision of warehouse employees including Hiring, Training, and Termination.
  • Experience with managing budgets and ability to create & maintain various management reports.
  • Intermediate computer experience, ideally with Microsoft products.
  • Excellent aptitude in estimating rates and adding and subtracting mentally while constantly multi-tasking.
  • College degree is a plus.

title: PK Laboratory Technician
description:
START Center for Cancer Research


START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest network of Phase I clinical trial sites, fully dedicated to oncology clinical research. Throughout our history, START has brought hope to cancer patients in communities around the world by providing access to cutting-edge clinical trials across the United States and Europe.

Today, with more than 1,300 studies conducted and research sites across the United States, Spain, Portugal, and Ireland, START’s mission is to accelerate the development of new cancer therapies that improve patients’ quality of life and survival, ultimately contributing to finding a cure for cancer. To date, more than 43 therapies studied at START sites have received FDA/EMA approval.


Open Position: PK (Pharmacokinetics) Laboratory Technician


This position is responsible for managing biological samples in Phase I clinical trials, ensuring their correct processing, storage, and shipment, including PK, PD, and other samples, in compliance with study protocols and laboratory requirements.


Responsibilities

  • Ensure compliance with clinical trial procedures.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of patient information and study protocols.
  • Collaborate with the research team throughout study processes.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of data recorded in source documents.
  • Order and manage sample collection kits, including receipt, registration, and storage.
  • Prepare, process, store, and ship PK, PD, and other biological samples according to study protocols.
  • Ensure the correct identification, labeling, and storage of samples.
  • Comply with applicable regulations and requirements for the handling and shipment of biological samples.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date sample and kit databases.
  • Organize and maintain the PK laboratory.
  • Participate in training activities and comply with the unit’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).


Requirements

  • Laboratory-related qualification, such as a Higher Vocational Training Diploma in Clinical and Biomedical Laboratory, or a similar qualification.
  • Previous experience in a laboratory environment or handling biological samples. Experience in clinical trials is considered an advantage.
  • Intermediate level of English and advanced Portuguese
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team and follow established procedures.


Details

  • Contract: Permanent
  • Working hours: 40 hours per week Monday to Friday
  • Work arrangement: 100% on-site
  • English classes: Free weekly virtual English classes in small groups of up to three participants

title: Tagalog Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Tagalog speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Tagalog speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Tagalog, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Tagalog and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Tagalog experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Tagalog, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Tagalog speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Retail and Consumer experts are dedicated to helping clients in an industry which is being transformed by new technologies and evolving consumer expectations. Leveraging over a decade of experience in Applied AI, we combine exceptional technical and delivery expertise to empower businesses to adapt and thrive.


About the role

As a delivery manager, you’ll own the end-to-end success of high-impact AI projects for our retail and consumer clients. You act as the crucial link between our customers and technical teams - we’ll look to you to balance technical possibility with feasibility, ensure we maximise value for our clients, and cultivate strong external relationships which position Faculty as the partner of choice for future projects.

What you'll be doing:

  • Owning the end-to-end delivery of customer projects, from initial scoping to final implementation

  • Collaborating with technical teams, and customers, to design innovative AI solutions that solve their challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Managing project development and ensuring a delivery approach that provides maximum value to the customer

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with customers; acting as the primary point of contact throughout the project lifecycle

  • Identifying new commercial opportunities and contributing to new business pitches and proposals

  • Developing and mentoring your peers; taking a proactive role in building good processes and practices

Who we're looking for:

  • You have previous experience in 0-1 AI/Digital transformation projects in the retail and consumer sector (preference for consulting services or CPG background)

  • You take full responsibility for the successful delivery of your projects, from initial scoping to end-user adoption

  • You're currently client-facing - trusted to help them navigate ambiguous situations, complex technical information and unexpected challenges

  • You are a clear communicator, with outstanding written and verbal skills, using these to instil confidence, bring clarity, and influence senior stakeholders

  • You are comfortable working with technical teams and have experience delivering technical projects

  • You know how to gauge possibility, and feasibility, and how to lead a team to balance vision and pragmatism

  • You are a practical problem-solver, identifying potential issues and proactively implementing solutions

Our interview process:

  1. Talent Team Screen (40 mins)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)

  4. Interview with Business Unit Director (30 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Financial Markets Client Control Senior Specialist
description:
Financial Markets Client Control Senior Specialist

FM Client Control

Work environment

Financial Markets Client Control (FMCC) is a department within Financial Markets (FM) Business Services (part of ING Wholesale Banking). The department consists of a Centre of Excellence (COE) in Amsterdam and two execution locations in ING Hubs Bratislava and Manila that provide services to 27 countries worldwide. The aim of these services is to ensure control throughout the client and counterparty life cycle (from on-boarding to exit and all processes in between) for FM and Group Treasury (GT). FMCC works using ING’s One Agile Way of Working principles.

Job Description

Financial Markets Client Control teams consist of self-steering teams for an individual with strong attention to detail, good communication skills, and coming up with own improvement’s idea.

As a Financial Markets Client Control Senior Specialist:

  • You maintain contact with Financial Market and Global Treasury Front Office desks via email and MS Teams channels. Coordinate the offboarding process and post-trade monitoring for clients actively trading on Financial Markets or with Global Treasury desks.
  • You serve as the main point of contact for global front office locations, sales locations, ING Hubs locations, and other back-office teams (e.g., Compliance, KYC, Business management).
  • Hold responsibility for onboarding of clients, and its compliancy with legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., KYC, MiFID, EMIR, SFTR, etc.), aiming for FM business continuity and company risk mitigation.
  • You collaborate with stakeholders and keep them informed about the progress of their requests.
  • You engage in FM related projects related to innovations and changes in a very dynamic environment.
  • You assist Sales, Front Office desks by identify their needs, and detecting potential technical and/ or functional issues in Financial Markets client control area applying the experience and knowledge to diagnose; prioritize, advise, and resolve cases.

Financial Markets Client Control plays a major role in communication and became one of ING’s central contact points for FM Sales, Global Treasury, and Front Office desks.

Main roles and responsibilities:

As Financial Markets Client Control Senior Specialist:

  • You execute daily operational tasks related to client control processes to ensure continuous client compliance with regulations in the financial markets
  • You govern the cooperation with stakeholders connected with client outreach communication
  • You focus on existing client portfolio and its compliancy with legal and regulatory requirements including CDD, MiFID, LEI, ESR, EMIR, SFTR and Dodd Frank, aiming for FM business continuity and company risk mitigation
  • You come up with improvement ideas and drive their implementation

Focus areas

As Financial Markets Client Control Senior Specialist, you are the gatekeeper for checking FM requirements on client compliance for trading (e.g., KYC, MiFID, EMIR, SFTR, Dodd Frank, etc.) and govern the client maintenance administrative process.

As Financial Markets Client Control Executive, you:

  • Are the first point of contact for Sales and Front Office desks and
  • Pro-actively manage communication with Front Office and Stakeholders.

We are looking for

An inspiring, energetic, and approachable colleague who displays the following behaviors:

  • Proactive work attitude with hands-on mentality.
  • Good team player.
  • Client-centric mindset with excellent communication skills and the ability to make connections.
  • Ability for data driven decision making and analytical skills.
  • Ability to cooperate with people at different levels inside and outside the company.
  • Ability to express information in appropriately to different levels of people & to lead negotiations.

Competencies and experience:

  • Previous experience with MiFID, EMIR, SFTR, Dodd Frank or other financial regulations is a significant advantage.
  • Fluent in English (verbal and written) with experience working in an international environment.
  • Experienced in client communication.
  • Skilled in Excel.
  • Presentation skills.

What’s in it for you?

ING is one of the most innovative and exciting digital banks in the world, with lots of opportunities to learn and grow. We offer you an interesting role with great responsibility, within a strong team in an international financial company with exposure to a variety of businesses.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
location: Vila Nova de Gaia, Porto, Portugal
description:
About iCliGo

iCliGo is an innovative platform connecting travelers with independent and highly qualified travel consultants. Founded in 2014, our Portuguese multinational has grown into a technology-driven company, committed to delivering seamless travel experiences while embracing a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

About the role

We are seeking a detail-oriented QA Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will be the analytical backbone of our quality process - translating requirements into thorough test coverage, running exploratory and functional testing across web and backend, and making sure defects are caught early and clearly understood. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to reduce risk and deliver a flawless travel experience to our customers.

Key responsibilities

  • Analyze requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to design clear, comprehensive test cases and test plans;

  • Perform exploratory, functional, and regression testing across web applications and backend services;

  • Define and maintain test scenarios in BDD/Gherkin that bridge business intent and engineering;

  • Apply risk-based testing to prioritize coverage where it matters most;

  • Identify, document, and track bugs; perform root-cause analysis and collaborate with developers to resolve them;

  • Validate data integrity across relational and non-relational databases using SQL;

  • Maintain and report on QA metrics (coverage, defect trends) to support release decisions;

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes and best practices across the development lifecycle.

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field;

  • 3+ years of experience as a QA Analyst, Software Tester, or in a similar role;

  • Strong command of test design techniques (equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision tables);

  • Experience with test management tools (e.g., TestRail, Xray, or Zephyr);

  • Hands-on experience testing APIs for validation (e.g., Postman);

  • Good understanding of relational and non-relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL/MySQL and MongoDB) and SQL for test validation;

  • Familiarity with BDD/Gherkin and agile delivery;

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail;

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a hybrid/remote team.

Nice to have

  • ISTQB certification (Foundation or higher);

  • Exposure to test automation tools (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium);

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control (Git);

  • Awareness of performance/load testing concepts.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience and expertise;

  • Private health insurance;

  • Meal allowance;

  • 2 extra days of annual leave (including your birthday off);

  • Hybrid working model;

  • Monthly utility allowance to support your remote working arrangement;

  • Access to the Udemy academy;

  • Travel perks at net rates.

Etsitkö monipuolista työtä rakennusalalta, jossa pääset käärimään hihat ja oppimaan uutta? Haluatko osaksi hyvää työporukkaa, jossa oikeanlainen asenne ratkaisee?
Asiakasyrityksemme etsii oma-aloitteisia ja ahkeria rakennusapulaisia. Työsuhde solmitaan Visio Yritys Oy:n kanssa. Itse työ tapahtuu kuitenkin asiakkaamme työmailla Oulun alueella.


Tehtävän kuvaus

Työssäsi tulet toimimaan korvaamattomana apuna rakennustyömaalla. Tehtäväsi ovat erittäin monipuolisia ja vaihtelevat päivittäisen tarpeen mukaan. Työpäivääsi voi kuulua esimerkiksi avustavia rakennustöitä, materiaalien kantamista ja järjestelyä, työmaan puhtaanapitoa ja siivousta sekä työkaluissa avustamista. Tässä työssä yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen!


Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö
Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:
  • Aiempi kokemus tai alan koulutus – eduksesi katsotaan aikaisempi työmaakokemus, mutta vähintään alan perusperiaatteiden tulee olla sinulle entuudestaan tuttuja.
  • Reipas ja tarttuva työote – työmaalla riittää hommaa, joten oma-aloitteisuus ja halu oppia ovat tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksiasi.
  • Hyvä fyysinen kunto – työ on aktiivista ja sisältää raskaidenkin tavaroiden kantamista sekä liikkumista.
  • Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti – turvallisuus työmaalla on meille ykkösasia, joten työturvallisuuskortti tulee löytyä taskusta.
  • Suomen kielen taito – kykenet ymmärtämään työmaan turvaohjeistukset ja kommunikoimaan sujuvasti tiimin kanssa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, että työsopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

  • Palkka määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella, vähintään Rakennusalan (Talonrakennus) TES:n mukaan.
  • Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
  • Perehdytyksen työhön.
  • Jokaiseen työtehtävään soveltuvat työvarusteet.
  • Päivittäisen tuen työasioissa.
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.
  • Hyville tyypeille on aina kysyntää ja autamme sinua löytämään uusia töitä määräaikaisen työsuhteen päättyessä.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Hakemuksia tulee paljon, ja jotta hakuprosessi on kaikille reilu, voimme ottaa huomioon vain järjestelmässä tehdyt hakemukset.

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

  • liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
  • kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit soittaa rekrytoinnista vastaavalle henkilöille:

Maija 050 552 1686

Olen tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-16.00.

Arvostamme, että puhelussa kysyt vain työtehtävään liittyviä asioita. Jätä esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Pohjois-Pohjanmaalla työpaikkaa, siinä auttaa sinua Oulusta käsin Maija.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Pohjois-Pohjanmaa on osa Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua peliä ja tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyö perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

description:
Dublin (hybrid), with candidates elsewhere in Ireland considered. Full-time, permanent.

The Role

We're looking for an engineer who builds with AI daily, can make technical calls with confidence, and brings strong leadership and clear thinking to the work.

Coastline Gaming operates 11 venues across Ireland plus Slotbox online casino, and bring a startup mindset to building an established and growing business. The directors use Claude Code in their own work—you won't be persuading anyone that AI-assisted building is worth doing. You'll be joining people already doing it and expected to push it further than they have.

Working across online gaming and physical venues gives you an unusual mix of product and engineering challenges. You'll help build the digital customer experience and the software used on the ground, with access to the people using both. You'll have a hand in the early decisions on new builds as well as improving existing products. The role gives you room to take responsibility for projects while staying involved in the engineering yourself.

What You'll Do

  • Build customer-facing applications and new frontends for our online casino brands.
  • Develop APIs and integrations that connect our customer products and business systems.
  • Work with staff to find where better software would help, then build internal tools that solve those problems.
  • Help set technical direction: how systems fit together, which architecture makes sense, and when to build, adapt or buy.
  • Manage several projects at once, agree priorities with the directors and give engineers clear ownership of the work.
  • Help other engineers work through difficult problems, review code and improve how the team builds with AI.

What We're Looking For

  • You build with AI daily. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent tools are central to how you work. You try new approaches, know where they help and can show us what you've built.
  • You get to grips with unfamiliar systems quickly. You ask useful questions, test your assumptions and know when to ask someone who knows more.
  • You can challenge a brief. You work out whether it solves the right problem and can explain a simpler approach when there is one.
  • You've managed people and several projects while continuing to build yourself. You can explain what needed your attention, what you delegated and how you handled problems. Managing a small team counts.
  • You've earned broader responsibility within an organisation and can show what changed as you took on more. Experience building and leading in a startup or smaller team is particularly relevant.
  • You can make technical decisions and explain the trade-offs. You understand what a change means for the users and the other systems involved.
  • You judge your own work. You check AI-generated changes, look for what could fail and change your approach when the evidence calls for it.

Working Here

Compensation is open for the right person. You must already be based in Ireland and have the right to work in the Republic of Ireland. The main office is in Dublin and the role is hybrid; we'll consider the right person elsewhere in Ireland.

title: Senior Java Backend Engineer (Core Java, Trading Systems)
company: Vistulo (for a major N. American bank)
description:
Join the Java Engineering Team at a top N. American Bank

Are you a Java engineer who enjoys working on large scale and high performance software? Do you love working with smart people on meaningful technology? Want to work in capital markets on financial trading systems? If so, read on.

The Role at a Glance

  • Senior Java Backend Engineer
  • Fully remote for a top N. American bank (for residents of Poland or Romania)
  • Openings on multiple teams in the capital markets division (prime brokerage, platform team)
  • Part of the core team - this is not a legacy support role or an outsourced B team

We’re hiring experienced backend engineers (6+ years) to join a major N. American bank — directly supporting the development of financial trading systems. This is not a legacy maintenance or support role — you’ll be part of the core product team, building highly-performant, low-latency systems used across the firm.

Are you a passionate Java developer who thrives on solving complex problems in low-latency, high-throughput trading systems? Join us and work on interesting financial system engineering problems.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on a large-scale, low-latency trading system processing millions of daily transactions.
  • No Legacy: Join an actively developed system — the engineers who built it originally are still on the team.
  • Collaborate with a world-class team of developers across North America and Europe.
  • Enjoy the stability of a long-term, fully remote role that only a bank can offer.

A successful candidate will be a very strong programmer with current Java development experience. They must also be curious, open-minded, and desire to learn new things. English proficiency is a must.

This role is for developers who excel at programming core Java from the ground up, not just integrating frameworks or APIs. If you’re fascinated by understanding systems ‘under the hood,’ this role is for you. Successful candidates enjoy geeking out about data structures and debugging application performance issues.

This is a fully remote backend Java development role for a developer in Poland or Romania. You will be working through a Polish company that will provide the support and administrative assistance to make you successful in the role. We are looking for people to join the team long-term.

Different teams have different working hour arrangements. For all roles, to ensure efficient onboarding, you’ll work in sync with the American team during US Eastern business hours for the first two months. Working this way maximizes your time overlap for answering questions, which means you can learn quickly. That means working until 21:00 CET. After that, some teams offer more flexibility your schedule can shift closer to standard Polish business hours.

Only open to residents of Poland and Romania. Citizens and legal residents with permission to work in Poland or Romania are welcome.

What we offer

  • Work that matters in the financial domain: Work on a trading system at an established financial institution, processing millions of transactions daily.
  • Professional growth: Collaborate with smart, highly capable developers in a supportive and challenging environment.
  • Direct collaboration: You will work directly with the client team in North America and in Europe.
  • 1st-tier work: This is not a technical support or legacy maintenance role. The system is functional and is actively being built and you will take part in updating it. The people who built the system are still part of the team.
  • Long-term commitment: This is not a fixed-scope or fixed-term outsourcing role; we value people who want to grow and contribute long-term.
  • Flexibility & remote work: Fully remote position with increasing schedule flexibility post-onboarding.
  • Competitive Compensation: Above-average pay and ample time-off options.

Must have

  • Strong understanding of programming concepts, including algorithms, complexity, and data structures.
  • Good knowledge of the data structures in the Java standard library - both breadth and internals.
  • Experience building distributed service-based applications based on message queues.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, to effectively diagnose production performance issues measured in microseconds.
  • Open mind, curiosity, and a strong desire to learn new technologies and business domains.
  • Ability to clearly explain non-trivial systems and algorithms.
  • Ability to follow and understand technical conversations.
  • Know when and how to ask questions that speed up learning.
  • Ability to align your working schedule to US Eastern business hours.

Nice to have

  • Experience with financial markets and trading systems.
  • Knowledge of AWS systems.
  • Experience with Spring boot (some teams).
  • Experience with JVM tuning (some teams).
  • Experience working remotely with North American firms.
  • A computer science degree from a top school.

description:

title: Senior Java Engineer (Trading Systems)
company: Vistulo (for a major N. American bank)
description:
Want to work on trading systems at a top N. American Bank

This isn’t just another dev role. It’s your chance to engineer the core of global trading.

We’re talking ultra-low-latency architectures, real-time market data, and automation at scale — all in an environment where milliseconds matter and billions move. You’ll work on greenfield and semi-greenfield projects, building trading systems for equities, options, FX (forex), and more.

If you thrive on complexity, love solving performance challenges under pressure, and want to collaborate directly with traders and product teams at the sharp edge of financial technology, this is your arena.

The Role at a Glance

  • Senior Java Backend Engineer
  • Building trading systems, including high-performance backend services for algorithmic order management and order routing (multiple projects & various asset classes)
  • Fully remote for a top N. American bank (for residents of Poland or Romania)
  • Part of the core team - this is not a legacy support role or an outsourced B team

This role requires experience building trading systems, ideally with order routing or algorithmic order management. Some capital markets experience is required.

If you enjoy working on low-latency, high-throughput trading systems, join us and build the next generation of high-performance capital markets solutions.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on a large-scale, low-latency trading system.
  • No Legacy: Join an actively developed system — the engineers who built it originally are still on the team.
  • Collaborate with a world-class team of developers across North America and Europe.
  • Enjoy the stability of a long-term, fully remote role that only a bank can offer.

A successful candidate will be a very strong programmer with current Java development experience. They must also be curious, open-minded, and desire to learn new things. English proficiency is a must.

This role is for developers who excel at programming core Java from the ground up, not just integrating frameworks or APIs. If you’re fascinated by understanding systems ‘under the hood,’ this role is for you. Successful candidates enjoy geeking out about data structures and debugging application performance issues.

This is a fully remote backend Java development role for a developer in Poland or Romania. You will be working through a Polish company that will provide the support and administrative assistance to make you successful in the role. We are looking for people to join the team long-term.

Only open to residents of Poland and Romania. Citizens and legal residents with permission to work in Poland or Romania are welcome.

What we offer

  • Work that matters in the financial domain: You’ll be building a high-performance trading system at an established financial institution.
  • Professional growth: Collaborate with smart, highly capable developers in a supportive and challenging environment.
  • Direct collaboration: You will work directly with the client team in North America and in Europe.
  • 1st-tier work: This is not a technical support or legacy maintenance role. The system is functional and is actively being built and you will take part in updating it. The people who built the system are still part of the team.
  • Long-term commitment: This is not a fixed-scope or fixed-term outsourcing role; we value people who want to grow and contribute long-term.
  • Flexibility & remote work: Fully remote position with increasing schedule flexibility post-onboarding.
  • Competitive Compensation: Top pay and ample time-off options.

Must have

  • Current Java programming experience, with a strong understanding of programming concepts, including algorithms, complexity, and multi-threading, and Java’s language capabilities and standard libraries.
  • Good knowledge of the data structures: familiarity with the Java collections framework, depth of understanding of the commonly used data structures, intuition on what to use when.
  • Proven experience building backend services for front-office trading systems.
  • Deep understanding of front-office workflows and electronic trading platforms (any asset class).
  • Built or contributed to the algorithmic order management systems or order routing systems (any asset class).
  • Expertise in multi-threading, event-driven systems, and performance tuning.
  • Ability to break down complex workflows into maintainable, high-quality solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working in high-stakes, trader-facing environments.
  • Knowledge that is required for building low-latency (measured in microseconds) trading systems.
  • Ability to align your work with a 6-hour overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to time-series databases and market data integration.
  • Familiarity with algorithmic workflows and pricing engines.
  • A computer science degree from a top school.

Etsimme tehtävään henkilöä, jolla on soveltuva korkeakoulutus kone-, sähkö- tai automaatiotekniikasta, erityisesti sähkötekniikan tuntemus katsotaan eduksi. TruTekniikka tarjoaa sinulle vakituisen työsuhteen ja etuina saat lounas- ja virike-edun, työajoihin pakettiauton ja perushammashuollon sekä työterveyshuollon Mehiläisessä.

title: Annotation Specialist
description:
Team Description:
Kitware’s computer vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. Our solutions embrace deep learning and add measurable value to government agencies, commercial organizations, and academic institutions worldwide. We understand the difficulties in extracting, interpreting, and utilizing information across images, video, metadata, and text, and we recognize the need for robust, affordable solutions. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms.

As an Annotation Specialist, you will work on a team of dedicated individuals alongside our R&D Engineers and Researchers to advance the state-of-the-art in computer vision. Annotation is critical to the success of many of our computer vision projects; the annotations are used in scoring and evaluating our work as well as training our algorithms. Kitware’s Annotation team provides the key data annotation support within our computer vision team to meet these needs. The team uses a variety of software tools to label objects, activities, events, and other items of interest in images and video.

This is an as-needed, project-dependent position with variable hours. Work availability will ebb and flow based on project needs, and a set number of hours each week is not guaranteed. The position requires flexibility to work on-site at Kitware’s headquarters in Clifton Park, NY when project needs require it, including work in a specialized facility. This position will also require obtaining the necessary government clearances.

In This Position You Will:

  • Use a variety of desktop and web-based software tools to review picture and video sources to identify objects, activities, events, and other items of interest to Computer Vision Researchers in images and video.
  • Perform diverse, detailed annotations in the form of bounding boxes, polygon segmentation, and metadata markups in accordance with established group procedures and a high degree of accuracy.
  • Work with custom in-house software to troubleshoot bugs and optimize the annotation process.
  • Learn new tools and/or technologies as necessary to follow team workflow and accomplish annotation tasks.
  • Use an agile workflow for tracking responsibilities and task progress, including git for task/issue tracking.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment that evolves regularly in response to changing research and customer needs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Willing to learn new tools or programs as project needs evolve and workflows change.
  • Comfortable being proactive and asking questions or for clarification when needed.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) or Google Suite.
  • Excellent customer service focus and communication skills, both oral and written; ability to effectively communicate with multiple individuals in varying levels of the organization.
  • Ability to maintain confidential data.
  • Good interpersonal skills and a team player.
  • High school degree required, advanced degree preferred.
  • Flexibility to work variable, project-dependent hours. Work may be available regularly during active project periods, while other periods may have limited or no hours. A minimum or set number of weekly hours is not guaranteed.
  • Ability and willingness to work on-site at Kitware’s headquarters in Clifton Park, NY when required by project needs.
  • If not already cleared TS/SCI, willingness and ability to apply for and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance.
  • Due to contractual requirements, this position requires U.S. citizenship.
Company Description:
Kitware is a research and development software solutions provider with a mission to advance science, make a positive impact, and share our results all within a collaborative, employee-focused work environment that is friendly, fair, and flexible. Our work is improving healthcare outcomes, increasing national security, and advancing our national computing infrastructure. Our customers and collaborators include top universities from around the world, government organizations, national research labs, medical device manufacturers, car manufacturers, financial institutions, and many others.
Kitware is proud to be 100% employee-owned.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE), EU Stores
description:
Are you passionate about using data to drive business decisions at massive scale? EU Vendor Intelligence is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to help power Amazon's growth and profitability across European markets.

In this role, you will tackle difficult, loosely defined business problems across key retail programs including Selection and Vendor Management. You will partner closely with Program Managers and Vendor Managers — not just answering their questions, but refining problems, recommending alternatives, and anticipating future analytical needs. You will own mid-to-large BI solutions end-to-end: from data modelling and pipeline design to dashboards and deep-dive analyses that drive real business decisions.

What you'll do:
• Design robust, maintainable data models and pipelines that power reporting and analytics for EU-wide retail programs
• Write advanced SQL and leverage scripting (e.g. Python) to solve difficult analytical problems and automate BI processes
• Build compelling visualizations and self-service reporting that reduce bottlenecks and put data directly into stakeholders' hands
• Develop a deep understanding of data lineage — from source systems through metrics aggregation to how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (PMs, VMs, Data Engineers, other BIEs) to deliver solutions that balance business needs with technology constraints
• Improve code quality, optimize BI processes for speed, cost, and reliability, and mentor teammates

This is a high-visibility role where your analytical rigor and business acumen will directly influence how Amazon grows selection and manages vendor relationships across Europe. You'll work in an environment that values high-quality, well-documented solutions — and gives you the autonomy to deliver them.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the design, build, and maintenance of mid-to-large BI solutions — data models, ETL pipelines, dashboards, and analyses — supporting EU Stores retail programs such as Selection and Vendor Management
• Write advanced SQL and Python to solve difficult, loosely defined analytical problems and automate recurring BI processes
• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of data lineage: source systems, metrics aggregation logic, and how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon by stakeholders
• Partner with Program Managers, Vendor Managers, and cross-functional teams to refine business requirements, recommend analytical approaches, and anticipate future needs
• Build self-service reporting and visualization solutions that reduce bottlenecks and empower business partners to access data independently
• Ensure all solutions are efficient, testable, maintainable, well-documented, and resistant to data quality issues
• Optimize BI processes for speed, cost, and reliability; establish data and reporting SLAs where appropriate
• Mentor junior team members and contribute to team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions


A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a data pipeline you built, checking for anomalies before a weekly business review. By mid-morning, you're in a working session with a Vendor Manager, refining requirements for a new selection coverage analysis. After lunch, you're writing SQL to model vendor performance data, then building a QuickSight dashboard that lets Program Managers self-serve insights without waiting on ad-hoc requests. Later, you review a teammate's code, suggest a cleaner data model, and wrap up by automating a manual reporting step that's been slowing the team down.

About the team
The EU Vendor Intelligence Team builds BI solutions and capabilities that empower business users to self-serve their analytics and data needs across EU Stores. We support a wide variety of programs — from selection growth and vendor management to vendor education and vendor-facing chatbot tools. Our mission is to make data accessible, reliable, and actionable so that Program Managers and Vendor Managers can make faster, better-informed decisions at scale. We value automation over manual work, clean data models over quick fixes, and strong partnerships with the business teams we serve.

Are you passionate about open-source technologies or solving distributed computing problems at scale? Do you love learning and working with a diverse range of technologies and people?

We’re looking for a collaborative and curious Mid/Senior Software Engineer to join our development team at NetApp Instaclustr ().

NetApp Instaclustr Our mission at NetApp Instaclustr () is to make it easy for customers around the globe to run powerful open-source applications at scale - like Cassandra, Kafka, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Cadence, and ClickHouse, across both on-premises data-centres and in the cloud. The NetApp Instaclustr development team is responsible for building, maintaining and operating the platform that allows us to provision and reliably keep thousands of distributed application servers running worldwide.

What You Will Do

  • Work within a development team of 3-8 engineers, to build, maintain, and enhance our open-source application platform, which takes care of the whole lifecycle: provisioning infrastructure, installing applications and, most importantly, keeping the applications running reliably in production.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of the whole development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing and deployment through to our production environments.
  • Lead the design and implementation of the more complex development initiatives
  • Mentor junior engineers within your team, assisting with developing their skills

  • A curious mindset with a keen interest in how your work will positively impact customers.

Generous other benefits, including:

title: Founding Engineer
description:
Build the future of architecture

1zu100 is automating construction planning. Together with exceptional architecture firms, we plan multi-unit residential buildings and deliver completed, permitted plans as a service.

TL;DR

We are looking for one cracked founding engineer to build the AI that plans large residential buildings end to end: the agent harness, the data and context layer, and the evals. You work in a small, high-agency team on real projects that ship right away.

The core of the role

  • Harness engineering: You build and run the layer around the model end to end: memory, tool orchestration, verification, drawing and document generation, so the output stays consistent and code-compliant at scale.

  • Data and context: You turn messy planning data (CAD/BIM models, PDFs, site surveys, building codes) into the right context at every phase, always traceable back to its source.

  • Evals and benchmarks: You build the eval harness (datasets, regression tests) and measure our agents against the architectural rule sets and judgment calls.

  • BIM and IFC automation: You connect to the architect's toolchain (Revit, ArchiCAD, IFC) to drive automated modeling and clean interoperability.

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on experience with harness engineering: agents, tool orchestration, evals.

  • High agency and an entrepreneurial drive. Ideally you have founded before or want to. You find the work yourself and move fast.

  • Experience in a high-growth environment (startup, scale-up or similar).

  • Nice to have: German, Revit, IFC or Grasshopper, a non-linear CV and experiments with reinforcement learning (MCTS, GRPO, RLHF) or diffusion models (discrete and continuous).

What we offer

  • A fast-paced environment at a fast-growing startup, with a steep learning curve

  • Competitive salary and a stake in the company, with first-hire upside

  • Real projects that ship right away

  • You build right alongside the founders, in the same codebase on the same hard problems

  • Wellpass and unlimited coffee from a professional barista

We're a small team with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and change the way construction planning is done, you're the one we need.

How we hire

  1. Apply here.

  2. An intro call with the founders.

  3. A technical interview.

  4. A trial day on-site in Munich. We pick a problem together and build it side by side.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Indonesian Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Indonesian speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Indonesian speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Indonesian, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Indonesian and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Indonesian experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Indonesian, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Indonesian speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

· Proven ability to manage P&L, productivity metrics, utilisation targets, resource planning, quality governance, stakeholder communication, technical reviews, and enterprise client relationships.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, Lähderannan päiväkoti
description:
Lähderannan päiväkoti sijaitsee rauhallisella pientaloalueella, hyvien retkeily- ja ulkoilumaastojen keskellä läntisessä Leppävaarassa. Päiväkodissamme on seitsemän lapsiryhmää 1-6-vuotiaille lapsille. Haussa on varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan sijaisuus ajalle 19.10.2026 - 31.1.2027 Mansikoiden ryhmässä, jossa on 3-5-vuotiaita lapsia. Toimit toisen opettajan työparina ja ryhmässä toimii teidän lisäksenne varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja ja avustaja.

Haemme yksikköömme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa, joka on innostunut lasten ja perheiden kanssa työskentelystä sekä hyvinvoinnin edistämisestä ja vahvuuksien tukemisesta. Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana vastaat oman tiimisi pedagogiikan toteutumisesta yhdessä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa. Toimit myös tiimisi vetäjänä ja pedagogisen tiimin jäsenenä ja pääset toteuttamaan vahvaa ammattiosaamistasi yhdessä koko yhteisön kanssa. Havainnointi, dokumentointi ja toiminnan jatkuva arviointi sekä kehittäminen kuuluvat jokaisen työhön kiinteästi. Tässä työssä pääset toteuttamaan itseäsi ja saat vaikuttaa omien työpäiviesi sisältöön tuomalla ideoitasi ja vahvuuksiasi käytäntöön.

Lähderannan päiväkodissa arvostamme lämminhenkistä, sensitiivistä sekä positiivista työotetta, jossa lapset kohdataan yksilöllisesti sekä kunnioittavasti. Työskentelemme lasten mielenkiinnonkohteista sekä tarpeista käsin, arvostaen vanhempien osallisuutta ja asiantuntijuutta lastensa asioissa. Hyödynnämme lähialueen toiminta- ja oppimisympäristöjä arjen toiminnassa, liikumme, retkeilemme ja ulkoilemme paljon.

Henkilöstöä yhdistää sitoutuneisuus, motivaatio, vahva ammattitaito ja pedagogiikka sekä ymmärrys varhaiskasvatustyön merkityksellisyydestä. Yksiköissä vallitsee positiivinen, kehitysmyönteinen ja toiset huomioiva ilmapiiri. Panostamme työhyvinvontiin ja yhdessä tekemiseen. Osaamista jaetaan, toisia tuetaan ja yhdessä innostutaan kehittämään. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen otetaan lämpimästi vastaan ja työtä tehdään toisia tukien. Jos nämä asiat tuntuvat omiltasi, sovit meille erinomaisesti.
Lähderannan päiväkodissa toimii Espoon uusi apulaisjohtajamalli, joka vahvistaa henkilökunnan pedagogista tukea. Apulaisjohtajamallilla pyritään siihen, että johtamisen resurssit varhaiskasvatusyksiköissä vahvistuvat, jolloin henkilöstö saa työlleen riittävän tuen ja arki varhaiskasvatuksessa sujuu entistä paremmin.

Lähderannassa saat opettajana toisen opettajan mentoriksi / työpariksesi. Espoo tarjoaa myös sinulle mentorointiohjelman aloittaessasi varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan työt. Mentorointiryhmän tuella espoolainen varhaiskasvatus tulee sinulle tutuksi ja opit tunnistamaan omat vahvuutesi ja osaamisesi. Samalla saat aineksia omaan ammatilliseen kasvuun ja työhyvinvointiin. Pääset keskustelemaan kokeneen mentorin kanssa uran alkuvaiheeseen liittyvistä iloista ja haasteista, ja tutustut myös muihin varhaiskasvatuksen opettajina aloitteleviin kollegoihin.

Työsuhde-etuuksina tarjoamme mm. työsuhdematkalippuetuuden, 100 ilmaista uintikertaa Espoon uimahalleissa vuodessa, sportti- ja kulttuuriedun, lukuisia harraste- ja liikuntaryhmiä ja taloudellista tukea kouluttautumiseen.
Tervetuloa iloiseen joukkoomme!

Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Lähderannan päiväkoti, Lähdepurontie 3, 02720 Espoo
Työaika: 38 h 15 min/viikko
Tehtävä on määräaikainen ajalle 19.10.2026 - 31.1.2027.

Kelpoisuusvaatimus: Varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukainen kelpoisuus.

Vähintään kasvatustieteen kandidaatin tutkinto, johon sisältyy varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan koulutus, tai sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto (varhaiskasvatus) tai aikaisempi vastaava opistotasoinen tutkinto, esim. lastentarhanopettajan tai sosiaalikasvattajan tutkinto (laki 272/2005 ja asetus nro 608/2005).

Haussa huomioidaan myös juuri valmistuvat varhaiskasvatuksen opettajat.

Edellytämme yhteistyötaitoja.
Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6.2 §:n tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote.
Tartuntatautilaki velvoittaa alle kouluikäisten kanssa työskentelevien tuberkuloositartuntariskin selvittämisen.

Arvostamme kykyä kohdata lapset ja heidän vanhempansa yksilöllisesti, arvostavasti ja sensitiivisesti.

Tervetuloa joukkoomme kasvattamaan vastuullista ja välittävää uutta sukupolvea!


Edelläkävijöiden Espoo - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää

Espoo on edelläkävijöiden kaupunki. Työnantajalupauksemme - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää - näkyy arjessamme sujuvana työnä, osaamisen pitkäjänteisenä kehittämisenä ja fiksuna johtamisena. Rakennamme yhdessä kaupunkia, jossa työn merkitys on selkeä ja asiantuntijuutta arvostetaan.

Tuemme ammatillista oppimistasi ja kehittymistäsi sekä työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamista joustavilla käytännöillä.

Toimintamme perustuu avoimuuteen ja luottamukseen, ja kohtaamme toisemme arvostavasti. Olemme sitoutuneet yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseen ja toivomme työyhteisöömme eri-ikäisiä, eri taustoista ja eri kieliä puhuvia osaajia.

Tehtävään ja hakuprosessiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit olla yhteydessä tehtävän lisätietojen antajaan.

Erityistarpeisiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit ottaa yhteyttä: keha.rekrytointi@espoo.fi. Käsittelemme yhteydenotot luottamuksellisesti.

Lue lisää: https://www.esitteemme.fi/espoonrekry/MailView/

title: Electronics Development Engineer (m/f/*)
description:
For over 15 years, PIDSO has been developing high-performance communication solutions “Made in Austria” – built for environments where failure is not an option.

Our antenna and RF systems enable reliable data transmission and signal processing in mission-critical applications across aerospace, defense, motorsport, automotive, and Industry 4.0.

We combine research, development, manufacturing, and testing under one roof. Fast, focused, and with uncompromising attention to detail.

Location: Vienna

Division: R&D

Reporting Line: Head of R&D

Language: English (must), German (plus)

Tasks

The Mission

As an Electronics Development Engineer, you develop electronic assemblies from schematic design and component selection through PCB layout to prototype bring-up and verification.

Projects range from compact integration boards to complex FPGA/SoC-based mainboards for Radar and SATCOM systems. You will work closely with RF engineers, embedded software developers and mechanical designers to create robust, manufacturable hardware.

We are open to different levels of experience: experienced engineers can take end-to-end ownership, while motivated engineers earlier in their career will grow into that responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Circuit & PCB Design: Select components, create schematics, maintain component and footprint libraries, and design PCB layouts using Altium Designer.
  • High-Speed, Power & EMC: Develop robust hardware with signal integrity, suitable power supply topologies and sequencing, thermal design and EMC in mind.
  • Prototyping & Verification: Bring up and debug new hardware, perform measurements and modify prototypes using soldering iron, hot air and rework equipment.
  • Manufacturing & Integration: Work with PCB manufacturers, assembly partners, RF engineers, embedded software developers and mechanical designers throughout development and production.
  • Requirements & Quality: Work against environmental and system requirements, identify missing or conflicting constraints, document design decisions and verify the implemented hardware in an EN9100-oriented development environment.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • BSc/MSc in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a comparable field.
  • Solid foundation in electronic circuit design and practical hardware development.
  • Ability to understand interactions between electrical, thermal and mechanical design constraints.
  • Hands-on engineering mindset and willingness to investigate problems directly on the hardware.
  • Structured, curious and pragmatic approach to engineering, with the ability to question unclear requirements and take ownership of technical decisions.

Strong Plus

Experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • RF / microwave electronics
  • FPGA / SoC-based hardware
  • High-speed digital design and signal integrity
  • Spectrum analyzers, VNAs or advanced laboratory measurement equipment
  • Aerospace, defence or another reliability-focused development environment

Benefits

Why Join Us?

At PIDSO, you don’t just design a PCB and hand it over. You develop electronics that become part of advanced antenna, Radar and SATCOM systems — from the first design decision to a tested, manufactured product.

You’ll work hands-on with sophisticated hardware, collaborate closely with specialists across RF, embedded software and mechanical engineering, and have the opportunity to take real technical ownership. Short decision paths and direct collaboration mean your ideas and engineering decisions have a visible impact on the final product.

What else you can expect:

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work
  • Modern workplace in Vienna with excellent public transport connections
  • Free parking directly at the company
  • Subsidised lunch with a wide daily selection
  • Regular team events and company activities
  • International, highly skilled team with short decision paths
  • A growing Austrian technology company working on demanding international projects

Real hardware. Real ownership. Engineering that goes beyond PCB layout.

Salary

For this position, the minimum salary according to the Kollektivvertrag Metallgewerbe (Verwendungsgruppe III, after 4 years) is € 3.109,21 gross per month, with a clear willingness to overpay based on your existing projects and technical skills.

Interested?

Send us your application (Cover Letter, CV)!

Please include your name and the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to hearing from you! 🚀

title: Kassa-myyjä jouluavuksi, Sipoo Söderkulla (määräaikainen 20 h/vko)
description:
Tokmannin halvat hinnat tuottavat iloa ja hyötyä, sekä helpottavat asiakkaan elämää. Työskentelemme yhdessä tämän tavoitteen puolesta ja tarjoamme asiakkaillemme halvan hinnan lisäksi myös sujuvan ja nopean asioinnin myymälöissämme sekä laajan ja vastuullisesti hankitun ja tuotetun tuotevalikoiman. Tokmanni Group Oyj on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista halpakauppakonserneista. Onnistuneen asiakaskokemuksen takaamiseksi työskentelemme yli 6000 työntekijän voimin yhteensä yli 370:ssä Tokmanni-, Dollarstore-, Bigdollar-, Miny-, Click Shoes- ja Shoe House -myymälässämme sekä verkkokaupoissamme. Vuonna 2023 Tokmanni-konsernin liikevaihto oli 1 392,7 miljoonaa euroa ja vertailukelpoinen liikevoitto 98,8 miljoonaa euroa. Tokmanni Group Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingin pörssilistalle. Meille tokmannilaisille on tärkeää, että toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä välittäen. Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Etsimme joukkoomme erilaisilla osaamistaustoilla varustettuja henkilöitä monenlaisiin työtehtäviin. www.tokmanni.fi https://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/

Hei!

Kaipaatko tulevaan talveesi jotakin uutta ja haluat ansaita lisätienestejä esimerkiksi opintojen ohella? Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden joustavalle työnteolle monipuolisessa ja vauhdikkaassa työympäristössä!

Haemme Sipoo Söderkullan Tokmannin iloiseen joukkoon asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja aidosti positiivista kassa-myyjää, jolla on intoa työskennellä kaupan alalla joulusesongin parissa.

Tehtävät keskittyvät kassatyöhön sekä asiakaspalveluun kassalla ja infossa. Osastopuolen tehtäviin kuuluu mm. tuotteiden vastaanottoa ja hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myymälässämme asioivien asiakkaidemme auttaminen erilaisissa kysymyksissä, ja aina autamme myös toisiamme, kun tiimissä tarvitaan apua.

Tehtävä on 3 kuukauden mittainen määräaikaisuus. Työ alkaa 12.10.2026 ja työaika on 20 h/vko. Sinulla on meillä työskennellessäsi myös mahdollisuus tehdä osa sopimuksesi tunneista tai lisätunteja työskentelemällä lähimyymälöissäsi. Täytämme tehtävän heti, kun löydämme sopivan työkaverin joukkoomme, joten toimithan pian!



Voit olla etsimämme työkaveri, jos olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on:

- Iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne
- Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää
- Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä
- Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli
- Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin
- Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen - Kyky palvella asiakkaitamme suomenkielellä; hyvä englannin kielen taito lasketaan eduksi

Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
- Yhdessä tekemistä ja onnistumista
- Avointa, kannustavaa ja mukavaa työyhteisöä
- Ihmisistä ja ympäristöstä välittämistä
- Kilpailukykyistä palkkaa ja henkilöstöetuja
- Valmennus- ja koulutusmahdollisuuksia
- Uusia haasteita ja urapolkuja
- Kehittymiseen kannustamista virheitä pelkäämättä
- Monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia työtehtäviä
- Työhyvinvointia ja -turvallisuutta

title: Lähihoitajat, Nurmijärven kotihoito
description:
Tule osaksi Keusoten kotihoitoa, jossa työskennellään suurella sydämellä nurmijärveläisten ikäihmisten arjen tukena.

Haemme lähihoitajia työskentelemään Nurmijärvelle, mutta myös yli kuntaratjojejn Keusoten kotihoitoon.

Keusoten kotihoidossa haluamme, että ikääntyvät asiakkaat saavat parasta mahdollista hoitoa vuoden jokaisena päivänä ja että kotona asuminen tuntuu turvalliselta. Työ on itsenäistä, asiakkaan kotona tapahtuvaa, kuntouttavaa ja toimintakykyä ylläpitävää hoitotyötä.

Nurmijärven kotihoito toimii kahdessa alueessa: eteläinen (Klaukkala) ja pohjoinen (Kirkonkylä, Rajamäki). Etsimme vahvistusta meidän tiimeihin, jossa sinua odottavat huumorintajuiset ja toisiaan tukevat kollegat. Panostamme hyvään perehdytykseen ja yhteishenkeen – täällä et jää yksin. Lähihoitajana vastaat asiakkaan kokonaisvaltaisesta hoidon suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja arvioinnista yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Työ on monipuolista, vastuullista ja merkityksellistä – jokainen päivä on erilainen. Työtä tehdään aamu- ja iltavuoroissa sekä viikonloppuisin.

Tehtävään edellytettävä kelpoisuus

-
Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteen ammatillinen tutkinto.

Hakijalta edellytämme ja toivomme

- Edellytämme kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon, oman työn organisointitaitoa ja hyviä yhteistyövalmiuksia sekä ammatillista osaamista vastata asiakkaiden kokonaisvaltaisiin hoidon tarpeisiin.
- Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää, voimassa olevia lääkelupia, sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa sekä ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta tarvittaessa.
- Tehtävässä edellytetään työntentelyä koko Keusoten alueella,
