description:
Haemme ohjaajia joulunajan sijaisuuteen Järvenpään Lampipuiston asumisyksikköön

Lampipuisto sijaitsee Järvenpäässä lähellä keskustan palveluita. Rakennus on kolmikerroksinen kerrostalo. Lampipuistossa tuotetaan asumispalvelua vammaispalvelulain mukaisesti. Asiakaspaikkoja Lampipuistossa on yhteensä 19.

Ensimmäisessä kerroksessa sijaitsee ryhmäkoti, jossa asuu viisi (5) autisminkirjon asiakasta. Ryhmäkodilla asiakkaat tarvitsevat paljon tukea arjessa sekä struktuurit ovat heille tärkeitä.

Toisessa ja kolmannessa kerroksessa asuu yhteisöllisen asumisen asiakkaita, asuntoja on yhteensä 14 kpl. Yhteisöllisen asumisen asiakkaiden kanssa suunnitellaan yhdessä arkeen ohjausaikoja, jolloin ohjaaja on asiakkaan tukena sovituissa asioissa.

Asukkaat ovat pääsääntöisesti nuoria aikuisia, jotka tarvitsevat tukea ja valmennusta mahdollisimman itsenäisen elämän harjoitteluun. Asiakkaiden kanssa tehdään töitä yhdessä suunnitellen, itsenäisyyttä ja osallisuutta tukien sekä huomioiden. Työ asiakkaiden kanssa on ihmislähtöistä, asiakkaan omaa näkemystä kunnioittavaa ja tukevaa. Haettavan työntekijän työaika painottuu pääsääntöisesti klo 7-21 välille, työ voi sisältää myös yötyötä.

Tehtävään edellytettävä kelpoisuus

- Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteen ammatillinen tutkinto.
- Kelpoisten hakijoiden puuttuessa huomioimme myös alan opiskelijat, joilla vaadittavat opinnot suoritettuina.

Hakijalta odotamme ja toivomme

- Edellytämme voimassa olevia lääkelupia, jotka voi suorittaa heti palvelussuhteen alkaessa sekä hyvää suomen suullista kielen ja tyydyttävää kirjallista osaamista..
- Edellytämme asukkaiden osallisuuden ja itsemääräämisoikeuden huomioimista ja kunnioittamista. Lisäksi tehtävä edellyttää hyviä ihmissuhde- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja.
- Arvostamme aitoa halua ja sitoutuneisuutta työskennellä kehitysvammaisten henkilöiden ja autisminkirjon henkilöiden parissa sekä toimintakykyä edistävää, ylläpitävää ja kannustavaa työotetta

Lisätietoja tehtävistä antaa asumispalveluiden esihenkilö Nina Hintikka, p. 050 497 2821, nina.hintikka@keusote.fi

Lisätietoja palvelussuhteesta sekä tehtävään esitettävät selvitykset

- Määräaikainen palvelussuhde (2kpl) ajalle 14.12.2026-24.1.2027
- Tehtäväkohtainen palkka 2844,60 e/kk. Maksamme työkokemukseen perustuvaa lisää. Puuttuvan kelpoisuuden vaikutus palkkaa on -5%.
- Välittömässä potilas- ja asiakastyössä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n edellyttämää rokotussuojaa ja 55 §:n mukaista hengityselinten tuberkuloosia koskevaa selvitystä.
- Valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2 mom. tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote ennen työn aloittamista työn sijoittuessa ikääntyneiden kanssa työskentelyyn.
- Tehtävässä noudatetaan koeaikaa.
- Alkuperäiset opiskelu- ja työtodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

title: AI Product Consultant Lead
description:
We work with some of the UK’s biggest companies and government departments to provide a pragmatic approach to technology, delivering bespoke software solutions and expert advice.

We're looking for a Lead AI Product Consultant to work with clients to identify high-impact AI opportunities, shape product strategy, and deliver practical solutions that transform the way work gets done.

You'll combine consulting expertise, product thinking, and a strong understanding of AI to help clients move from ideas and experimentation to measurable outcomes. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you'll lead discovery, define product direction, build stakeholder confidence, and ensure AI solutions are delivered responsibly and effectively.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of AI adoption across some of the UK's most complex and ambitious organisations.

What you’ll do:

  • Discover and frame client problems, business outcomes, user needs and decision points before jumping to an AI solution.
  • Identify, assess and prioritise AI and agentic opportunities using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness and change impact.
  • Map workflows and redesign how work gets done across people, AI agents, systems and data.
  • Shape AI product visions, value hypotheses, MVP/PoV scopes, roadmaps, success measures and delivery plans.
  • Define what 'good' looks like for probabilistic AI systems, including evaluation criteria, quality thresholds, failure modes and human oversight.
  • Work with engineers, architects, designers, data specialists and client SMEs to turn concepts into working, testable solutions.
  • Design product guardrails covering explainability, traceability, permissions, escalation, responsible use and appropriate human control.
  • Use evidence from prototypes, pilots and benchmarks to build business cases and advise whether to stop, iterate, scale or change direction.
  • Design and facilitate discovery, strategy, prioritisation, operating model and mobilisation workshops with mixed client audiences.
  • Synthesize complex information into clear recommendations, decision packs, roadmaps, proposals and executive-level narratives.
  • Support change and adoption by helping clients define roles, processes, governance, communications, training and feedback loops.
  • Contribute to AI pre-sales: qualify opportunities, shape engagements, estimate effort, write proposals and statements of work, and present to prospective clients.
  • Help develop reusable Scott Logic AI value propositions, consulting methods, accelerators, playbooks and thought leadership.
  • Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and challenge constructively when technology is not the right answer.

What we’re looking for:

You do not need to be the deepest AI engineer in the room. You do need enough technical understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and make sound product choices. Equally, we are not looking for a traditional management consultant who only produces recommendations. The strongest candidates combine consulting clarity with product management and a bias toward proving value through delivery.

Key Experience:

  • Delivery of AI/ML, GenAI, LLM, RAG or agentic products in an enterprise setting.
  • Product or transformation consulting experience, ideally across complex or regulated organisations.
  • Experience in financial services, government, energy or other environments where governance, resilience and auditability matter.
  • Workflow / service design, operating-model design, change management or business transformation experience.
  • Experience proving AI value through pilots, experiments, benchmarks or measurable productivity/quality outcomes.
  • Pre-sales, proposal writing, account growth, proposition development or consulting practice development.

At Scott Logic, we value the flexibility of remote working alongside the value gained from spending time with our colleagues and clients. In our offices you’ll find employee-led clubs and events, as well as free games, books, and refreshments.

We have shared values that govern our behaviour toward others and the environment. We are proud to be a B Corp, a global movement of businesses driving for a more inclusive, equitable, and regenerative economy.

We believe diversity drives innovation, and embrace a culture where everyone can contribute, irrespective of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability.

title: QA Engineering Leader  | Range Operations
description:
Hej QA Engineering Leader,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilites, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our QA Engineering Leader, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

We’re looking for a QA Engineering Leader who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on leading and continuously refining the quality and test automation approach within Range experience together with the other Software Engineering Leaders and Specialists.

You will also be sharing your work in the wider Range Areas and you’ll report to the Quality Platform QA Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world.

On a typical day, you will:

  • Develop QA test plans and define acceptance criteria for both built and purchased software solutions.

  • Plan, coordinate, and lead QA activities to ensure testing is executed effectively and delivered on time.

  • Coach and mentor members of digital product teams on QA frameworks, methodologies, and best practices.

  • Drive clarity, consistency, and quality in requirements across product and platform teams.

  • Champion test data creation, mocking, and test automation as the preferred testing approach, always balancing cost, value, and efficiency.

  • Provide coaching and constructive feedback to engineering and platform communities to strengthen quality practices and a quality-first mindset.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and platform leaders to ensure features are implemented with quality assurance built into the delivery process.

  • Support product and platform teams in working in a decoupled way to improve software quality and enable effective interface-level testing.

  • Act as the subject matter expert on specialist QA disciplines such as performance testing, penetration testing, and high-availability assurance when needed.

  • Support Engineering Managers in follow-ups, reviews, and quality discussions with consultancy partners.


Qualification

What we’d like you to bring to the table

As a person you see the joy of sharing your knowledge and experience with your colleagues across different teams. Being curious and innovative is at the core of everything you do, and you know that making mistakes sometimes is part of your own development and learning journey.

You bring extensive experience and knowledge in software development and are fully familiar with agile/DevOps practices and tooling, and how the quality aspect is an integrated part of the development. Ideally, you have experience in building test automation frameworks and building their usage in an organization of cross-functional product teams.

You are an experienced leader with the ability to coach our product teams, testers and developers alike around test automation as an integrated part in software development, helping to ensure that we use our resources in the best way to achieve the strongest outcome.

You enjoy an agile, iterative and structured way of working and achieving results together with a team in a flexible environment but also have a strong individual drive to deliver high-quality results on time. You have great communication and networking skills and are fluent in written and spoken English.

The role as a QA Engineering Leader requires you to:

  • Hold a degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience.

  • Have at least 2 years of hands-on software engineering experience.

  • Have at least 5 years of hands-on experience working with QA processes, testing methodologies, and QA tooling.

  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of modern digital product development principles, including aligned autonomy, Conway’s Law, product decomposition, DevOps, automation, blue-green deployments, and automated regression testing.

  • Coach and support engineering teams in adopting quality-first ways of working and embedding quality throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Advocate for early defect prevention through practices such as automation, clear requirements, and decoupled architectures.

  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels, both verbally and in writing.

  • Be a trusted subject matter expert in quality assurance, providing guidance on specialist QA approaches when needed.

  • Have experience of building and maintaining modern test automation frameworks for web using Playwright, Cypress or similar, including custom framework design in JavaScript/TypeScript with deep CI/CD integration via GitHub Actions

It’s a plus if you also have experience with:

  • Using Sentry, Splunk or similar tools for monitoring and real-time error tracking

  • Procurement processes and quality assurance of off-the-shelf or SaaS solutions.

  • Non-functional requirement (NFR) quality assurance and performance testing practices.


More Information

Be yourself, a QA Engineering Leader, and more!

title: Emergency Medical Technician (EMT-B) (Brooklyn Base)
description:
Midwood EMS is seeking new and experienced EMTs to work from our Brooklyn Base located in Coney Island.

WHY WORK WITH MIDWOOD EMS:

  • $1000 Sign-On Bonus for Full-Time Employees
  • Flexible Schedules
  • Seeking Full-Time and Part-Time EMTS
  • Weekly Paychecks
  • Paid Time Off
  • Professional Work Environment
  • Friendly, Dedicated Coworkers
  • Permanent Schedule will include Evenings, Overnights and alternate weekends

EMTs must possess current:

  • New York State EMT certificate
  • New York State Driver’s License (if required)
  • Any and all other requirements for the position as determined by the New York State Department of Health or other regulating agency or statute.

The crew member who acts as the patient care attendant is responsible for all aspects of patient care, beginning with preparation of the patient compartment of the ambulance at the start of the shift.

The duties of the crew include but are not limited to:

Arrival for tour of duty :

The crew must arrive on time, in proper uniform, neat and clean and in possession of a New York State Emergency Medical Technician Certificate. Personal patient care equipment when present, must be in good working order and clean. Persons who do not meet these criteria will not be allowed to start work.

Prior to departing the garage ‑ the crew must :

  • Perform a visual inspection of the patient compartment, inside and out, for cleanliness and damage.
  • Ensure access to and egress from the patient compartment via the rear and side doors.
  • Clean the patient compartment and equipment as necessary
  • Complete the inventory check sheet (Part 800 list).
  • Replace damaged or missing items.
  • Present the signed, dated check‑out sheet to the supervisor.

The crew is responsible to ensure that the ambulance is at all times in compliance with Sections 800.22, 800.23 and 800.24 of the New York State Department of Health regulations and applicable OSHA regulations. All patient care equipment must be clean and sanitary (except when sterile is required) and all equipment must function properly. Failure to carry out this responsibility will result in disciplinary action.

During the tour of duty ‑ the attendant must :

  • Respond to all calls as directed by the dispatcher.
  • Treat all patients in accordance with New York State Basic Life Support Protocols and applicable regional and local ALS protocols.
  • Secure pertinent information and records from the discharge clerk or RN at the transferring facility.
  • Introduce themselves to the patient and call the patient by proper name e.g., Mrs. or Mr.
  • Tell the patient what is happening and where the patient is going.
  • Transport all patients on the stretcher.
  • Carry all patients to and from the ambulance ‑ none are to walk.
  • Carefully monitor all patients during transport.
  • Record changes in patient's condition during transport.
  • Alter patient care in accordance with changes in the patient's condition.
  • Take all patients to their assigned room at a medical facility or to their apartment on discharge.
  • Patients are never to be left at the door.
  • Properly complete the patient care record.
  • Properly complete all company paperwork and obtain all necessary signatures for billing purposes.
  • Report with the patient and records to the appropriate person at the receiving facility.
  • Maintain professional demeanor and courteous interaction with all medical facility staff.
  • Replace equipment in the ambulance as necessary to maintain compliance with State regulations and policy.
  • Return the patient compartment to a condition of readiness for the next call.
  • Notify dispatch of any change in patient’s destination.

Quality patient care is the primary goal of our company. All PCRs are subject to retrospective review by our Quality Assurance manager. Deficiencies in recording or in patient care will be promptly addressed in accordance with our current company Quality Assurance policy.

State Inspections:

Ambulances are subject to inspection by representatives of the State EMS office without advance notice. Inspectors will show proper identification and conduct inspections on the spot.

In the event of an inspection, the crew must notify the dispatcher immediately, then cooperate fully with the inspector. As requested by the inspector, the crew will present or demonstrate any or all equipment on the ambulance.

At the completion of the inspection, the inspector will present the crew with a copy of the inspection sheet that will be turned over to the supervisor at the end of the shift. The crew will promptly notify the dispatcher of the results of the inspection.

In the event a violation notice is issued, the crew must contact a supervisor prior to accepting another patient. The supervisor will decide the course of action.

Our policies and procedures are geared toward strict compliance with the New York State Department of Health regulations. In the event a violation results from an administrative shortcoming, management will accept responsibility and promptly correct the procedure. In the event a violation results from failure on the part of the attendant, disciplinary action will be taken.

End of tour:

The crew must return the ambulance to the garage, secure the ambulance and equipment as required, replace all supplies used during the tour and then report to the supervisor. All paperwork as well as a report of any problems encountered during the tour will be reported to the supervisor.

The foregoing delineates primary responsibilities but is not intended to eliminate creative effort on the part of our employees. Management encourages constructive criticism and recommendations for modification of policies that will result in improving our work environment and service to our patients and clients.

Notice: EMS agencies in NYS are required by law (Executive Law Section 837-s) to check applicants (who may be involved in the care or transportation of patients) personally identifying information against the Sex Offender Registry and make a determination of eligibility to become a member/employee pursuant to Correction Law Article 23-A

title: Caseworker II Intake
description:
POSITION: CASEWORKER II – Intake

Full-Time, 80 hours per pay

DEPARTMENT: Children and Youth Services, Clarion, PA


PAY GRADE: $21.00/hour starting rate

$5,000 Sign On Bonus after 120-introductory period


BENEFITS: Up to family coverage for health, dental, and vision insurance effective first of the month after date of hire (employee pays 15% of premium, county pays 85%). $1,500 stipend if you do not need the county insurance. Life insurance coverage at no cost to employees. 5 Vacation days first year, 10 vacation days starting second year, 3 personal days per year, 10 sick days per year, 13 paid holidays off. Enrollment in Clarion County’s Pension plan (vested after 5 years, eligible to retire at 55 with 20 years of service).

POSTING DATE: Wednesday, September 23, 2026

DEADLINE TO APPLY: Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 4:00 PM

QUALIFICATIONS: A bachelor's degree which includes or is supplemented by successful completion of 12 college credits in sociology, social welfare, psychology, gerontology, criminal justice, or other related social sciences.

HOW TO APPLY

A County application and copy of your transcripts are required to be considered for the advertised vacancy.

Applications are available at:


OVERALL OBJECTIVE OF JOB

To perform intake assessments for all individuals entering the county human service programs, provide daytime and after-hours coverage for protective services of Children and Youth Services. The primary function of the after-hours work is to assure immediate safety of children through the provision of assessment and referral to community-based services.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF JOB

  1. Conducts intake or assessment interviews to determine immediate needs of children and families.
  2. Provides crisis and/or supportive counseling to stabilize children and families.
  3. Provides walk-in, telephone, and mobile crisis intervention services to children and families.
  4. Investigates allegations of sexual abuse, assesses risk, assures safety of child(ren) and if appropriate, makes referrals for ongoing treatment.
  5. Investigates allegations of physical abuse, sexual abuse, assesses risk, assures safety and if appropriate, makes referrals for ongoing treatment.
  6. Assesses individuals for need of emergency mental health services.
  7. Provides information, referral and other required services to individuals and/or families of developmental disabilities or substance abuse services.Assists the individual in the development or enhancement of their natural support systems.
  8. Develops and implements service plans for individuals based on preventing further abuse from occurring.
  9. Provides for necessary arrangements according to individual’s needs; makes referrals/contacts to other community services/agencies to help fulfill the service plan.
  10. Maintains accurate documentation and records on individuals.
  11. Attends court hearings and writes reports as needed.
  12. Testifies in court, if necessary, regarding children’s needs; prepares summaries for court as requested.
  13. Prepares required reports as mandated by federal, state, or County policies and procedures.
  14. Completes necessary filing and maintenance of records.
  15. Utilizes computer and other office equipment as needed.
  16. Maintains statistics on pertinent data base and completes required paperwork/reports.
  17. Assists individual in making appointments, including helping the individual arrange transportation. Transports individual as a last resort.
  18. Travels periodically and makes home visits to individuals as necessary to complete the investigatory process.


OTHER DUTIES OF THE JOB

  1. Attends staffings, training, and other meetings as required.
  2. Attends meetings, training, and seminars as necessary.
  3. Attends certification trainings as required under Act 151 of the Child Protective Services Law, Title 23 PA. C.S.
  4. Required to work flexible schedule in order to meet the needs of consumers.
  5. Performs other job-related work as required.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED

Incumbent must demonstrate the ability to work with minimal supervision. Must be able to formulate an immediate plan of action while in the field, with little or no direct supervisory links. Formal supervision provided by Casework Supervisor.

SUPERVISION GIVEN

None

WORKING CONDITIONS

  1. 1Works indoors in adequate workspace, lighting, temperatures, and ventilation.
  2. Works with average indoor exposure to noise, but subject to frequent disruptions and stress.
  3. Normal indoor exposure to dust/dirt.
  4. Works in conditions of potential outbursts or disruptive behavior of individuals.
  5. Travels frequently during all seasons and is exposed to outdoor elements, including snow and icy roadways.
  6. Works frequently outside the office and is exposed to above average dust/dirt/odors and smoke.
  7. Works non-traditional hours and maintains flexible work schedule.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL CONDITIONS

  1. Must possess above average ability to record, convey, and present information, explain procedures, and follow instructions.
  2. Usually performs job functions in a high-stress environment.
  3. Must be able to sit and/or drive for long periods throughout the workday with intermittent periods of standing, walking, bending, twisting, and reaching as necessary to carry out essential duties of job.
  4. Dexterity requirements range from simple to coordinated movements of fingers/hands; feet/legs; torso as necessary to carry out duties of job.
  5. Sedentary work, with occasional lifting/carrying of objects with a maximum weight of fifty (50) pounds.
  6. Must be able to cope with the physical and mental stress of the position.
  7. Must be able to physically and mentally react quickly in the event of a disturbance or physical outbreak.
  8. Must be able to pay close attention to details and concentrate on work.
  9. Must have above average ability to think clearly and act decisively.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

Six months of experience as a County Caseworker 1;

OR

A bachelor’s degree with social welfare major and 6 months of professional social casework experience in a public or private social service agency.

OR

A bachelor’s degree with concludes or is supplemented by 12 college credits in sociology, social welfare, psychology, gerontology, criminal justice, or other related social sciences and one year of professional social casework experience in a public or private social services agency;

OR

Any equivalent combination of experience and training which includes 12 college credits in sociology, social welfare, psychology, gerontology, criminal justice, or other related social sciences. Necessary Special Requirement: Must possess a Pennsylvania driver’s license.

Clearances:

· Must work in conjunction with employer to apply for Act 34 PA State Police Criminal History, Act 151 PA Child Abuse and FBI clearances prior to employment. All clearances must reflect acceptable results.

· Must not appear on Preclusion Lists as defined by “Pennsylvania’s Medical Assistance Bulletin 99-11-05 Provider Screening of Employees and Contractors for Exclusion from Participating in Federal Healthcare Programs.”

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED

  1. Must be able to speak and understand the English language in an understandable manner in order to carry out essential job duties.
  2. Must possess effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  3. Must possess initiative and problem-solving skills.
  4. Must possess ability to function independently, have flexibility, and the ability to work effectively with individuals, co-workers, and others.
  5. Must possess ability to maintain confidentiality in regard to individuals’ information and records.
  6. Must possess ability to operate personal computer and related software, to type and utilize other office equipment, and to prepare required reports.
  7. Must possess ability to make accurate observations and documentation of it in regard to individuals’ needs and make determinations of risk assessment.
  8. Must possess the academic knowledge and some skill in promoting therapies and social service work and skills with children and youth and families.
  9. Must possess knowledge of child development and the ability to conduct assessments and investigations.
  10. Must possess ability to provide structured and unstructured life skills instructions and guidance to individuals as needed.
  11. Must possess the ability to express empathy and understanding to all individuals.
  12. Must be able to interact effectively with children and youth, department staff, counselors, attorneys, and the courts.
  13. Must be able to work effectively with persons involved in the criminal and/or juvenile justice system.
  14. Must be able to rapidly establish rapport with individuals having behavioral health, substance abuse, or intellectual challenges.
  15. Must have some knowledge of the judicial and court system as it relates to child services.
  16. Must have transportation available and a willingness to travel for work-related job duties.

title: EHS Executive Leader – Wind Services
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a EHS Executive Leader – Wind Services based in United States.

This executive leadership role will oversee environmental, health, and safety strategy and execution across a global wind services organization. The position carries broad responsibility for EHS performance across more than 3,000 employees and 1,000 contractors supporting a fleet of approximately 25,000 wind turbines worldwide. You will translate EHS strategy and performance data into practical operational actions while partnering closely with senior services and regional leaders. The role combines organizational design, contractor risk management, incident investigation, proactive risk reduction, and cultural transformation. You will lead a global EHS team and drive consistent standards across geographically dispersed, high-hazard operations. This is a high-visibility opportunity to strengthen safety performance, operational discipline, and compliance across a complex international services environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Design and optimize the EHS organizational structure for Wind Services, establishing clear accountability, effective response mechanisms, and consistent operational standards across global regions.
  • Serve as the primary EHS strategic partner to senior services leadership, regional leaders, and contractor operations leadership.
  • Translate complex EHS performance data into actionable business strategies that align safety, operational effectiveness, and business objectives.
  • Collaborate with EHS Centers of Excellence to translate global standards into practical, scalable, and effective field-level programs.
  • Direct the execution of EHS initiatives across service regions, with particular focus on operations and maintenance, blades, and other high-risk activities.
  • Ensure EHS standards are embedded into maintenance, repair, and field intervention activities rather than treated solely as documentation requirements.
  • Own the contractor safety lifecycle, partnering directly with contractor leadership to establish EHS priorities, reinforce life-saving requirements, and maintain consistent safety expectations.
  • Lead the global deployment of EHS programs in coordination with regional EHS leaders, promoting consistency, accountability, and disciplined execution.
  • Oversee monthly reporting, KPI analysis, problem solving, action planning, and preparation of management operating reviews related to Wind Services EHS performance.
  • Lead investigations into high-risk near misses, serious injuries, fatalities, and other significant incidents, using findings to drive structural and systemic improvements.
  • Direct proactive risk assessments and safety assurance activities designed to identify and mitigate hazards before incidents occur.
  • Develop data-driven initiatives aimed at reducing incident rates, serious recordable events, and process safety events.
  • Champion a safety-focused culture throughout the organization, influencing senior executives, operational leaders, contractors, and field personnel.
  • Build, recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing global EHS organization.
  • Provide senior leadership with transparent reporting on EHS performance, compliance, risks, challenges, and progress toward safety maturity objectives.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Health & Safety, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
    • Proven experience leading large-scale, complex, geographically dispersed organizations in high-hazard industries.
    • Significant experience in EHS management, including direct execution of EHS programs in operational or field environments.
    • Strong understanding of how EHS functions as a business enabler while maintaining appropriate operational rigor and risk controls.
    • Demonstrated ability to reduce incident rates through proactive risk management, structural improvements, and sustained leadership.
    • Experience managing contractor safety programs and working directly with contractor leadership on EHS performance and compliance.
    • Strong understanding of incident investigation, risk assessment, safety assurance, EHS metrics, and continuous improvement methodologies.
    • Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire stakeholders across diverse global teams.
    • Ability to communicate effectively with both field-level operational teams and senior executive leadership.
    • Strong strategic thinking, organizational design, problem-solving, and change-management capabilities.
    • Demonstrated ability to build and develop high-performing EHS teams across multiple regions and operating environments.
    • Ability to balance global EHS standards with practical field requirements and changing operational priorities.
    • Strong commitment to safety culture, accountability, continuous improvement, and measurable business results.

      • Benefits

      • U.S. base salary range of $192,000–$264,000, with the specific offer influenced by experience, education, skills, and other relevant factors.
      • Eligibility for a discretionary annual bonus.
      • Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

      • Access to executive retirement services.

      • Disability benefits and life insurance.

title: Lääkitysturvallisuusasiantuntija
location: Hyvinkää, Järvenpää, Mäntsälä, Nurmijärvi, Tuusniemi, Finland
description:
Haemme lääkitysturvallisuusasiantuntijaa Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen kliinisten tukipalveluiden tulosalueelle farmasia-asiantuntijapalveluihin.

Farmasia-asiantuntijapalvelut koordinoivat lääkitysturvallisuuden kehittämistä Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen toimintayksiköissä. Työtä on mahdollista tehdä joustavasti etätyönä, mutta tehtävä edellyttää myös liikkumista hyvinvointialueen eri toimipisteissä.

Lääkitysturvallisuusasiantuntijana vastaat hyvinvointialueen lääkitysturvallisuuden kehittämisestä, seurannasta ja koordinoinnista yhteistyössä palvelualueiden, toimintayksiköiden ja sidosryhmien kanssa. Tehtävässä varmistat, että lääkehoidon käytännöt ovat turvallisia, yhtenäisiä ja ajantasaisia sekä tukevat laadukasta potilas- ja asiakastyötä.

Keskeisiin tehtäviisi kuuluvat

- lääkitysturvallisuuden kehittäminen, seuranta ja arviointi koko hyvinvointialueella
- lääkehoitoon liittyvien vaaratapahtumien seuranta sekä ilmoitusten hyödyntäminen toiminnan kehittämisessä
- lääkehoitoon liittyvän lainsäädännön sekä STM:n Turvallinen lääkehoito -oppaan mukaisten toimintatapojen edistäminen
- lääkitysturvallisuuteen liittyvien ohjeiden ylläpito ja kehittäminen
- yksiköiden lääkehoitosuunnitelmien ajantasaisuuden seuranta sekä tuki niiden laatimisessa
- lääkitysturvallisuuteen liittyvien verkostojen ja työryhmien koordinointi (esimerkiksi lääkitysvastaavat)
- osallistuminen vakavien vaaratapahtumien tutkintaan ja korjaavien toimenpiteiden suunnitteluun
- lääkitysturvallisuuteen liittyvien toimintamallien ja järjestelmien kehittäminen sekä käyttöönoton tukeminen
- yhteistyö HUS Apteekin, avoapteekkien ja muiden keskeisten yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja vaikuttavan asiantuntijatehtävän, jossa pääset kehittämään lääkitysturvallisuutta koko hyvinvointialueen tasolla. Tehtävässä pääset tekemään laajaa yhteistyötä eri ammattiryhmien kanssa sekä vaikuttamaan turvallisen lääkehoidon toteutumiseen käytännössä.

Tässä tehtävässä sinulla on mahdollisuus rakentaa ja kehittää lääkitysturvallisuuden toimintamalleja sekä tukea yksiköitä turvallisen lääkehoidon toteuttamisessa osana hyvinvointialueen asiantuntijaverkostoa.

Tehtävään edellytettävä kelpoisuus

- Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto. Lisäksi edellytämme terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) 5 §:n mukaista laillistusta.
- Edellytämme kokemusta lääkehoidosta, lääkehuollosta tai lääkitysturvallisuuden kehittämisestä, hyvää terveydenhuollon lainsäädännön, määräysten, ohjeiden sekä suositusten tuntemusta.

Hakiajlta odotamme ja toivomme

- Toivomme kehittävää ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta, vahvoja viestintä- ja yhteistyötaitoja, kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn sekä asiantuntijaroolissa vaikuttamiseen sekä ohjaavaa ja valmentavaa työotetta yksiköiden tukemisessa.
- Arvostamme lisäksi kokemusta lääkitysturvallisuuden seurannasta, vaaratapahtumien käsittelystä, laadunhallinnasta sekä terveydenhuollon kehittämis- ja asiantuntijatehtävistä.

title: Tamil Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Tamil speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Tamil speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Tamil , and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Tamil and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Tamil experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Tamil , written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Tamil speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

We're recruiting Plumbing and Heating Engineers to install our Air Source Heat Pumps. We're looking for passionate people who have worked on the installation of heating systems and we provide full training for candidates looking to make the transition to renewables!
This is a field based role covering the Cumbria/Carlisle area.

What you'll do

  • You’ll work as part of a team to install low carbon technology in customers' homes - starting with Air Source Heat Pumps
  • You’ll learn about new technologies and get awesome training in our state-of-the-art £10m training centre; giving you the confidence to install the kit, to find solutions to challenges and to share low carbon advice with our customers
  • You’ll use your knowledge and experience of heat pump installations to deliver an outrageous experience
  • You’ll review and collaborate on technical specifications and mechanical drawings
  • You’ll work with an electrician to commission Air Source Heat Pumps
  • You’ll lead a team; be responsible for your crew and empower them to make on-the-fly decisions to do what’s right for you and your customers

What you'll have

  • You’ll be experienced in the installation of boilers and it's a plus if you know about air source heat pumps
  • You’ll be an experienced plumbing and heating engineer with knowledge of heating system design and the ability to fault find. You’ll also have domestic hot & cold water system knowledge
  • You’ll have experience of reviewing and challenging technical specifications & mechanical drawings
  • It would be great if you had knowledge of and a basic competency in electrical levels
  • It would be great if you had experience with hydraulic systems to design & quality standards - CIBSE & MCS - but this isn't a must
  • Similarly F-gas would be great but it’s not essential

Qualifications

  • For this role, you need a minimum NVQ level 2 (or equivalent experience) within the Plumbing and Heating pathway and a full, clean Driving Licence
It would be great if you had some of the below too
  • WRAS Water Supply Regs
  • UHW10/HWSS Unvented DHW Storage Systems
  • Gas safe certification
  • BPEC L3 or equivalent in heat pump installation

What we offer

  • Basic salary £38,000 per year
  • On-target earnings £45,000
  • Additional salary for overtime/on-call
  • £2,500 annual bonus
  • Training programme worth £7,000 at our state-of-the-art R&D centre
  • Share Options in Octopus Energy
  • £25 per week lunch allowance
  • Use of company tools
  • Uniform and all PPE
  • Company Vehicle and fuel
  • Support for personal development in Renewable Tech

Schedule

  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Schedule: 8 hour shift (8am - 5pm Monday - Friday) 42.5 hours per week
  • Overtime

Other Perks

  • Octopus Energy is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about!
  • We've officially a world class company to work for [Best Companies] and we're in Glassdoor's [Top 50 best places to work in 2022]

title: Vastaava työnjohtaja, toimitilarakentaminen (PK-seutu)
description:
Haemme nyt vastaavaa työnjohtajaa toimitilapuolen hankkeisiin pääkaupunkiseudun alueelle. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Tehtävään valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan asiakkaamme palveluksen.

Tulet työskentelemään uudisrakennuskohteiden parissa ja kohteina toimivat erityisesti koulu- ja hoivakotikohteet. Vastaavana työnjohtajana vastaat hankkeiden kokonaisvaltaisesta johtamisesta työmaalla. Huolehdit aikatauluista, laadusta ja turvallisuudesta sekä toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä projektiorganisaation ja asiakkaiden kanssa. Toivomme sinulta aikaisempaa kokemusta vastaavista kohteista.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Soveltuvaa rakennusalan koulutusta, kuten rakennusmestarin tai -insinöörin tutkintoa.
  • Aikaisempaa kokemusta toimitila- ja liiketilamuutostöistä.
  • Laatu- ja kustannustietoista ajattelutapaa, sekä kykyä tehdä itsenäisiä päätöksiä.
  • Vastuullista ja ahkeraa työotetta yhdistettynä erinomaisiin organisointitaitoihin.
  • Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, jotka auttavat sinua toimimaan tehokkaasti tiimin ja sidosryhmien kanssa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Toistaiseksi voimassaolevan työsuhteen, joka takaa vakaan työuran.
  • Mahdollisuuden osallistua vastuullisiin ja mielenkiintoisiin projekteihin, jotka kehittävät osaamistasi.
  • Osaamistasoasi vastaavan kilpailukykyisen palkan.
  • Työyhteisön, jossa arvostetaan osaamistasi ja yhteistyötä. Sinua tukee joukko alan ammattilaisia, jotka jakavat intohimosi laadukkaaseen työntekoon.

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, haethan mahdollisimman pian, sillä paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si palkkatoivomuksineen oheisen hakulinkin kautta. Huomioithan, että haastattelemme henkilöitä jo hakuaikana.

Käy myös katsomassa työntekijävideomme suorarekrytoinnista

Mestarit Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy on rakennusalan ja talotekniikan toimialoilla toimiva henkilöstöpalveluyritys. Yrityksille tuotamme henkilöstöpalveluratkaisuja vahvalla ammattitaidolla. Työntekijöillemme olemme turvallinen ja luotettava työnantaja ja väylä rakennusalan uusiin haasteisiin. Mestareiden toiminta perustuu vahvoihin kumppanuussuhteisiin ja asiakaslähtöisyyteen.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.


About the team

Our Retail and Consumer experts are dedicated to helping clients in an industry which is being transformed by new technologies and evolving consumer expectations. Leveraging over a decade of experience in Applied AI, we combine exceptional technical and delivery expertise to empower businesses to adapt and thrive.

About the role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, we’ll look to you to lead development and deployment of cutting-edge AI systems for our diverse clients. You’ll design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade ML software and infrastructure that meets rigorous operational and ethical standards.

This is an ambitious, cross-functional role requiring a blend of technical expertise, engineering leadership, and confident client-facing skills.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions for high-impact ML systems

  • Designing and building production-grade ML software, tools, and scalable infrastructure

  • Defining and implementing best practices and standards for deploying machine learning at scale across the business

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and commercial teams to solve critical client challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex concepts into actionable strategies

  • Mentoring and developing junior engineers, actively shaping our team's engineering culture and technical depth

Who we're looking for:

  • You understand the full ML lifecycle and have significant experience operationalising models built with frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch

  • You bring deep expertise in software engineering and strong Python skills, focusing on building robust, reusable systems

  • You have demonstrable hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture, security, and infrastructure

  • You've extensive experience working with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale

  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, demonstrating ownership and autonomy in driving projects to completion

  • You communicate exceptionally well, confidently guiding both technical teams and senior, non-technical stakeholders

Our Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

#LI-PRIO

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

This position is with Helena Industries (HI). HI is a wholly owned subsidiary of Helena Agri-Enterprises, LLC and provides production and distribution solutions to customers across a wide variety of industries. HI is one of the largest chemical toll manufacturers in the U.S. and our clients include many household name brands and large retailers.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Engineer is responsible for all engineering-related tasks and leading engineering team members under the direction of the Plant Engineer or Plant Manager.

WHAT YOUR DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

  • Assists Plant Engineer/Project Manager with the execution of capital and expense projects, including: project definition, planning, approval, tracking and reporting.
  • Generates engineering deliverables (drawings, calculations, specifications, bid packages, installation scope, etc.) required for execution of projects.
  • Procures equipment, labor and materials.
  • Supports installation, commissioning and training activities as necessary.
  • Serves as a technical resource for the plant, for both internal and external needs.
  • Assists operations in process analysis and equipment troubleshooting to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Training and mentoring of other employees, including engineers, maintenance, interns, and production personnel as it impacts the process and equipment.
  • Staying abreast of changes in the industry and new technical developments through continuing education, research and personal development.
  • Maintaining plant drawings, including P&IDs, layouts, and electrical drawings.
  • May be required to drive a company vehicle.
  • Provides excellent customer service to all internal and external customers.
  • Other work-related duties as assigned by leader.
  • Regular and reliable attendance is required.
  • Follows all company policies and procedures.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field is required.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Computer skills, including Microsoft Office and AutoCAD are preferred.
  • Interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Manages multiple tasks and projects and meets deadlines.
  • Experience with engineering disciplines and principles is preferred. This may include: process/mechanical (i.e. machine/equipment design, fluid flow, solids handling, heat transfer, strength of materials, mass/energy balance), electrical/controls (i.e. electric power distribution, power and control wiring, process control strategy, instrumentation, automation, pneumatics, and hydraulics), facilities --(i.e. site planning, HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, building design, steam, utilities, construction management and engineering economy).
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time in hot or cold temperatures.
  • Ability to travel by various means up to 30% of the time is required.
  • Can work at elevated heights up to 50 ft.
  • Ability to read, write and speak in English is required.
  • Communicating in Spanish is a valuable skill at Helena.
  • Valid U.S. driver's license is required and must meet all company requirements to drive a Helena vehicle.
  • Applicants for positions requiring operation of a moving vehicle or interaction with heavy equipment must meet the legal age requirement.

title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö, Retail, Ahlsell Oy
location: Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Jyväskylä, Turku, Finland
description:
Pohjoismaiden johtava tekninen tukkukauppa etsii nyt aktiivista ja tuloshakuista Asiakkuuspäällikköä liittymään Ahlsellin myyntitiimiin! Jos sinulla on kokemusta LVI-, sähkö-, työvaate- tai henkilönsuojaintuotteiden jälleenmyynnistä sekä halua kehittää asiakkuuksia pitkäjänteisesti, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinua varten.

Työtehtävästä tarkemmin
Asiakkuuspäällikkönä vastaat jälleenmyyntiasiakkaiden myyntiketjun sujuvuudesta ja varmistamalla samalla parhaan mahdollisen asiakaskokemuksen. Olet päivittäin aktiivisesti yhteydessä asiakkaittesi kanssa niin puhelimitse, sähköpostitse kuin myös asiakaskäynneillä sekä asiakastilaisuuksia järjestäen. Tuet oman vastuualueesi myyntiä myös omassa yksikössäsi. Tehtävä sisältää jo olemassa olevien asiakkuuksien hallintaa, sekä uusasiakasmyyntiä. Tärkeintä meille on oikea, aktiivinen asenne työntekoon sekä aito halu oppia, kehittyä ja vastata asiakkaidemme tarpeisiin.
Toivotut ominaisuudet tässä työtehtävässä
- Hyvät ihmissuhdetaidot ja pelisilmä.
- Olet myyntihenkinen ja nautit ihmisten parissa työskentelystä.
- Sinulla voi olla esimerkiksi kokemusta LVI-, sähkö-, työvaate- tai henkilönsuojaintuotteista sekä ammattilaisten käyttämistä tuotteista ja ratkaisuista aiemman työkokemuksesi kautta.
- Olet oma-aloitteinen, myynnillinen persoona ja haluat auttaa asiakastasi löytämällä hänelle parhaan mahdollisen, ammattilaisen työtä helpottavan ratkaisun. Haluat saada kauppaa aikaiseksi.
- Tiimikaverina olet positiivinen kollega, joka jakaa omaa asiantuntemustaan ja tekee mielellään yhteistyötä niin asiakkaiden, tavarantoimittajien, kollegoiden kuin muidenkin ahlsellilaisten kanssa.

Toivottu osaaminen ja taidot
- Toivomme hakijoilta koulutusta kaupalliselta ja/tai tekniseltä alalta
- Aiempaa kokemusta jälleenmyynistä tai ratkaisuiden myynnistä B2B asiakkuuksille.
- Hyvä perusosaaminen IT-ohjelmista sekä nopea kyky oppia uusia järjestelmiä
- Sujuva suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen ja englannin kielentaito, ruotsin osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.

Työskentelypaikkana voi toimia mikä tahansa Ahlsellin toimipiste Suomessa. Tarjoamme joustavan mahdollisuuden sijoittua sinulle sopivimpaan Ahlsellin yksikköön.

Lyhyesti Ahlsellista työnantajana ja kulttuuristamme
Ahlsellilla pääset osaksi työpaikkaa, jossa ammattimaisuus ja hyvä fiilis kulkevat käsi kädessä. Meillä arvostetaan monimuotoisuutta, reiluutta ja aitoutta – ja ennen kaikkea ihmisiä. Pidämme huolta toisistamme, teemme töitä turvallisesti ja kannamme vastuuta ympäristöstä ja tulevaisuudesta.Työntekijänä saat meillä laajat hyvinvointiedut, kuten liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hierontaedun oman jaksamisen tueksi. Tarjoamme myös turvaa vapaa-ajalle vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella.


Tulevat kollegasi
Ahlsell Retail & Ahlsell Workwear tiimiin kuuluu 14 alan ammattilaista. Tämän lisäksi teet tiiviisti yhteistyötä Ahlsellin myynti ja toimiala organisaatioiden kanssa. Meitä kaikkia ohjaa halu antaa asiakkaillemme ensiluokkainen asiakaskokemus. Kokonaisuudessaan Suomessa sinulla on yhteensä noin 800 kollegaa. Ahlsellilla on Suomessa 40 yksikköä, logistiikkakeskus Hyvinkäällä sekä pääkonttori Vantaalla.
Hakeminen
Mikäli Ahlsell voisi olla sinun tulevaisuutesi työnantaja, lähetäthän hakemuksesi meille 15.10.2026 mennessä.
Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivien henkilöiden kanssa mahdollisimman pian. Toimi siis nopeasti. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytoiva esihenkilömme Anni Hakola p:+358414573084.
Soittoajat: 1.10. klo 14-16.00 ja 2.10. klo 10-11-00.

Tervetuloa viettämään työelämäsi parasta aikaa
Monimuotoisuuslupaus
Me Ahlsellilla rakennamme kestävämpää huomista. Uskomme, että monimuotoinen työyhteisö on vahva työyhteisö. Ahlsellilla sitoudumme edistämään yhdenvertaisuutta ja toivotamme hakemuksia kaikilta iästä, sukupuolesta, kulttuurista, vakaumuksesta, vammaisuudesta, suuntautumisesta tai muusta taustasta riippumatta.
Kannustamme eettisiin toimintatapoihin sekä pyrimme luomaan kestävän ja turvallisen työympäristön kaikille työntekijöillemme. Noudatamme Suomen yhdenvertaisuus- ja tasa-arvolakeja sekä FIBS-monimuotoisuussitoumusta, jonka jäsenenä kehitämme toimintatapojamme jatkuvasti. Hyppää mukaan Pohjoismaiden johtavan teknisen tukkukaupan tarinaan!
Yhdessä rakennamme kestävämpää huomista!
Ahlsell on pohjoismainen teknisten tuotteiden, palvelujen ja ratkaisujen tukkukauppa. Meidän toimintamme pohjana toimivat vahvat arvot: vastuunkanto, avoimuus ja mutkattomuus. Olemme sitoutuneet ylläpitämään korkeaa asiakaspalvelun tasoa, tarjoamalla laadukkaita tuotteita yli 100 vuoden kokemuksella. Valikoimissamme on kaikkea mitä ammattilainen tarvitsee; LV, sähkö, työkalut ja tarvikkeet, IV ja kylmä. www.ahlsell.fi

title: EverPro - Lead Product Manager
description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:


EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.


About The Role

EverPro is hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the next chapter of ZyraTalk, our AI-powered voice and receptionist product line. ZyraTalk was recently acquired by EverCommerce and is now becoming a core part of EverPro’s AI and customer engagement strategy across our portfolio of home services software products.

This role will own the product direction for ZyraTalk while also driving the broader EverPro Voice product line: deepening integrations into EverPro Product Suite; expanding the value of AI voice across customer communication workflows; and helping shape how voice agents become an embedded, revenue-driving capability across the EverPro suite.

The ideal candidate is a senior product leader who is comfortable operating at the intersection of AI, voice, SaaS workflow automation, customer experience, and platform integration. They should be able to translate market opportunity and customer pain into clear product strategy, partner closely with engineering and go-to-market teams, and bring structure to a product area entering its next phase of scale.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for ZyraTalk as part of the EverPro product portfolio.
  • Define and drive the EverPro Voice product line, including how AI voice capabilities integrate into and enhance EverPro’s vertical SaaS products.
  • Identify and prioritize integration opportunities across EverPro products, with a focus on customer communication, scheduling, lead capture, missed-call handling, support workflows, and revenue conversion.
  • Partner with engineering, design, AI/platform teams, customer success, sales, and business unit leaders to deliver high-impact voice and AI-powered workflows.
  • Build a deep understanding of home services SMB customers and how voice automation can reduce administrative burden, improve responsiveness, and drive business outcomes.
  • Translate customer needs, product usage, and business priorities into clear requirements, product briefs, launch plans, and success metrics.
  • Own product discovery, customer feedback loops, competitive analysis, and market insights for AI voice and receptionist capabilities.
  • Drive adoption and commercialization of voice offerings across EverPro, including packaging, positioning, enablement, and expansion opportunities.
  • Establish product KPIs and operating rhythms to measure usage, quality, retention, revenue impact, customer satisfaction, and operational effectiveness.
  • Help lead the transition from founder-led product intuition to a scalable product management discipline for the ZyraTalk product area.

What You’ll Do

  • Create a compelling product vision for AI voice within EverPro and turn that vision into an actionable roadmap.
  • Work closely with engineering to continue developing ZyraTalk’s core capabilities, including call handling, conversational flows, integrations, routing, summaries, handoffs, analytics, and customer-specific configuration.
  • Partner with EverPro product teams to determine where voice should be embedded directly into existing workflows and where it should operate as a standalone or cross-product offering.
  • Prioritize product investments across core ZyraTalk enhancements, platform integrations, customer-specific needs, and scalable shared capabilities.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams to define target customers, packaging, pricing inputs, sales enablement, launch sequencing, and expansion motions.
  • Partner with AI and platform leaders to ensure voice capabilities align with EverPro’s broader agentic platform strategy, including shared tooling, data access, observability, security, and reusable agent patterns.
  • Develop a strong point of view on the AI voice market, including competitive offerings, customer expectations, technical constraints, and emerging opportunities.
  • Bring clarity and momentum to a product area with high strategic importance and significant cross-portfolio potential.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including experience owning complex SaaS products or platform capabilities.
  • Experience with AI, voice, conversational products, communications platforms, workflow automation, or customer engagement tools strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead product strategy and execution in a cross-functional environment.
  • Strong customer discovery skills and ability to translate qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions.
  • Experience working with engineering teams on technically complex products, integrations, APIs, data workflows, or platform capabilities.
  • Ability to balance near-term customer and business needs with longer-term platform and product strategy.
  • Strong analytical skills, including comfort defining success metrics, evaluating adoption, and making prioritization decisions based on data.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align executives, product teams, engineering, sales, customer success, and other stakeholders.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, especially in a newly acquired or rapidly evolving product area.
  • Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how product decisions influence packaging, adoption, retention, and revenue growth.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with voice AI, contact center technology, virtual receptionist products, call tracking, telephony, or conversational AI.
  • Experience integrating acquired products into a broader product portfolio.
  • Experience serving SMB customers, especially in home services, field services, construction, pest control, lawn care, HVAC, plumbing, or similar verticals.
  • Familiarity with AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, speech-to-text / text-to-speech systems, call analytics, or automation platforms.
  • Experience building products across multiple brands, business units, or vertical SaaS products.

Success In This Role Looks Like

  • ZyraTalk has a clear product strategy, roadmap, and operating rhythm.
  • EverPro has a defined Voice product line with clear integration paths across priority products.
  • Voice capabilities are embedded into meaningful customer workflows, not treated as a standalone add-on alone.
  • Product teams across EverPro understand how and where to leverage ZyraTalk capabilities.
  • Customers see measurable value through improved responsiveness, reduced missed opportunities, saved administrative time, and stronger customer communication.
  • The business has a clear view of adoption, quality, revenue impact, and expansion potential.
  • ZyraTalk successfully transitions from founder-led momentum into a scalable, integrated EverPro product capability.

Why This Role Matters

AI voice is becoming one of the most important front doors for small businesses. For EverPro customers, every missed call can mean missed revenue, slower service, or a weaker customer experience. ZyraTalk gives EverPro the opportunity to bring intelligent voice automation directly into the workflows our customers already use every day.

This role will help turn that opportunity into a scaled product line: continuing to advance ZyraTalk while building the voice layer of the EverPro suite.


Where:
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


Benefits and Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation: The target base compensation for this position is $170,000 per $200,000 USD/year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
The Lead Software Engineer for Disney Experiences Technology is a subject matter expert and hands-on technical leader who designs, builds, and evolves high-scale software that powers magical, immersive Guest experiences across parks, resorts, cruise, vacation, travel, retail, and consumer touchpoints worldwide. In this role, you guide engineering efforts across the stack, mentor other developers, and ensure solutions are robust, performant, and aligned with Disney’s creative, customer-focused, and innovative culture.

Responsibilities:

As a Lead Software Engineer, you act as a skilled, experienced subject matter expert and lead, organizing development efforts across UI, services, and integrations to deliver intuitive, high-volume Guest and internal experiences for Disney Experiences brands. You solve complex problems, identify innovative solutions, and serve as a mentor and problem-solver who can explain difficult concepts, influence technical direction, and collaborate as a team player across technology and business partners. This role matters because it connects engineering excellence with Disney’s Guest-centric vision, requiring strong technical depth, communication, collaboration, and accountability to succeed.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and technical lead across the software stack, guiding architecture, design, and implementation for complex, large-scale systems and applications.

  • Organize and lead development efforts, including analysis, programming, debugging, and modification of software improvements and new products used across Guest-facing and internal platforms.

  • Mentor, train, and guide individual contributors by providing continuous coaching, feedback, and technical oversight, helping them connect their work to team goals and business outcomes.

  • Break down organizational and product goals into clear strategies, expectations, and priorities, empowering team members to contribute their unique talents toward well-defined results.

  • Lead end-to-end troubleshooting, problem analysis, and incident resolution for high-volume, 24/7 applications, ensuring reliability, performance, and a seamless Guest experience.

  • Participate in and often lead agile rituals—such as scrums, sprint planning, capacity tracking, and demos—to align deliverables, manage dependencies, and drive continuous value delivery.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners and other technology teams to define system requirements, estimate and plan scalable projects, and negotiate solutions that balance technical and business needs.

  • Own the design and development of backend services, APIs, and integrations, including security, data flow, and performance considerations for cloud-hosted, distributed systems.

  • Stay current with emerging technologies and tools, making informed recommendations that foster creativity, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team.

  • Create an environment where Disney values are experienced daily by encouraging collaboration, creative problem solving, accountability, and ensuring every voice is heard.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong subject matter expertise in software engineering, with the ability to lead complex projects and act as a primary technical point of contact for teams and stakeholders.

  • Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Java, Kotlin, Swift, JavaScript, Python, or similar, including experience with front-end and service development for high-volume applications.

  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems, including security frameworks like OAuth and JWT and integration with cloud hosting environments.

  • Familiarity with persistent storage technologies such as relational databases, document databases, caches, and database programming (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, schema design).

  • Comfort working in an agile environment, managing team rituals, coordinating releases, and delivering continuous value across large or sophisticated systems.

  • Strong problem-solving, analysis, and communication skills, with the ability to explain difficult concepts, negotiate different points of view, and influence technical direction.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers, hold self and others accountable to commitments, and collaborate effectively as a team-oriented, customer-focused leader.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field of study, or equivalent work experience.

  • Minimum 7 years of industry experience in software development or related work on large, scalable systems and high-scale environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience operating at scale in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP), including observability, performance monitoring, and reliability for 24/7 web applications.

  • Background with server-side rendering web frameworks (such as Astro or Angular SSR) to ensure performant, accessible, and SEO-optimized experiences for Disney Parks websites.

  • Exposure to AI-related tools or intelligent service integration, and a desire to further develop technical expertise in modern engineering tools and methodologies.

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, and/or relevant professional certifications in software engineering or cloud technologies.
